ji ga po rjo〉dro/smo ji dzā
(58)skra/:recas rtsar stun sheste /)krung da rag pa ba 'jug gnas bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

mdo sme/ 6) (58)0170 'phags pa blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 3dang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems rin po che yongs su sbyang ba'i le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ gnod pa bzod pa dang nges par 'bigs pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 30gsum pa/ ting nge 'dzin bstan pa'i le'u/ 51bzhi pa/ dpe bstan pa'i le'u/ 72lnga pa/ brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i le'u/ 92drug pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan pa'i le'u/ 108bdun pa/ yongs su gtad pa'i le'u/ 121brgyad pa/ chos kyi sgo'i le'u/ 136dgu pa/ yongs su bsngo ba'i le'u/ 175bcu pa/ sngon byung ba'i le'u/ 196bcu gcig pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun du bstan pa'i le'u/ 2001

bcu gnyis pa/ byin gyi rlabs kyi le'u/ 156rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shrī la dang / bud dha pra bha dang/zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(271) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(302)0171 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 303dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 303gnyis pa/ smon lam gyi le'u/ 335gsum pa/ mi zad pa'i za ma tog gi gzungs kyi le'u/ 348bzhi pa/ mi zad pa'i za ma tog gi gzungs kyi phan yon gyi le'u/ 373lnga pa/ lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 393drug pa/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la gnas pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 403bdun pa/ klu yongs su bskyab pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 428brgyad pa/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 452dgu pa/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa'i le'u 471rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /pradzñā bca dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(ga2) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(518)0172 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa 2

chen po'i mdo/ 519rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shī la dang / mu ne bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(536) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(538)0173 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 539rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo rnyi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(541) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(541)0174 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 542rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dra na shī la dang / ban de ye shes sde dang / yi ge pa dgon gling rma la sogs pas zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(650) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(663)0175 'phags pa mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 6643
dang / dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(817) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(836)

༄ga /'phags pa blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/1)༄༄na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sā ga ra ma ti pa ri tsusgrom nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul rin po che bkod pa'i 'khor gyi khyams de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ bsod nams chen po'i rgyan gyi tshogs bsags pa/ spyod pa chen po'i rgyu 'thunas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rnam par smin pas mngon par grub pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i gnas/ bstan pa mtha' yas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas rnam par sprul pas byin gyis brlabs pa/ chags pa med 4pa'i spyod yul gyi ye shes la 'jug pa/ dga' ba rgya chen po bskyed pa/ dran pa dang / blo gros dang /58—3

rtogs pas 'jug pa/ kun nas ma smad pa/ ye shes kyis rnam par dpyadamatsho)pa de la ma chags par rtogs pas 'jug pa/ bskal palo5)mu med par mngon par bstod pa/ yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad dpag tu med pa na bzhugs te/bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni mnyam pa nyid du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ chos kyi 'khor lo ni shin tu bskor/ slob ma shin tu dul ba mtha' yas pa'i tshogs ni mnga'/ chos thams cad la mnga' dbang ni brnyes/sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa sgrub pa ni legs par mkhyen/ dbang po'i dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni brnyes/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba yang dag par 'joms pa la ni mkhas/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa lhun gyis grub pa ni rgyun ma chad cing / dge slong 'bum phrag drug cu'i cadage slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cigatsha ste/ thams cad kyang cang shes kyi sems dang ldan pa/nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba yang dag par 'jomasam pa la brtson pa/ chos kyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras/ chos zab mo la gnas pa/ dmigs pa med pa'i chos kyis nges par byung ba/ spyod lam mdzes pa phun sum tshogs pa/ sbyin gnas chen por gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' la shin tu zhugs pa sha stag go/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dmigs pa med57pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa rab tu thob pan/ dbang bskur ba dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa la zhugs pa/ mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pas rnam par rtsen pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs mi zad pa'i za ma tog rab tu thob pa/ byang chub sems 58—4

dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dpa' bar 'gro ba la dbang thob pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i so so yang dag par rig pa sems can thams cad tshim par byed pa rjes su thob pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa lhun gyis grub pas nges par byung ba 41bkod pa'i rgyan gyi lhag pa'i bsam pa la shin tu gnas pa/ tshad med/grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/ gzhal du med/dpag tu med pa la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mdzod mi zad pa zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros tshad med pa zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spobs pa mtha' yas zhes7bya ba dang / byang chu/ sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dmigs pa med pa'i bsam gtan pa zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus gong na 5med ces bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus blo gros zhes bya ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgyun mi 'chad pa zhes bya ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chags pa med pa'i mi 'jigs pa brtsegs pa zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don nges par brtags te bltas rib zhes bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med/ grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/ gzhal du med/ dpag tu med pa dag dang yang thabs cig 5go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pas nges par 'byung ba sgrib pa med pa'i sgo byang chub sems dpa'i lam bkod pa la dmigs pa/ stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi 58—5

chos thams cad yongs su 'grub pa'i ye shes kyi 'byung gnas chos thams cad la51)dbang sgyur 5ba'i gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i sgor 'jug pa/ so so yang dag par rig bapas rnam par gdon mi za ba la 'jug pa'i sgo/ mngon par shes pa chen po'i ye shes la 'bab pas 'jug pa 4phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa ston pa/theg pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid du yang dag par 'du ba/ chos kyi dbyings 'dres pa med de tshul gcig pa rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang dbang po'i tshul la 'jug pa ston pa/ snying po dang ldan pa/ chos rnam par gdon mi za ba dang 5/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'joms pa/ tshul bzhin du chos kyi tshul la 'bab cing 'jug pa/nyon mongs pa dang lta bar gyur pa thams cad 'dul ba/ chags pa med pa'i ye shes la 'jug pa/ kun tu bsngo ba'i thabs la nyanamakhas pa shes pa ston57)pa/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la 'jug pa/ chags pa med pa'i byin gyi rlabs 8kyi sgo chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par gdon mi za ba ston pa/ mi rtog cing rnam par mi rtog ste597/ mnyam pa nyid du 'jug pa/rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab mo rtogs par byed pa1 )/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen po sogs 11pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs mnyam pa nyid kyi rgyan dang ldan pa/ dran pa dang / blo gros dang / rtog nyu pa dang ske/ mos pa dang / shes 1lharab mi zad pa mngon par sgrub pa/ nyan thos kyi theg pas 'dul ba'i phyir 'phags pa'i bden pa'i 1 tshul la 'jug pa/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas 'dul ba'i phyir lus dang sems rab tu dben par shes pa / theg pa chen pos 'dul ba'i phyir thams cad mkhyen par dbang bskur ba 58—6

rab tu thob pa/ chos thams cad la dbang sgyur 17ba'i tshul la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan brjod pa'i phyir gsung ngo ske/ /ston to/ /rab tu 'chad don/ /'dzin du 'jug go/ /klog tu 'jug go/ /shes par mdzad do/ /rnam par shes par mdzad do/ /rab tu shes par mdzad do / /rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par 'byed do/ /rnam par 'grel to/ /gsal bar mdzad do/ /yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don shin tu rnam par nges pa 'dus pa chen po'i le'u'i —cos kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan pas thams cad dang ldan pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'og tu sa'i steng canas bzung ba yan cad zhinarin po che bkod 0pa'i 'khor gyi khyams kyi gzhi la thug pa'i bar dag tu 57/chus yongs su gang ba'i rgya mtsho gcig ltar kun tu snang ste/ 'di lta ste dper na/ bsreg 8pa'i bskal pa 'das nas chags pa 'byung ba'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad chus yongs su gang bar 'gyur te/ chu'i dkyil 'khor gyis yongs su 'khor ba de bzhin du/ de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi 9khams thams cad chus yongs su gang ba'i rgya mtsho gcig lta bur gnas par kun tu snang yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang /ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rnams la yang 1 sgrib pa med par kun tu snang ngo / / 'dzam bu'i 11gling rnams dang / gling bzhi pa chen po rnams dang / rgya mtsho chen po rnams dang / ri rab rnams dang /'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams la yang sngon ji ltar phyis kyang de bzhin du 58—7

sgrib pa ci yang med par de kho na bzhin du kun du snang ngo / /chu'i phung po de las kyang pad ma chu ba ni be+e drur+ya༄te// sdong bu ni an da rnyil/ lo ma ni 'dzam bu'ikhuchu bo'i gser/ ze ba ni dpal gyi snying po/ snying po ni rdo'i snying po las grub pa/mu tig gi dra bas ni khebs par byas pa/ 'dabasko )ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dngas )ldan pa/ tshad ni rgyang grags kyi khyon tsam yod pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po byung ste/ de dag rin po che'i bkod pa'i 'khor gyi khyams kyi gzhi las thal nas shing ta la'i /desrid du 'phags te/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de yang de'i tshe pad ma la 'khod par kun tu snang ngo / /pad ma de dag las kyang 'od gang dag gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med grangs med pa dag snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur pa'i 'od de lta bu dag byung ngo / /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de ngo mtshar du gyur nas ji ltar snga ltas56)'di dag kun tu snang ba las na/ kye ma'o 'di ni chos bstan pa chen por 'gyur ro zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod rdo7)/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas cho 'phrul chen po de mthong nas pad ma'i stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga pad ma'i snying po la btsugs nate/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 9logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di chab kyis yongs su gtams tu ripa'i rgya mtsho gcig lta bur kun tu gda' 1 4ba dang / pad ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 'di snyed cig 1 mngon par byung 1 ba 'di dag dang / bcom ldan 'das sngon ma mthong ma thos pa'i cho 'phrul rgya chen po 'di dag kun tu gda' ba 'di 58—8

dag su'i snga ltas73)lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byems pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byams pa 'og gi phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyiloXkhams kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan rin po che dri ma dang bral ba dpag tu med pa bkod pas brgyan pa zhes bya ba de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i mchog mnga' ba'i 5)blos rnam par rol pa mngon par 'phags pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa zhes bya ba bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston pa yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtsho zhes bya ba / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bgrang bte rilas 'das pa dag dang lhan cig tu nga la blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba dang ske/ chos bstan pa 'di las gtam gyi rgyud 'ga' zhig dri ba'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 'ong bar 'gyur te/ 'di ni de'i snga ltas rigaso/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho thag ring po de srid cig 6)na mchis shing chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu khyod ji ltar nga'i mdun na chos kyi 7rnam grangs 'di nyan pa de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho yang 'jig rten gyis8)khams de na 'dug cing chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan to/ /shā ri'i bu khyod kyis ji ltar nga dang thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor 'di mthong ba 58—9

de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos kyang nga 1dang thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor 'di mthong ngo / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kye ma'o ci tsam du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyi stobs 'di bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ 'di ltar thag ring po de srid na mchis kyang mig gis gzugs mthong ba la sgrib pa ma mchis shing rna bas sgra thos pa la sgrib pa ma mchis pa ni ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi yon tan gyi che ba nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di thos nas su zhig bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems mi bskyedan/ gnas brtan shā ri'i bus bstan pa 'di bshad pa'i tshe lha'i bu nyi khri bzhi stong gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtsho byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis kun nas bskor te mdun du bdar nas lhan cig tu/ bcom ldan 'das rgya mtsho'i mchog mnga' ba'i blos rnam par rol pa mngon par 'phags pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das des gnang ste/ sangs rgyas rnam par rol pa'i dardzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang /mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i 4rdzu 'phrul dang / sems gcig gis thob pa'i ridran pas mig phye ba tsam gyis 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan rin po che'i dri ma dang bral ba dpag tu med pa bkod pas brgyan pa de nas mi snang bar gyur nas/'jig rten gyi 6khams mi mjed 'dir phyin 7te/ rin po che bkod pa'i 'khor gyi khyams kyi gzhi las thal nas shing ta 8la bdun tsam du mngon par 'phags te 58—10

pad ma'i snying po la 'dug par kun tu snang ngo / /de las gzhan pa'i pad ma'i snying po rnams la yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag 'khod par kun tu snang ngo / /'og gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med grangs med pa dag nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shin tu grangs med dpag tu med pa dag chos nyan05pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtsho'i phyi bzhin du 'brang bar gyur to/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma la 'khod pa dag gis rin po che bkod pa'i 'khor gyi khyams shin tu rgyas pas mdzes te/ lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /de nam thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de ngo mtshar du gyur te/ dga' ba dang / dang bam dang / rab tu dga' ba thob nas thalas namo sbyar te/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag la phyag 'tshal 5)to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtshos 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan rin po che dri ma dang bral ba dpag tu med pa bkod pas brgyan pa na yod pa'i me tog mya ngan med cing yid du 'ong ba mthong na dga' ba zhes bya ba 'dab 'am bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa / tshad rgyang grags kyi khyon tsam yod pa de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par 'os pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pas rnam par dag pa sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas yongs su sbyangs pa/ rnam par bkra ba/ mig tu sdug pa/ 'khor thams cad tshim par byed pa kun nas 'od dang 7ldan pa kun nas shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i nadri dang ldan pa'i me tog de 'dra ba dag mchod pa'i las kyi phyir 9bcom ldan 'das kyi 1 spyan sngar me tog gi char chen po mngon par phab ste/ me 58—11

tog gi char des rin po che bkod pa'i 'khor gyi khyams su mi bdun gyi 'phang tsamadza1)gyi me tog dgram pa bkram par gyur to/ /rab tu dben pa'i bsam gtan gyi zas zhes bya ba'i sil snyan yang bsgrags te/ sil snyan gyi sgra des thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de bsam gtan la snyoms par zhugs pa bzhin du bdag bde bas tshim par shes so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtshos bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa 'di lta bu 'di byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 2zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal ①te lan bdun bskor ba byas nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi 4)spyan sngar thal mo sbyar te 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho'i mchog mnga' ba'i blos rnam par rol pa mngon par 'phags pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa bcom ldan 'das la gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba nyung ngam/bskyod pa yang ngam/ stobs dang bde bar reg pa la gnas sam zhes snyan gsol tor / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi ne zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalas7)te/ lan bdun bskor ba byas nas slar rang rang gi 8tshostan la 'khod do/ /de nas stong gsum gyis49)stong chen po'i tshangs pa snying rje chen po sems pa zhes bya ba mya ngan med pa'i gling bzhi pa chen po na gnas pa/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten na 'dug pas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams chus yongs su gang ba'i rgya mtsho gcig lta bu yang mthong / pad ma rnam par bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa/ bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong mngon par byung ba yang mthong / rin po che bkod pa 'khor gyi khokhyams byang chub sems dpas 11gang ba yang mthong ste/ mthong nas kyang de 58—12

'di snyam du sems te6)/ bsregasho pa'i bskal pa ni ma byung na chus 'jigam pa 'di byung ste/ 'di lta bu'i cho 'phrul 'di dag kun tu snang ba 'di la rgyu ci yod/bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi 4)thad du song ste/ bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos 'a/chen po 'jig rten du byung ba'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags zhes zhu'o snyam mo/ /de nas tshangs pa snying rje chen po sems pa' tshangs pa 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa labargyad kyis yongs su bskor te/ mdun du bdar nas lhan cig tu tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas mi snang bar gyur te/ rin po che bkod pa'i 'khor gyi khyams su bcom ldan 'das kyi na spyan sngar steng 49)gi bar snang la 'dug ste/ lus btud thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das nyid la phyag 'tshal tobo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshangs pa snying rje chen po sems pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ci lags/ gang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di chab kyis yongs su gtams 17pa'i rgya mtsho gcig lta bur kun tu gda' ba dang / pad ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag 'di snyed cig byung ba 'di dang / de dag la yang skyes bu dam pa dag mchis pa 'di lta bu kun tu gda' yang bcom ldan 'das stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na grong dang / grong khyer 12dang / grong rdal dang /ljongs 1snyedang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rnams la yang sgrib pa ma mchis par kun tu gda' ba dang / 'dzam bu'i 7gling rnams dang /gling bzhi pa chen po rnams dang / rgya mtsho rnams dang / ri rab rnams dang /'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams la yang sngon ji lta bar phyis kyang de bzhin du sgrib pa ci yang ma mchis par de kho na bzhin du kun tu gda' ba de la/ bcom 58—13

ldan 'das 'di su'i byin gyi rlabs 1kyis gyur snyam du bdag ngo mtshar cher gyur na 'di su'i snga ltas nalags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshangs pa snying rje chen po sems pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /tshangs pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho mchog mnga' ba'i blos rnam par rol pa mngon par 'phags pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan rin po che dri ma dang bral ba dpag tu med pa bkod pas brgyan pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtsho byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bgrang ba las 'das pa dag dang lhan cig tu nga la blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / 'dus pa chen po'i le'u'i 3chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las gtam gyi rgyud 'ga' zhig yongs su dri ba'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 'ong ba yin te/ gang stong gsum gyi 5stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyis 6)khams 'di chus yongs su gang bar kun tu 97snang ba 'di lta bu na'adi ni de'i rnam par sprul pa'i byin gyis rlabs 9so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das da dung yang7 ci'adus pa chen po'i le'u'i 11chos kyi rnam grangs 'chang ngam12/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i spobs pa la 15ni/ rgyun chad pa chung zad kyang med de15/ gang gi tshe khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa cang mi gsung bar gyur pa mthong ba de'i tshe na yang / nga ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi skra khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la chos rnam par nges pa'i gtam yang dag par rab tu ston te/ tshangs pa nyi sangs rgyas kyi yul ni de ltar bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang 'di lta bu 58wa 14

'di rnam par sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtsho zhes bgyi ba de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/tshangs pa khyod kyis pad ma dpag tshad bcu'i khyon tsam yod pa de'i dkyil na pad ma'i snying po la rin po che bkod pa'i seng ge'i khri 'phang du shing ta la bdun tsam pa srog chags bye ba phrag mang pos phyag byas pa mthong ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 1 bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa khyod kyis seng ge'i khri de la byang chub sems dpa' lus gser gyi kha dog tu 'dug pa/ lus mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos legs par brgyan pa 'dug ste/gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ma gtogs par gzhan byang chub sems dpa'i lus zil gyis mnan nas 'dug pa/ byang chub sems dpa' mang pos phyag byas pa mthong ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtsho zhes bya ba ste/ 'di ni de'i rnam par sprul pa'o/ /de nas tshangs pa snying rje chen po sems pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal nanonas tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul 'di lta bu dag thob par /gyur cig /gang dag byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho'i ming thos pa'i sems can de dag ni rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang skyes bu dam pa 'di'i ming thos shing gzugs kyi 5lus kyang mthong bas bdag gis kyang rnyed pa legs par rnyed 'do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dus pa chen po'i le'u'i 7chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yun ji srid cig 8tu 'chad/58—15

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa ji srid du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku che'i tshad gnas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' (1)'di dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / yang dag par rab tu stonadza pa dang / rgyas par byed kyi bar du'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshangs pa 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnamyo sa kyis45)byang chub ni ci 'di'i nang du 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo grosam rgya mtshos 'khor thams cad rgya cher yang dag par rab tu dga' bar bya ba dang / tshangs pa snying rje chen po sems pa 'dun par bya ba dang / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di brgyan par bya ba dang / bdag nyid kyi shes rab kyi 'dang / spobs pa'i stobs nye bar bstan pa'i phyir pad ma dang lhan57ricig seng ge'i khri dang lhan cig tu steng gi bar snang la shing ta la bdunas48)srid tsam na 'dug ste/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /khrag khrig sangs rgyas 9zhing rdul snyed kyi zhing rnams 'das pa'i 'og logs na/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 1 gnas zhing yon tan kun ldan rab mdzes pa/ /de na 'dren pa'i bstan pa rgya mtshos 11blo thugs mtshungs pa med 12bzhugs te/lha/ /der ni bdag gis thub pa'i chos thos gyur te thos nas de bzhin bzung / /bdag ni stobs 1 bcu ldan la blta bar bgyi dang de bzhin phyag bgyi dang / /byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog 'di rnams phan tshun dri slad 'dir mchis te/ /skyob la phyag bgyi bas ni chos rgyal mtshungs med khyod la 'dir phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa gang lags rgya chen shin tu rgyas pas mchod pa 'tshal/ /gang gis 1558wa 16

gzugs la gzugs su mi rtog tshor ba 'dus bgyis ma lags shing / /rnam par shes pa'ang tshor gsum bzhin du rtag par shin tu rnam dag ste/ /gang zhig 'dren la mtshan du ma lags skyes dang rigs su ma lags rtogs11/ /mig ldan des ni chos kyi rgyal po dri med yang dag don du mthong / /bdag gam bdag med ces bya'i (nyamatha' de gnyi ga mi len mi 'dor te/ /nang du gyur pa zhi zhing thugs kyang zhi ste phyi rol rgyu ci nomi mnga'/ /mi rtog rnam mi rtog cing rtog bral thub pa'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra/ /des ni phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs chos kyi rgyal mtshan gsal mdzad rnams la mchod/ /gang blo sbyin pa rnams la 'di ni sgyu ma len pa stong pa nyid/ /g.yo ba med pa'i yid kyis nor rnams de dag re ba med par gtong / /byang chub don du nges kyi lta bar nges min spros las niganas ma yin / /gang blo sems can nyes pa mthar 'byin de ni sbyin bdag ser sna med/ /de ni rab tu zhi bas zhi ste ngag med yid med lus gdung med/ /gdung ba med pas bcing ba rgya chen bralamar te des pa dbang po zhi/ /bdag med theg tsi par gnas nas byang chub dmigs pa med cing de mi 'dor/ /khrims gnas blo ldan khrims 'chal mthar byed 'dod pas tshul khrims dri ma med/ /chos rnams skad cig par ni rtogs par shes bya rnams la smras pa med/ /nam mkha' mtshungs pa'i yid kyis 'gro ba 'di dag sgyu ma ji 8bzhin mthong / /gang zhig lus ni dum bu dum bur bcad kyang yid ni khro mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig byang chub brtul zhugs gnas pa'i blo ldan mkhas de bzod pa smra/ /gang zhig chos rnams chu zla chu bur mnyam zhing sgyu ma mig rgyu 'dra/ /rtogs nas mi min srog ma yin zhing shed bu ldan pa ma yin mthong / /byang chub dang ni sems can tshogs mi dmigs kyang byang 58—17

chub gzhan don brtson/ /tshulas 1)'dir gang zhig skrag pa med pa de ni brtson 'grus tha mar phyin/ /gang gi 2)sems ni yul la chags pa med cing the tshom kho yod min la/ /sems can gzhan gyi sems kyi spyod pa dus gsum gyur pa'ang shes pa dang / /gang sems spyod par gyur pa gang yin des4)yi bdud kyis mi shes 5pa / /pha rol phyin thob bsam gtan dang ni mngon par shes la blo gros gnas/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung kun nyan cing de bzhin 'dzin byed pa/ /bskal pa dpag tu med par smras kyang spobs pa rgyun chad mi 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas chos rtogs sems can mi ltung de ni gang du'ang gnas 67med pa/ /bcom ldan thub nyid mkhyen gter shes rab ldan zhing 'jig rten gsum na dpa'am/ /gang zhig pha rol phyin pa'i pha rol gshegs kyang gshegs lke /min ma gshegs min/ /gang zhig sems can spyod pa mthar phyin mi gnas g.yo ba mi mnga' zhing / /yon tan kun mthar gang phyin yon tan rnams la rlom rinasems mi mnga' ba/ /thub pa'i dbang po shākya 9sangs rgyas khyu mchog de la mgo bos 'thug1 /'od zer rnam dag nyi mas srin bu me khyer 'od rnams zil gyis mnan / /me lce rtse mthon 11bskal mtha'i me yis sa 12la ji snyed yod pa sreg1lha /ri mchog ri rab kyis ni sa la yod pa'i ri kun zil gyis mnan/ /shākya khyu mchog spu 'dis 'jig rten gsum gyi 'od gzhan zil du rlag1 /zhing brgya dag nas lhags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog ji snyed pa/ /de dag gtso bo khyod kyi mdog dang gzi brjid kyis ni tshim par gyur/ /gang dag smon lam ji ltar btab pa de ltar kun gyis 'thun par mthong / /bdag cag gang nas ma 'ongs rang gi zhing nyid na ni 'dug par shes/ /ji ltar gang gis rang rig de ltar khyod 58—18

kyi gsung ni shin tu 'jug /srid pa gsum na skad rnams ji snyed ci mchis de dang 'thun par 'jug /rdul gyi rdul dang mi rnams kyi 91ni sems kyi bsam pa bgrang nus srid/ /thub pa'i gsung dbyangs tshad med nam mkha' na'adra 'di bgrang bar nus ma lags/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mi rnams kyi ni mtha' ma bgrang bar mi nus te/ /'khor ba'i sngon gyi mtha' ma nyid ni rnam pa kun tu bgrang mi nus/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang 'khor ba'i mtha' ni mi yis bgrang bar nus kyang srid/ /sangs rgyas mkhyen dang ting 'dzin tshul khrims yul ni gang du'ang shes mi nus/ /gzhal yas bskal par gang gi bsngags pa brjod par sla ba ma lags pa/ /khyu mchog dpag yas chos kyi dbang phyug 'dren pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye bo gang dag shes dang mos pas sangs rgyas che ba rjes rtogs pa/ /de dag gis ni blo gros bsam yas rmad byung kun lhag 'dren pa mthong / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtshos tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras nas bar snang de las babs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol tol/ /gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtsho la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu khyod de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang / dris pa de dang de ngas lung bstan pas khyod kyi 58—19

sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po (3)blo gros rgya mtshos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin shin tu dkar ba dri ma med pa'i phyag rgya zhes bgyi ba mchis te/ ting nge 'dzin de la rab tu gnas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya zhes bdag gis thos na3)/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi shin tu dkar ba dri ma med pa'i phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin ji ltar 'thob pa dang / ci'i slad du shin tu dkar ba dri ma med pa zhes bgyi ba bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas de legs par bshad du gsol/ ting nge 'dzin de la 'jug pa'i sgor 'jug pa gang thos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob cing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas legs par bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtsho la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so/ /kye ma dri ba 'di bzang zhing dpyod pa de tshul bzhin yin (7te / de'i phyir rigs kyi bu legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shigs dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis shin tu dkar ba dri ma med pa'i phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin 'di ji ltar 'thob pa dang / myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 58—20

'gyur ba ngas bshad par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtsho bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan0)pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /blo gros rgya mtsho 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni dge ba'i rtsa bas bstanasko pa yin te/ dge ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pa/ nges da pa'i phung po la rab tu gnas pa/ tshogs bsags pa/ dbang po rno ba/ dge ba'i bshes caganyen gyis yongs su zin pa/ sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ rgyu'i stobs can yin te/ de ni risakyisangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mnyes par byed / bsti ne/stang du byed/ bla mar byed/ rim gror byed/ mchod par byed dol/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi gzugs phun sum tshogs pa mthong zhing gsung snyan pa thos te7)/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa yang mthong zhing chags pa med pa'i mkhyen pa yang thos la/ rdzu 'phrulas gyi cho 'phrul 9lam/ kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrulamatshalam/ rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul 11gyis sems can 'dul ba mdzad pa yang mthong nas sems can rnams la snying rje chen po skyes te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin te/ dge ba'i chos yongs su tshol 1 ba la brtson zhing thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes brjid sna pa med pas sems yongs su dag par rnal 'byor du byed do/ /de sems yongs su dag pas ting nge 'dzin yongs su dag pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /blo gros rgya mtsho 'di lta ste/ dper na rigs 'phags pa'i nor bu rin po che nor bu mkhan mkhas pa'i lag tu son pa/ ji tsam na yongs su dag pa dang ske/ shin tu dkar ba dang / mthing bu dang bral ba dang / skyon med par 58—21

gyur pa de srid du yongs su sbyangs na/ skyes bu mkhas pa nor bu rin po che la mkhas pa rnams 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' nya rigs 'phags pas thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa (gerin po che bskyed nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ ji tsam na mthing bu dang bral zhing rlom tshurisems kyi mthing bu dang bral bar 'gyur ba de srid du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ri4nodage ba'i rtsa ba 45yongs su sbyang ba bya ba dang / thos pa la mkhas pa yongs su sbyang ba bya bas thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems bskyed pa'i rin po che de yongs su sbyangs na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'du 6zhing shin tu dkar ba dri ma med pa'i phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin 'di yang 'thob bo/ /blo gros rgya mtsho 'di lta ste dper na/ rigs 'phags pa'i nor bu rin po che de ni rin po che'i rigs dgu las shin tu 'das par 'byung ste/dgu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gser gyi rigs dang / dngul gyi rigs dang /shel gyi rigs dang / be+e drur+ya'i 7rigs dang / rdo'i snying po'i rigs dang /spug gi rigs dang / mu tig dmar po'i rigs dang / ke sa ra'i ④rigs dang ske/ dpal gyi snying po'i rigs te9/ nor bu rin po che'i〈 )rigs dgu po 'di dag las shin tu 'das nas/ dri ma med cing rnam par dag pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i nor bu rin po che chen po'i rigs de las de rin thang med pa'i nor bu rin po cher 'gyur te/ de 'khor los sgyur 11ba'i rgyal po'i yongs su spyad par 'gyur gyi/ de ma yin pa'i sems can phal pa 12gzhan rnams kyi ni nyanyam yin te/nor bu rin po che de'i 'od gang yin pa des ni de ma yin pa'i nor bu rin po che 58—22

gzhan rnams kyi 'od mog mog por byed do/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa'i rin po che de yang rin po che'i rigs dgu las shin tu 'das par byung ste/ dgu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ so so'i skye bo dge ba'i rin po che'i rigs dang / dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i rin po che'i rigs dang ske/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rin po che'i rigs dang / mtshan ma med pa 1la gnas pa rin po che'i rigs 2dang / rgyun tu zhugs dpa rin po che'i rigs dang ske/ lan cig 5phyir 'ong ba rin po che'i rigs dang / phyir mi 'ong ba rin po che'i rigs dang / dgra bcom pa rin po che'i rigs dang / rang sangs rgyas rin po che'i rigs dang / rin po che'i rigs dgu po 'di dag las shin tu 'das nas bcu pa sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa snying rje chen chapo'i rin po che'i rigs las thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa de rin po che 'byung ste/ de yongs su sbyangs na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis non cing / sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi sgyu rgyud rnams la yang snang bar byed do/ /blo gros rgya mtsho 'di lta ste dper na/nor bu rin po che chen po de gang gi 75tshe/ sbyang 8bzod cing gnod pa bzod la/phugs smyo nas kyang nyes par 1 ma gyur na7/ nor bu rin po che chen po de ni 'di ltar sems can bsod nams byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa rnams la phan pa 12byed par 'gyur ro/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa rin po che de yang gang gi tshe sbyang bzod cing gnod pa bzod la/phugs 12nas kyang nyes par ma gyur na thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa rin po che skyon thams cad dang bral ba de 'di ltar sems can thams cad la phan 58—23

pa 1byed par 'gyur ro/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de la thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa rin po che de sbyang ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sdom pa gsum gyis dge ba bcu'i las kyi snolam yongs su dag pa dang / byams pa'i rjes su 'jug pas sems can thams cad la byams shing dang ba 5dang / snying rje'i rjes su 'jug pas sems can thams cad kyi bya ba ci yodam snyam pa la brtson pa dang / dga' ba'i rjes su 'jug pas sems can thams cad chos la sbyor ba dang / btang snyoms kyi rjes su 'jug pas sems can thams cad la mi 'tshe 5)zhing rtag tu sems drang ba dang / g.yo dang sgyu 6med pas phan pa'i dngos po'i57bsam par gyur pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad brtsam pa la lhag 9pa'i bsam pa sbyor ba dang / cang shes kyi sems kyis dran pa dang shes bzhin dang ldan pa dang /sems shin tu dul bas sems las su rung ba dang / dgang ('o )sla bas sbyangs pa'i yon tan yo byad bsnyungs pa'i cho ga dang ldan pa dang / gso 3 )sla bas 'phags pa'i rigs chog shes pa dang / bla ma dang sbyin gnas rnams la 'dud cing rab tu 'dud pa dang / nga rgyal med pas khengs pa dang rtsod pa rnam par spong ba dang / sems nges par sems pas nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal rnam par spong ba dang / rnyog pa med pas sems gsal ba dang / bdag la mi stod /1pas bdag shes pa la 'jug pa dang / gzhan la mi smod pas sems can rjes su srung 12ba dang / sman gyi sems kyis chos la gus pa dang / de'i don so sor myong bas chos don du gnyer ba dang / de la gzhol 'bab babs1 pas chos 'dod pa dang / nyon mongs pa med pa la gnas pas chos la dga' ba dang /chos ma yin pa rnam par spong 1 bas chos yongs su tshol 15ba dang / rtag tu ngo tsha 58—24

shes pas dkon mchog gsum la dad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / las kyi rnam par smin pa la yid ches —pas dge ba thams cad yid la byed pa'i bya ba la 'jug pa dang / drang bas spyod lam sbas pa dang / khengs pa med pas mnyen pa dang /zhi gnas yongs su tsholamatsho)bas rgod pa dang bral ba dang / blo brtan pas snyom las med pa dang / rab tu mi g.yo bas sems ri dang mtshungs pa dang / rjes su chags pa dang khong khro ba dang bral bas sems sa (midang mtshungs pa dang /bsam pa dag pas sems chu dang mtshungs pa dang / rlom sems med pas sems me dang mtshungs pa dang / gnas med pas sems rlung dang mtshungs pa dang /shin tu dri ma med pas sems nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi tshul na'akhrugs pa med pa'i phyir rab tu 'byung ba la gzhol ba dang / lus dben pa'i phyir dgon pa la dga' ba dang / sems dben pa'i phyir chos la spyod pa dang / de byed cing yang dag par sgrub pa'i phyir tshig bden pa dang /kha 'og tu lus 'khrus par byed pa'i phyir ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed pa dang /nyon mongs pas mi rdzi ba'i phyir sems dpa' ba dang / shin tu nyams pa med pa'i phyir bslab pa yang dag par 'dzin pa dang / kha na ma tho ba phra rab la yang 'jigs par lta ba'i phyir tshul khrims lhod pa med pa dang / skye bar smon pa med pa'i phyir tshul khrims skyon med pa dang / gcig tu dkar po spyod pa'i phyir tshul khrims thun tshags ma yin pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag sbyang ba'im riphyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten pa dang / mig yongs su dag pa'i phyir 'od zer thogs pa med pa dang / rna ba yongs su dag pa'i phyir sgra la thogs pa med pa dang / sna yongs su dag pa'i phyir dri la thogs pa med pa dang / lce yongs 58—25

su dag pa'i phyir ro la thogs pa med pa dang / lus yongs su dag pa'i phyir reg bya la thogs pa med pa dang / yid yongs su dag pa'i phyir chos la thogs pa med pa'ol/ /blo gros rgya mtsho gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ni mi sdug pa shin tu bsgoms pa'i phyir 'dod chags kyi gdung ba dang bral ba yin/ byams pa shin tu bsgoms pa'i phyir zhe sdang gi gdung ba dang bral ba yin/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la shin tu brtags pa'i phyir gti mug gi gdung ba dang bral ba yin/dbang po rnams la shin tu brtags pa'i phyir sgrib pa dang bral ba yin/ stobs tshangs su dag pa'i phyir sgrib pa yang dag par bsal ba yin/ 'byung bar bya ba'i khams yongs su dag pa'i phyir kun nas ldang ba bsal71ba yin/ yang dag par bsgrubs 2pa'i phyir 'dod pa dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang /'jigs pa dang / nga rgyal dang bral ba yin/ chos kyi sbyin pa la ser sna med pa yin / zang zing gi sbyin pa la kun 'dzin pa'i sems med pa yin/ theg pa dman pa la 'dod pa med pa'i phyir byang chub kyi bsam pa yin/ dbang po sbas pa'i phyir nang nye bar zhi ba yin/ skyon shin tu mthong ba'i phyir phyi rol nye bar zhi ba yin/ sdig pa thams cad mi byed pa'i phyir 'khor bas skrag pa yin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sogs 3pas mi ngoms 4pa'i phyir yid yongs su mi skyo ba yin/ chu bo bzhi las bsgral ba'i phyir chos kyi gru chen po yang dag par sbyar sgrub yin/ pha rol du 'gro ba'i phyir stegs dang zam pa shin tu bcas pa yin/ thang la shin tu gnas pa'i phyir 'dam dang 'obs las brgal tshob yin te/ blo gros rgya mtsho de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gi tshe chos 'di lta bu de dag gis dag pa dang / yongs su dag pa dang / sbyin pa 'phags pa dang / tshul 58—26

khrims yongs su dag pa de ni thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa rin po che de sbyong ba'o1 / /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /lus dang ngag rnams dang ni yid bsdams shing / /rnam par dag pa'i las lam bcu la slob/ /byams pas sems can kun la yang dag ltar/ske/ /'di ni thams cad mkhyen paras kyisems sbyong yin/ /snying rje ldan pas gzhan gyi bya bar brtson/ /dga' dang ldan pas chos la pha rol sbyor/ /btang snyoms ldan pas chos mchog 'tshe ba med/ /'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems sbyong yin/ /rtag tu drang zhing g.yo ni rnam par spangs/ /gzhan la phan byed sdig pa rnam par spangs/ /lhag bsam dge ba ci yod rjes su 'jug /'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems sbyong yin/ /shes rab rab 'jug dran dang shes bzhin can/ /sems rab dul bas sems ni las su rung / /sbyangs pa'i yon tan rnams dang gso sla cib/ /'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems sbyong 5yin//'phags rigs 6 chog shes pa dang tshig mnyen dang / /bla ma rnams la rtag tu 'dud byed dang / /rtsod brdzun nga rgyal spangs dang stobs ldan dang / /brnyas 7dang logs pa nam yang byed ma yin/ /sems ni nges sems mngon pa'i nga rgyal bral / /rnyog pa med cing rab tu dang lags la9/ /bdag shes pa la rim gyis 'jug par byed/ /gzhan la mi brnyas 1 sems can rjes su srung 1/ /chos la gus par dga' zhing gus dang bcas/ /bsgrims te nyon mongs rnams ni spong bar byed/ /chos don gnyer zhing chos la rton 2par byed/ /rtag tu chos don gzhol zhing 'bab par byed/ /chos la brtson zhing nyon mongs med pa bsgoms/ /chos min spangs shing chos rnams yongs su tshol ri/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad 58—27

pa mi phyed ldan/ /'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems sbyong yin/ /rtag tu 'dzem dang ldan zhing nyes spyod ldog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun la ngo tshas sdom/ /khrel yod ldan zhing 'dir ni dbang po bsdams/ /'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems sbyong yin/ /rab tu sbyor bas las kyi bya bar 'jug /bag yod pas na mtha' gnyis 'dzin mi byed/ /mkhas pa sten0)pa'i chos rnams rjes rtogs pa/ /'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems sbyong yin/ /spyod lam gyis ni drang ba'i dngos dang ldan/ /khengs pa med pas rtag tu mnyen pa nyid/ /zhi gnas cho ga ldan pas rgod pa medame/ /'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems sbyong yin/ /blo ni rab tu brtan pas nyams pa med/ /lhag mthong la ni ri rgyal ji bzhin te/ /dam bcas brtan zhing bar skabs nyams pa med/ /'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems sbyong yin/ /sdug bsngalam bde bas mi g.yosalas dang mtshungs/ /bsam pa dag pas chu ltar dri ma 'khru/ /rtag tu zlas sems med pas me dang mtshungs / /gnas med rgyu bas rtag tu rlung dang 'dra/ /shin tu dri ma med pas mkha' mnyam sems/ /rab tu byung bas sangs rgyas bstan pa rnyed/ /lus ni dben zhing zhi bas dgon par dga'/ /sems dben pas ni chos kyi mchog la spyod / /dge ba rabaden par smra dang yang dag smra/ /ji skad smras pa de ni de bzhin byed/ /nyon mongs mi rdzi dge la dpa' bo mchog /shin tu bslabasalagayupas bslab pa yang dag 'dzin/ /de la lhod pa〈7)nam yang yod ma yin/ /kha na ma tho chung la'ang rtag tu 'jigs/ /byang chub mchog rgyu'i tshul khrims nyams pa med / /yon tan dkar /spyod tshul khrims 'dres pa med/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten 9cing sdig pa min/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems sogasam bya phyir 58—28

brtan / /de ltar de yi mig ni dri med kyis/ /'jig rten kun la 'od zer mnyam par lta3)/ /rmakhas pa de ni sna tshogs sgra thos nas/ /dga' med rangs pa med cing zhum pa med/ /blo ldan de ni sgra yi don rtogs du shes/ / de yi 47rna ba de ltaratswa)rnam dag nyid/ /sna yis dri dang lce yis ro rnams dang / /lus kyis reg dang yid kyis chos rnams la/ /reg gnas ma khengs ma dud zhum pa med/ /de ltar de yi dbang po dag pa nyid/ /chags pas mi chags snang bas snang ba med / /gti mug ma rmongs mi sdug gnas pa can/ /byams la sridaga' zhing rkyen gyis chos sems pa6)/ /'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems sbyong yin/ /sgrib pa lnga po dag gis bsgribs pa med/ /de ltar des ni dbang po lnga yang bsgoms/ /de ni gang du'ang sgrib med bcings pa'ang med/ /stobs rnams lnga po dag la rab tu gnas/ /kun nas ldang ba shes shing byung ba nyid/ /tshul bzhin ma yin spangs shing tshul bzhin gnas/ /dran pa nye bar gzhagam47)pa bzhi la sten(8)/ /yang dag spong dang rdzu 'phrul rkang par ldan/ /byang chub yan lag sten 5skudang rtag tu ldan/ /brtan pa de ni yan lag brgyad la7 rimachog /de ni 'dod dang snang dang 'jigs mi 'gro/ /gti mug bral zhing dbang po shin tu bsdams/ /chos kyi sbyin la de ni ser sna med/ /slob dpon nam yang chos 'chab mi byed de31 / /zang zing med par chos ni ston par byed/ /des na de ni byang chub sems dag 12'gyur/ /de ni zang zing rnams la kun 'dzin med/ /rnam smin re med 'dod dgu gtong /lhabar byed/ /sbyin dang snyan dang don byed don 'thun pas / /de ni sems can brgya dag rab tu sdud/ / de yi byang chub sems ni brjidama'imi 'gyur/ /theg pa dman la nam yang re ba med/ /ji lta ji ltar 58—29

sangs rgyas yon tan mthong / /de lta de ltar de bsam0)ri rab 'dra/ /nangasnyeni rab zhi srid pa'i nyes pa mthong / /de ni gzhan gyi 'khrul la lta ldenomi byed/ /'dus byas nyes pa dag kyang shin tu mthong / /'khor bas 'jigs pas sdig pa rnams mi byed/ /legs spyod khur khyer bas ni skyo ba med/ /zhing rnams sbyong bar 'dod pa nyams pa med/ /chos rnams yongs su bzung bas zhum pa med/ /sems can thar byed rgyu la 'jigs pa med/ /chu bo bzhi po dag las bsgral ba'i phyir / /de ni chos gru yang dag sbyor bar byed/ /lus can mya ngan 'das lam gzud pa'i 2phyir/ /de ni stegs 5)dang zam nepa 'cha' bar byed/ /'dam las 'das shing 'obs las brgalam rinas ni/ /thang la gnas shing de dag 'jigs med gnas/ /'jigs pas g.yen spyom rnams la 'jigs med ston/ /bdag nyid rgal nas de dag gzhan yang sgrol/ /gang dag chos tshul 'di dag rnam dag cing / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems brtan kha lo sgyur1ri/ /de dag byang chub sems mchog rnam dag ste/ /nyon mongs dri mas gzhar yang gos mi 'gyur / /ji 1 ste nam mkha' nyon mongs bya bar nus/ /de la rjes kyang 11bstan par nus srid kyi/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal rdzogs pa'i byang 12chub sems/ /de ni nam yang nyon mongs byar mi nus/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems rin po che yongs su sbyang ba'i 1 le'u ste dang po'o// //'phags pa blo gos rgya mtshos zhus pa/ bam po gnyis pa/ blo gros rgya mtsho thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa rin po che de'i gnod pa bzod pa ni ji lta bu / thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa rin po che de'i gnod pa ni gang zhe 58—30

na / blo gros rgya mtsho 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed 1)pa rin po che de ltar bskyed nas/ 'phags pa ma yin pa tshul khrims 'chal pa'i sems can rnams sam/ bdud rnams sam/bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams sam/ bdud kyi byin gyis brlabs pa rnams sam/bdud kyi pho nya rnams kyis gtses sam/ rnam par gtses sam/ bskyod dam/kun tu bskyod dam/ dkrugs nasam/ kun tu dkrugs sam/ bsdigs sam/brdegs kyang byang chub tu bsam pa'i sems bskyed pa de las mi phyed pa dang /sems can thams cad rab tu thar bar bya ba'i snying rje chen pos brtson 'grus brtsams pa las mi phyed pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs mi 'chad par bya bar brtson pa las mi phyed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yang dag par bsgrub cisne pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la sbyor ba las mi phyed pa dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po yongs su 'grub par 'gyur ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa las mi phyed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyang ba mngon par sgrub par cabartson pa las mi phyed pa dang / lus dang srog 'dor zhing dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin par mngon par brtson pa las mi phyed pa dang /sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba lamangon par brtson zhing bdag bde ba la mi chags pa las mi phyed pa ste/ de de ltar lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs par gyur pas sems can thams cad kyis dpyas 5kyang bzod/thing ne slad byas pa dang / smad pa dang / bshung bas byas kyang bzod/sems can thams cad kyis spyos sam bsdigs sam ngan du brjod dam/ ngan du smras pa'i tshig gi lam yang bzod/ sems can thams cad kyi gnod pa yang 58—31

bzod / sems can thams cad kyi khur yang bzod/ sgrol bas kyang skyo ba med/zhum pa med/ kun tu zhum pa med/ sgyid lug pa med/ yi chad pa med kyi stobs nye bar ston par byed/ mthu skyed nyu7par byed cing brtson 'grus rtsom la rtul bas rtul bar byed den// spro ba skyed 5cing rmongs pa'i sems mi 'dzin to/ /de spyos kyang slar mi gshe/ brdegs kyang slar mi rdeg /khros kyang slar mi khro/'khrugs kyang slar mi 'khrug ste( / de ltar sems canas5)bgrang ba'i go cha gyon no / /'di lta ste/ theg pa chen po 'di ni 'jig rten thams cad dang mi 'thun pa'i theg pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can de dag ni rgyun gyi rjes su 'gro ba dag go/ /bdag ni rgyun las ldog par rtsol bar 'dod pa'o/ /sems can de dag ni phan tshun mi 'thun pa dag go/ /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi mi 'thun pa spang ba'i phyir go cha bgos pa'o/ /sems can de dag ni gnod sems la dpa' ba dag go/ /bdag ni bzod pa dang / nges 6pa yongs su tshol (3ba'o/ /sems can de dag ni gcig la gcig yongs su 'drid par gnas pa dag go/ /bdag ni shes rab kyis ngoms pa yongs su tshol 3 ba'o/ /gal te sems can de dag phyogs bcu'i rab tu dbye bas rab tu phye 9ba ji snyed pa de dag thams cad ral gri dang / mdung thung dang mda' bo che lag na thogs te/ bdag gi skye bzhin 'brang yang / sa phyogs gang du 'greng ngam 'dug gam 'chag gam nyal yang rung ste/ byang chub kyi sems skye bar 'gyur ba dang / sbyin pa'i sems sam / tshul khrims kyi sems sam/ bzod pa'i sems sam/ brtson 'grus kyi sems sam/ bsam gtan gyi sems sam/ shes rab kyi sems sam thos pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sems skye bar 'gyur 1 ba'i sa phyogs der da bdag 11)lus 58—32

rgya shug gi lo ma'i brgya cha tsam du gtubs sam/ rnam par gtor tamatsho)/ rnam par bcom mamanya/ sems can de dag thams cad las gzhan mi byed par rgyun tu gshe 'am/ bsdigasaspobasam/ smod dam/ bshung ngam/ tshig ngan pa dang ngag rtsub po smra ba de ltar gyur kyang bdag gis sems can 'ga' la yang 'khrug pa'i sems bskyed par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sngon gyi mtha' nas 'khor ba tshad med par byas te/ gang du bdag gis 3)lus 'di sems can dmyal bar song ngam/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ngam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten du song ngam/ mir gyur kyang rung ste 'dod pa'i zas kyi dri mas dri ma can du gyur nas chos thos pa dang mi ldan zhing ya nga ba'i 'tsho ba'i spyod yul don med pas 'tsho ba can du gyur te yan lag dang / nying lag brgyar gshegs shing gtubs te phye zhing55)phral la bya ba rnam pa mang po byas kyang bdag gis gzhi de las bdag gi zhi)don byas kyisam7)gzhan gyi don ma byas pa'i 3cigal te sems can de dag thams cad kyis/ phyi ma'i mthar bdag gis she/lus gshegs 1 gtubs rnam par gtor rnam par bcom pa de lta bur gyur kyang bdag gis thams cad mkhyen pa yongs su mi gtong71ngo / /sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong ngo / /dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa yongs su mi gtong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lus gtubs kyi pa'i lus kyi gnod pa 'di lta bu thams cad ni sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyi / brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro ba nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod do/ /bdag〈nyeni sems can dmyal bar gnas par spro'i( / bdag gisalasangs rgyas kyi chos gtang bar ni mi bya'o/ /sems can thams cad rab tu thar bar bya ba la dmigs pa'i snying rje chen po mi gtong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni bcom 58—33

ldan 'das kyis kyang gsungs te/ dge ba la ni bar chad mang ngo / /mi dge ba'i phyogs la ni grogs byed pa mang ngo / /dge ba'i phyogs la ni grogs byed pa nyung ngo zhes gsungs pas bdag gis mi dge ba'i phyogs kyi grogs mi bya'i dge ba'i phyogs kyi grogs bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la bzod par bya'i gnod sems su mi bya'o/ /sems can de dag la gang yod pa de mar1)byin na yang bdag la gang yod pa de bdag gis sbyin par bya ste/ sems can de dag la gnod sems dang khro ba dang / 'khon nadu 'dzin pa yod pa de dag de rnams kyis ma ( ribyin yang bdag la bzod pa dang des pa gang yod pa de bdag gis sbyin par bya'o / /bdag gis 4)bzod pa'i stobs bstan par bya'i gnod sems ni ma yin no snyam mo/ /blo gros rgya mtsho lus dang srog 'dor ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnyed par rinodaka' ba ma yin no/ /gang gi gzhi las gnod sems 'byung ba'i chos de bdag gis spang bar bya'o snyam mo/ /chos de gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste lus la dga' ba dang /lus la gnas pa dang / lus la chags pa ste/ lus btang ne/na gnod sems kyang gtong ngo / /blo gros rgya mtsho de ltar bgrang ba la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can thams cad kyi gnod pa bzod de mi skyo mi khro'o/ /de gnod pa gsum bzod de/ gsum gang zhe na/ lus kyi gnod pa dang ske/ ngag gi gnod pa dang / sems kyi gnod pa'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de la byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi gnod pa bzod pa gang zhe na/ gang yan lag dang nying lag rnams bcad 7kyang chos nyid la rton te gang de'i lus gcod pa'i sems can de nyid la lta 8ba'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de la thabs la mkhas pa'i byang 58—34

chub sems dpa'i lus gcod pamanya)na pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsgomatshwa /pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /blo gros rgya mtsho ji ltar na thabs la mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus gcod pa na pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsgom 5)pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhe na/ gang lus 'dor ba dang lus yongs su gtong ba dang lus la mi ltalo)ba 'di ni de'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang lus gcod pa na sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par byed pa dang / tshor ba rnams kyis mi 'phrogs (5)pa 'di ni de'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang lus yongs su gcod pa na gang dag de'i lus gcod pa de dag nyid rab tu thar bar bya ba'i phyir bzod cing sems kyi rma mi phyin te/ bzod pa'i stobs nye bar ston pa 'di ni de'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /brtson 'grus gang gis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la 'dun pa mi 'dor zhing sems kyi stobs bskyed pa yang rab tu 'dzin la 'khor ba nyid du mtshams kyang sbyor zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba brtsam pa yang rtsom pa 'di ni de'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang lus rnam par 'thor ba na 6thams cad mkhyen pa'i 7sems bskyed pa rin po che de mi brjid 8cing byang chub nyid la ltam9ba dang / zhi ba dang rab tu zhi ba la so sor rtog pa 'di ni de'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang lus gcod pa na lus la rtswa dang / rtsig pa dang / shing dang / rdo dang / mig yor lta bur 7so sor rtog cing lus la sgyu ma'i chos nyid du 'jug pa dang / yang dag par na 11mi rtag pa nyid dang / yang dag par na 2sdug bsngal ba nyid dang / yang dag par na bdag med pa nyid dang / yang dag par na zhi ba nyid du lus la rtog pa 'di ni de'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de ltar na thabs la 58—35

mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i0)lus gcod pa na/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsgom ri pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhing theg pa chen po de las nyams par mi 'gyur te 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi gnod pa bzod pa'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de la byang chub sems dpa'i ngag gi gnod pa bzod pa gang zhe na/ gang ngan du brjod pa'i tshig thams cad dang du len pa dang / gshe ba dang /bsdigs ṭapa dang / smad pa dang / bshung ba dang / bsdigasam mo byed pa thams cad bzod pa dang / yod pa'am/ med pas glengs ri pas kyang mi khro ba dang ske/ 'khon 'du mi 'dzin pa dang / bag la nyal spong ba'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de la thabs mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ngan du brjod pa dang / ngan du smras pa'i tshig gi lamatsha dang / gshe ba dang bsdigasamar pa dag pha rol las thos nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsgom 9pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /blo gros rgya mtsho ji ltar na thabs la mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ngan du brjod pa dang ngan du smras pa'i tshig gi lam dang 1 ci/ gshe ba dang bsdigs nyi1pa dag pha rol las thos na pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsgom nya pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhe na/ blo gros rgya mtsho 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ngan du brjod pa dang ngan du smras pa'i tshig gi lam dang / gshe ba snyedang bsdigs 1 pa dag pha rol las thos na 14dran pa 'di lta bu rab tu 'thob ste/sems can 'di ni sngon nas ser sna can du gyur pa 'jungs pa ste/ ser sna'i dri mas kun nas kun tu bskor ba des gang dag de'i gnod sems kyi dri ma spang ba'i phyir / chos ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la ma bstenanyis/ gus par ma byas bsnyen bkur ma byas pa'o/ /bdag ni gtong ba la mos shing ser sna med 58wa 36

par bya/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten par bya/ bsnyen par bya/ bsnyen bkur bya'o snyam ste/ de dag bsrung ①zhing gnod sems kyang spong ba 'di ni de'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gzhan yang de zhi'adi snyam du sems te/ sems can 'di ni tshul khrims 'chal pa las ma mthong ba ste/ de ni bdag la gshe zhing bsdigasam pa'o/ /bdag ni tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs yang dag par blangs pa las mi nyams par bya'o/ /gnod sems med par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi sems yongs su bsrung bar bya'o/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa la bsten tshodepar bya'o snyam pa 'di ni de'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gzhan yang de 'di snyam du sems te/ sems can 'di ni zhe sdang gi shas che zhing gnod sems mang ba ste/ de ni bdag la gshe zhing bsdigs gyesapa'o/ /bdag ni bzod pa'i stobs mang du gebyas te/ byams pa la gnas par bya'o snyam pa 'di ni de'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gzhan yang de 'di snyam du sems te/ sems can 'di ni le lo can dge ba'i chos dang bral ba ste de ni bdag la gshe zhing bsdigs ldepa'o / /bdag ni brtson 'grus brtsam par bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su btsal bar brtson pa 9ril mi ngoms par bya ste/ sems can 'di byang chub kyi snying por sngar je 'jug nya par byas la phyis bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o snyam du/ de ltar go cha gyon pa 'di ni de'i 17brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gzhan yang de 'di snyam du sems te/ sems can 'di ni brjid ngas pa/ shes bzhin med pa/nyon mongs pa nges par 12bsams 1 pa ste/ de ni bdag la gshe zhing bsdigs mupa'o / /bdag ni nyon mongs pa nges par bsam tshepar bya/ dran pa dang shes 58—37

bzhin can du bya/ rtse gcig tu byang chub kyi sems mi brjid par bya ste/sems can ma dul 11ba/ ma zhi ba/ ma sbas pa/ nye bar ma zhi ba (3)'di lta bu dag gi don du bdag gis go cha chen po bgos te 'di ltar sems nges par sems su gzhug go/ /snyam pa 'di ni de'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gzhan yang de 'di snyam du sems teri / sems can 'di ni shes rab 'chal pa/bdag tu smra ba/ sems can du lta bar dmigs pa'i spyod yul ba ste de ni bdag la gshe zhing bsdigs la pa'o/ /bdag ni chos nyid la bsten 5par bya'o snyam ste 'di la gshe 6ba dang khro ba su yin zhes des 7yongs su tshol na ba na gang gshe ba dang khro ba'i chos de mi dmigs so/ /de bdag dang gzhan mi dmigs par 9lta ba dang bral bar bzod pa 1 'di ni de'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de ltar na thabs la mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' /stongan du brjod pa dang ngan du smras pa'i tshig gi lam dang / gshe ba dang bsdigs kyi pa dag pha rol las thos nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsgom 1nyepa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhing theg pa chen po de las kyang mi nyams te 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i ngag gi gnod pa bzod pa'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de la byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi gnod pa bzod pa gang zhe na/ gang bdud thams cad kyis byang chub kyi 1 sems de las phral yang mi g.yo ba dang / phas kyi rgol ba dmigs par lta ba la mngon par zhen pa thams cad kyis yang dag pa'i bsam par zhugs pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i 5sems de las mos pa bzlog kyang mi brjed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi gzugs su 'dug kyang mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i sems de las nyams par byed mi nus te bdud rdzu 'phrul rab tu sachen po dag gis khyod kyis 1 theg pa 58—38

chen po yang dag par bsgrub7)par mi nus kyis na khyod kyis gces par bya ba 'di thong shig( /khyod54)kyis brtson 'grus 'di pa'or cig /byang chub ni rnyed par dka' ba/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni rnyed par dka' ba ste 'dir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mang du myong bar (6zhi'agyur ro/ /gang dag mya ngan las 'das pa de dag ni bde ba yin gyis 77skyes bu dam pa khyod myur du mya ngan las 'das par gyis shig ces de'i 8sems skul zhing sems dran par byed la/ blo gros rgya mtsho gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la de ltar bral bar byed de ltar mos pa zlog 9par byed kyang sngon gyi go cha mi 'dor zhing bsam pa rnam par 'khrugs 1 par mi byed kyi de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis nges par byang chub kyi snying po mnan 1 par bya/ bdag gis nges par bdud dpung dang bcas par 'pham 12par byas te bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya/ bdag gis nges par 1 chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar bya/ bdag gis nges par stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su chos kyi gtam chen po brjod par bya/ bdag gis sems can thams cad mgron du gnyer la chos kyi sbyin pas tshim par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / bdag dang gzhan gyi sems rig pa'i lha rnams kyis byang chub tu bsam pa rig gis15/ bdag gis thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems kyi gnod pa bzod par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang lha rnams dang sems can thams cad dang bdag la bslu tshobar mi bya'o snyam pa 'di lta bu ni/blo gros rgya mtsho byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi gnod pa bzod cing / theg pa chen po de las mi phyed pa ste/ blo gros rgya mtsho 'di ni thams cad mkhyen par 58—39

sems bskyed pa rin po che de'i gnod pa bzod pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha gang yin pa dang7/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gong na med pa gang yin pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byed pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi gnod pa bzod pa'o/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /byang chub lam las bsam pa mi phyed cing / /de ni snying rje las kyang phyed ma yin/ /bdag gis dkon mchog gsum po bsrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams yang dag bsgrub par bya/ /sum cum rtsa gnyis khyad 'phags mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pa/ /gang dag gis ni stobs bcu rnams kyis lus mdzes pa/ /de dag yongs su btsal phyir mchod sbyin bye ba byed/ /gnod pa shin tu rnam mang bzod cing yon tan phyug /brgya phrag mtha' yas zhing rnams de dag bdag gis sbyang 4/ /rin chen chos mchog 'di dag bdag gis bsrung bar bya/ /brgya phrag mtha' yas sems can de dag bdag gis dgrol/ /des nalo)gnod pa bzod cing bsam pa mi phyed do/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can khams ni mtha' yas ji snyed pa/ /thams cad 'dus par gyur nas lag na mtshon thogs te/ /de dag de la 'jigs sbyin gshe zhing bsdigs 'byed kyang / /yon tan phyir ni bsdigs7)dang 'phya ba bzod par byed/ /sngon mtha'i bskal pa brgya phrag mtha' yas ji snyed par/ /de dag rgyun mi 'chad par tshig rtsub smras kyang ni/ /bdag nyid chen po de bzod mi khro gshe ba med/ /de ltar rtogs pa rnams ni gnod pa dag par 'gyur/ /sems can de dag lag nan mtshon thogs lhan cig tu/ /bdag gi /lus kyi yan lag dum bu dum bur gtubs/ /'on kyang bdag gi7 )sems 58—40

yid khro bar mi bya ste/ /byang chub yid la byas0)na gnod 'di dag par 'gyur/ /'greng ngam 'dug gam 'chag gam 'on te nyal yang rung / /gang du byang chub sems mchog 'di dag ②sbyin pa dang / /dula'akhyaba'i sems dang gzhan yang dkar sems mi 'dor ba/ /der ni de'i lus dum bu dum bur rnam par 'thor//sems dmyal dud 'gro'i skye gnas yi dgas ④'jig rten mira'abye/ /bskal pa brgya phrag mtha' yas don med lus kyang gtubs/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mngon par 'dod pas lus 'dor zhes/ /skyes bu des ni yid kyang yang dag tshim par byed/ / mi yi5zhesdug bsngal rgyu geni rnam pa du ma dag /mtshams med sdug bsngal brgya charal nye bar mi 'gro ba'i/ /dmyal ba rnams su bskal pa brgyar ni gnas par spro/ /rgyal ba dang ni chos dang sems can mi gtong ngo / /bdag lus mi rtag ring du mi thub sgyu ma 'dra/ /khams bzhi de dag gdug pa'i sbrul dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /bdag gis lus bor59)byas te dug med 'gyur bar bya/ /nyon mongs dug7zhi nas ni rang byung sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /srid rgesum 'jig rten 'di ni01lus bde 'gyuratshwa ba'i gzhi/ /'dod pa'i zas rgyu cung zad ji snyed 'jigs pa ste/ /bdag gis lus btang 'jigs pa med par 'gyur bar bya /bgrang ba 'di la zhugs pa de dag gnod pa bzod/ /nag po'i phyogs la grogs ni brgya stong phrag kyang mangs snye/ / dkar po'i〈 raphyogs ni gang la'ang grogs po gcig pur 'gyur/ /bdag ni mi dge rnams dang rtsod par mi bya ste/ /sangs rgyas bzod pa gsungs pas tshabazod pa bdag gis grogs/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de dag 'dir ni bdag gi dpang / /ji ltar sangs rgyas sku la sems ni mi phyed de0 / /sangs rgyas dang ni bdag nyid che lha bdag gi grogs/ /58—41

gnod pa bzod par bya yi sdang bar mi bya'o/ /gnod pa lus dang 1ngag yid rnam pa gsum du gsungs/ /gang bzod dpa' bo nade ni mi 5phyed bzod pa yin / /lus kyi sdug bsngal rnam pa mtha' yas yod pa dag /gal te lus la bzod pa lus gnod dag par 'gyur/ /lus ni dum bu dum bur gtubs te rnam gtor tshe/ /thabs ldan che ba'i bdag nyid pha rol phyin rdzogs 'gyur/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan dang / /shes rab khyad 'phags dam pa skad cig tsam gyis 'dzin/ /lus dang lus la sred pa'i nyon mongs rnams kyang 'dor/ /sbyin dang rab tu ldan (5pa'i pha rol phyin par 'gyur / /byams pas 'jig rten khyab byed tshul khrims nyams mi 'gyur/ /byang chub rjes su 'gro bas tshul khrims dag pa 'dzin/ /bzod pa'i stobs bskyed ri 6)yan lag rnams dang nying lag gcod/ /de yang de yi 7ribazod pa'i pha rol phyin la sbyor/ /brtson 'grus gces pa ma zhum bar skabs sgyid lug med/ /lus ni rnam par 'thor zhing brtson 'grus pha rol 'gro/ /byang chub sems kyi bsam pa dran pa mi 'dor zhing / /nyon mongs mun pa'i na rdul rnams bsal phyir rab tu brtsonate/ /lus bshig nas ni bsam gtan stobs 9dang rnam thar 'thob/ /'dir yang rdul bral bsam gtan pha rol phyin la sbyor/ /bdag gi 1 lus ni bdag med rmi lam glog 11dang 'dra/ /'di la byed pa po med tshor ba po yang med / /lus kyi gzings pas bcings pa'i sems can bdag gis dgrol/ /shes rab 'di ni khyad 'phags pha rol phyin pa mchog /gang zhig 'di la sbyor zhing tshul bzhin chos sems la/ /lus kyi gnod pa bzod cing rab sdang mi byed deb/ /mi snyan pa dang smad dang bshung 5ba'i tshig thos kyang / /de ni zhe sdang mi 58wa 42

'gyur byams ldan sems kyang dul/ /tha ba rab tu zhe sdang bor 'di sbyin pa dag/byams pa'i yid du gyur pa 'di ni tshul khrims dag1 /bzod pa'i stobs bskyed 'di ni bzod pa dag pa yin/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'dod nas brtson 'grus phyir zhing skyed95ci/ /sems dang yid rab zhi ba 'di ni bsam gtan dag /sgra skad mi rnyed 'di ni shes rab dag pa yin/ / mi yi /tshig thos nas ni gang chos 'di sems pa/ /de 'dir gnod bzod dag gi skyon la chags pa med/ /bdud dang mu stegs can gyi lta gyur brgya stong gis/ /gnas 'di rnyed dkas 4sbyor ba 'ongs5)brjod kyang / /mi skrag zhum pa med cing phyi phyir mthu bskyed de/ /mkhas pa des6)ni gnod dang sems gnod mtha' yas bzod/ /gang zhig bzod dang brtson 'grus 57)rab gnas ri rab 'dra/ /sems can kun nang dpa' bo de 'dir gnod pa bzod/ /stobs bcu rnams kyi sbyang ba dang ni gnod shes nas/ /byang chub rjes su 'gro bas phyi nas lung ston ton/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de 9la thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa rin po che de'i 'bigs pa gang zhe na/ blo gros rgya mtsho 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa rin po che des rlom sems su mi byed de/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems de la brten par mi byed gnas par mi byed/ len 1 par mi byed / 'dor bar mi byed/ spros par mi byed/ rtog par mi byed/ rnam par rtog par mi byed kyi rnam par rtog par 11nye bar zhi ba la gnas pa yin te/ de chos zab mo rnams la blos rnam par dpyod do/ /chos zab mo de dag gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i lugs su 'byung ba dang / rgyu la dmigs pa khong du chud pa dang / rtag pa ma yin pa dang / chad pa ma yin pa 58wa 43

dang ske/ mthar lta ba dang bral ba dang / rang bzhin gyis bdag med pa dang /bdag ngo bo nyid med pas chos thams cad/ ngo bo nyid med pa dang / gdod ma nas ma skyes pa dang / ma byung ba dang / stong pa nyid la mos pa dang /mtshan ma med pa la yid ches pa dang / smon pa med pa la som nyi med pa dang /mngon par 'du byed pa med pa la de kho na'i blo dang ldan pa dang / shin tu mi rtas pa nyid dang / gzugs dbu tshob dang mtshungs pa nyid dang / tshor ba chu bur dang 'dra ba nyid dang / 'du shes smig rgyu dang mtshungs pa ste chosaganyis su med pa nyid dang / 'du byed rnams la chu shing dang mtshungs par so sor rtog pa dang ske/ rnam par shes pa sgyu ma lta bu'i chos nyid dang / khams rnams g.yo ba med pa nyid dang / skye mched rnams phan kyitshun du shes pa med pa nyid dang /sems gnas pa med pa dang / nga rgyal yid la mi byed pa dang / lhag par byed pa lhag par mi byed pa dang / mnyam pa nyid la ri )mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa dang ske/ tha dad du bya ba med pa dang / ro gcig pa dang / bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam la rab tu gnas pa dang / lam gyi tshogs shes pa yongs su tsholamarab dang ske/ nges pa'i don gyi don la rton pa dang / don gyi rjes su zhugs pa'i blo snyedang ske/ skad thams cad la skad med par 'jug pa dang / sgra thams cad la sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' yongs su chad par shes pa dang / don dang tshig 'bru gnyis su med pa la 'jug pa shes pas don brjod du med par rtogs pa dang glu/ sdug bsngal shes pa ngar 'dzin pa med pa dang / kun 'byung ba shes pa de shin tu zad pa dang / 'gog pa shes pa sgro btags pa med pa dang / lam shes pa 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas mnyam pa 67nyid du 'jug pa dang /58wa 44

lus la zhugs pa'i dran pa sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mthar 'pho ba med pa dang ske/ tshor ba la zhugs pa'i dran pa skye ba dang 'jig par mi 1gnas pa dang /sems la zhugs pa'i dran pa dmigs pa la shin tu brtags pa dang / chos la zhugs pa'i dran pa chos kyi dbyings la ma yin pa dang / yang dag par spong ba mnyam pas mnyam pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa sems la dbang sgyur 5bar gyur pa dang / dad pa'i dbang po chags pa thams cad las shin tu 'das pa dang ske/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dben pas nges par byung ba dang / dran pa'i dbang po dran pa med pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po yid la byed pa med pa dang / shes rab kyi dbang po 5/spros pa las shin tu 'das pa dang / dad pa'im /stobs gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi stobs dmigs pa rtogs pa med pa dang / dran pa'i stobs nyams pa med pa dang ldan pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs nges par sems par gyur pa dang / shes rab kyi stobs mi 'khrugs pa'i rgyu 'thun pa dang / dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dran pa med cing brjed pa med pa dang / chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du 'jug pa dang /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag len pa med cing 'dor ba med pa dang ske/ dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dba' 5rlabs med pa dang /rab tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag lus dang sems la zhugs pa dang ske/ ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag mnyam pa nyid khong du chud pa dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gnyis dang bral ba dang /yang dag pa'i lta ba lta ba thams cad spong ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtog pa rtog 58—45

pa dang rnam par rtog pa dang / yongs su rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba dang /yang dag pa'i ngag sgra skad thams cad mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' lus dang / sems kyi las dang bral ba dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho 1ba tshol ba thams cad rgyun bcad pa dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba 'deg pa med cing 'jog pa med pa dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dge ba dang mi dge ba'i rnam par rig pa la mi 'jug pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting ninge 'dzin sems kyi dmigs pa mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa dang / zhi ba zhi gnas kyi mthar song ba dang / lhag mthong lta ba rnam par dag pa dang / skye ba med pa'i don mi rtag pa'i don dang / gdod ma nas skye ba med pa'i don sdug bsngal gyi don dang / rgyu ba med pa'i don bdag med pa'i don dang / nye bar zhi ba'i don zhi ba'i don dang / dul bas sbyin pa dang / bsil ba'i dngos por gyur pa'i tshul khrims dang / zad pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i bzod pa dang / shin tu rnam par phye bas rnam par 'byed pa'i brtson 'grus dang / nad nye bar zhi ba'i bsam btan dang / yang dag pa daji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes pa'i mtshan nyid kyi shes rab dang / sems can gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa'i byams pa dang ske/ nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i snying rje dang / dga' ba med pa'i dga' ba dang / rtsod pa thams cad rgyun bcad pa'i btang snyoms dang / chos thams/ cad 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' nas stong pa dang ske/ phyi ma'i mthar dben pa dang / da ltar byung ba na bdag med pa'o /blo gros rgya mtsho de ltar gang chos zab mo rgyun chad pa tshig 'bru dang bral ba nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/ 'di lta bu 'di dag rtogs pa dang khong du chud pa dang 58—46

'jug pa shes pa la dpyod pa dang / sems pa dang 'jal ba dang bgrang ba dang /nye bar rtog pa dang nan tan byed pa 'di ni thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa rin po che de 'bigs pa'o/ /de ltar thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa rin po che de phigs 1na/ chos thams cad la dbang sgyur 2ba nyid lhun gyis grub pa nyid du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /blo gros rgya mtsho 'di lta ste dper na/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i gzhal med khang lhun gyis grub par rnam par rgyu zhing 'dzam bu'i cagling thams cad du/ snang bar byed kyang lha'i bu nyi ma dang zla ba 'di ci snyam du bdag cag 'gro'am 'on te ldog 6snyam du mi 7sems par sems can rnams kyi bsod nams 8kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pas de dag 'gro'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de bzhin du rab tu phigs pa'i shes pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa 'a sems dpa' chen po yang lhun gyis grub par sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa dag na sems can gyi don byed kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems/ ngapa' chen po de ni yang mngon par 'du byed pa med par bya ba de dag kun tu ston to/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de la byang chub sems dpa'i 'bigs pa shes pa gang yin pa de ni/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par yongs su btsal bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' mnyam par bzhag 9na lhag mthong gi 1 chos rnams mthong gi mnyam par ma bzhag rta pas ni ma yin no/ /de'i mthong ba gang yin pa de ni shes rab ste/ shes rab des ma ngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /gang mngon sum du 'gyur zhe na/ chos rnams kyi yang nga/ ga pa'i mtshan nyid la mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /chos rnams kyi yang dag nga/'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ mtshan nyid kyi rigazhi de la kun tu mi spyod pa'o/ /chos 58—47

rnams kyi mtshan nyid kyi gzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste rnam par rig pa ni chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid kyi gzhi'o/ /rnam par rig pa de'i yang dag pa ji lta ba'i mtshan nyid gang yin pa de nyid ni chos rnams kyi yang dag pa'i mtshan nyid ces bya'o / /gang gi tshe 1tshor ba thams cad rgyun bcad par gyur pa de'i tshe snang bar yang mi byed/ mi snang bar 2mi byed do/ /de la snang ba ni gang / mi snang ba ni gang zhe na/ snang ba zhes bya ba ni skye ba'o/ /mi snang ba zhes bya ba ni 'gag pa'o / /gang gi tshe snang bar yang mi byed mi snang bar yang mi byed pa de'i tshe/skye bar yang mi byed 'gag par yang mi byed do/ /gang gi tshe skye bar yang (5)mi byed 'gag par yang mi byed pa de'i tshe chos nyid la gnas pa yin te chos kyi dbyings 'khrugs lapar mi byed/ de bzhin nyid las mi g.yo/ yang dag pa'i mtha' 'jig par mi byed do/ /de la chos kyi dbyings zhes bya ba ni brten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rjes su rtogs pa'o/ /de bzhin nyid ni de kho na'i mtshan nyid khong du chud pa'o/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' ni gnyis su med pa'i yang dag par mngon par rtogs pa'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de ltar mngon sum du shes pa rig pa'i 6byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni 7shin tu phigs pa shes pa zhes bya'o/ / sbyang brtsonadang gnod pa dang nges par 'bigs she pa'i le'u 'di/bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa'i tshe/ lha dang mi'i skye dgu'itsha srog chags khrag khrig phrag 11bcu gnyis kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /srog chags khri drug stong gis bzod pa rab tu thob par gyur to'i/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /chos kun nges par rtogs pa yi/ /byang chub sems ni sgrogs 1258wa 48

par byed/ /de tshe des rtogs ye shes kyis/ /chos rnams kun la chags pa med//zab mo'i chos rnams khong du chud/ /mkhas pa skrag par 'gyur ba med/ /skrag med kun tu 'jigs med pas/ /khyad par 'phags par 'gyur ba yin/ /rgyu la dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /brten pa'i chos rnams khong du chud/ /shes rab ldan de rjes 'thun byed/ /mtha' 11lta ba ni mi 'dzin to/ /rtag pa dang ni chad pa la/ /blo ni thogs pa yod ma yin/ /yang dag mtha' ni bsam yas pa'i / /dbu ma'i mtha' ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /bdag gis namatha' yi rang bzhin gyis/ /chos rnams bdag med ngo bo nyid/ /chos kun de yi /rang bzhin te/ /gdod nas ma skyes 'gag pa med/ /skyes pa med cing 'byung ba med / /stong pa gzung med dri ma med/ /mtshan ma med cing spros pa med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mtshungs shing 'dra/ /de dag sems kyis mi smon par/ /'dod cing chags pa rnam par spangs/ /gzugs kyi rang bzhin mngon sum du/ /dbum ba lta bur rab tu shes/ /tshor ba chu 5)bur 'dra ba ste/ /'du shes smig rgyu'i mtshan nyid do/ /'du byed chu shing snying po 'dra/ /rnam par shes pa sgyu ma 'dra / /khams bzhi g.yo ba med pa ste/ /nam mkha' snyomatshungs pa'i khams yin rnal/ /gangs7)dag skye mched thams cad ni/ /bems 8po phan tshun spyod yul lo/ /sems ni nang na ma yin te/ /phyi rol du yang mi dmigs so/ /yid la nga yi yod ma yin/ /rnam paras9shes pa gnas pa med/ /chos rnams yid la mi byed de / /lhag par byed pa rnam par spong / /chos rnams thams cad mnyam nyid du//yang dag nyid du khong du chud/ /tha dad med cing ro gcig ste/ /gcig pu bgrod lam mnyam pa nyid/ /lam gyi shes pa rab tu rtogs/ /nges pa'i don gyi 58—49

don rnams mthong / /blo ni don gyi rjes su zhugs/ /skad ni skad med khong du chud / /sgra rnams kun la sngon mtha' dang / /phyi ma'i mtha' 1mar yongs su gcod / /don dang tshig 'bru rnam/sa nal mkhas/ /chos rnams gnyis su med par rtogs/ /brjod du med pa'i don la ni/ /'di nyid 3yang dag khong du chud / /skye ba med par sdug bsngal shes/ /kun 'byung ba la mnyam pa'i blo/ /'gog pa shes pa zad par bstan/ /lam shes pa ni 'dus ma byas/ /lus dang tshor ba sems dang ni/ /chos la chos su rjes su rtogs/ /dran med yid la byed me /da pa'i/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag capa ston/ /chos kyi dbyings ni dbyings min par / /yang dag nyid ni mnyam pas mnyam/ /spong bas spang du med pa ni/ /yang dag spong bar rab tu bstan/ /sems la dbang ni thob pa yi/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rab tu bstan/ /chags pa kun las rab 'angs pa/ /de ni dad pa'i dbang po yin/ /chos rnams thams cad rnam dben pa/ /de ni brtson 'grus dbang po yin/ /dran pa med cing dran 'jug pa/ /de ni dran pa'i dbang po yinam/ /chos rnams yid la mi byed pa/ /de ni /ting 'dzin dbang po yin/ /spros las shin tu rab 'das pa/ /de ni shes rab dbang po yin/ /yang dag nyid ni rtogs nas de/ /gzhan gyi dad pas 'gro ma yin/ /sems ni g.yo ba yod min pa/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'di 6'dra'o/ /yang dag shes las nyams pa med / /dran pa'i stobs ni 'di 'dra'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs mdzod ni/ /des par sems la dga' ba yin/ /mi rtog rnam par mi rtog pa/ /shes rab stobs ni 'di 'dra'o/ /chos rnams rtogs pa'i don du ni/ /byang chub yan lag rab tu bstan/ /mnyam ste mi mnyam med pa'i chos/ /yang dag lta ba yin 58—50
