dpa' rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rab tu 'joms pa de tsho1ni byang chub sems dpa'i gtam 'ba' zhig yang dag par rab tu ston te/ de na theg pa gzhan gyi ming yang med do/ /btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu bde ba thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de ni de 'dra ste/der 'phangs na phyis bdud kyi las byed par mi 'gyur gyi/ bdud las btul ba'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang lhan cig tu byang chub tu sems bskyed nas / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bdud sdig can dngangs skrag 'jigs te/ spu zing 52zhes byed nas/'khor de nas 'gro bar 'dod na 'gro ma nus te mi snang bar ma gyur na / de de bas 4kyang cher dngangs shing skrag ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo 45༄gros rgya mtshos 'jig rten gyi khams der 'phang bar mi 'gyur bar bcom ldan 'das bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag la bskyab tu gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sdig can ma 'jigs shig /skyes bu dam pa 'di lta bu 'di dag ni sems can la rnam par 'tshe ba'i phyir gnas pa ma yin no/ /sdig can khyod byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho 'di la bzod pa gsol cig dang / 'di nyid khyod la skyob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis thal mo sbyar te/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal (6nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod bdag la bzod pa mdzad du gsol / bdag bde ba thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams der mi 'phang bar gsol/ ji ltar gang na skyes bu dam pa khyod lta bu chos ston par gyur 58—248

pa'i 'khor der bar chad bgyi ba'i slad du lan 'ga' yang mchi bar mi 'gyur ba de ltar bgyi'o/ /blo gros rgya mtshos smras pa/ sdig can kho bo lta bu dag la bzod pa gsol mi dgos so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sems can thams cad la shin tu bzod pa nyid do/ /sdig can khyod bde ba thams ri1cad kyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams der song la/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bkod pa de dag rinyadang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rab tu 'joms pa de la ltos shig dang khyod la 'tshe bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos lag pa g.yas pa gser gyi kha dog can brkyang danas/bdud sdig can gyi spyi bor bzhag nas/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la chos kyi ser sna dang / slob dpon chos kyi dpe mkhyud med pa'i bden pa ri skudang bden pa'i tshig des bdag gis 55)rdzu 'phrul 56gyi rkang pa ci 'dra bar (7bdud sdig can gyi yang de dang na'adra bar gyur cig ces de lta bu'i bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs smyo byas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos tshig de skad ces smras ma thag tu/ de nas bdud sdig can rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs mchog dang ldan par gyur te/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos par byas nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas mi snang bar gyur te/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho'i byin gyi rlabs 1 kyis skad cig thang cig 11yud tsam de la bde ba thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams der gnas par gyur to/ /de nas bdud sdig can bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdud rab tu 'joms pa ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/58—249

bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal (1)te lan bdun bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rab tu 'joms pa de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nasabadud las btul ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gang dag 'khod pa de dag gis bdud sdig can de mthong nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rab tu 'joms pa de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can dbang chung zhing ②mdog ngan la mi sdug pa 'di lta bu 'di gegang nas mchis/ bcom ldan 'das des bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu nub phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas gang gā'i klung (ltebacu gnyis kyi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba yod do/ /de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//'tsho'o gzhes so/ /de 'dus pa chen po'i le'u ni yichos kyi rnam 9)grangs rgya cher ston to/ /yang dag par rab tu 'chad do/ /der phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' tshad med grangs med cing bgrang ba las shin tu 'das pa dag /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mnyan pa'i phyir 'dus so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor der byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtsho zhes bya ba go cha bsam gyis mi khyab pa bgos 98pa/ bcom ldan 'das de la yongs su 'dri zhing yongs su 'drir 'jug pa yang 'dus par gyur to/ /chos kyi rnam grangs de'i tha ma bshad pa'i tshe bdud sdig can mig gis (94mi rtsol bar bya ba'i las kyirwa )phyir 'ongs pa dang / skyes bu dam pa des 'dul ba'i dbang nye bar bzung ste/bdud sdig can de 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir 'phangs so/ /de nas bdud las 58—250

btul ba'ishebyang chub sems dpa' de dag gis bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kho bo cag kyang khyod kyi grogs yin gyisal/ sdig can khyodamos)bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyed 'a)cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/kho bo cag kyang bdud du gyur te/ sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i (5)bar chad bya ba'i phyir (7zhugs pa las/ kho bo cag de bzhin gshegs pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de lta bas na sdig can khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyed (7)cig /de nas bdud sdig can gyis lhag pa'i bsam pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i〈shebyang chub tu sems bskyed nas tshig 'di skad ces bdag gis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de phyin chad bdud kyi las mi bya'o zhes smras so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de yonodag gis bdud sdig can rin po che bkod pa'i seng ge'i khri la bzhag ste3 )/ de na 'dus pa chen po'i le'u'i chos kyi rnam nyu1grangs kyi gtam rgyud ci 'dra ba la rigs kyi bu khyod spobs par gyis shig ces gsol ba btab bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos gang bdud sdig can seng ge'i khri la 'dug pa'i kha'i sgo dang / ba spu'i khung thams cad nas ji ltar bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas 'dus pa chen po'i le'u rab tu bshad pa lta bu'i gtam byung ste/ yi ge /2de dag dang ske/ tshig dang / yi ge'i 'bru de dag dang mnyam zhing mi nyung mi mang ma lhag par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i byin gyi rlabs sna byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis bdud sdig can de las 'dus pa chen po'i le'u'i gtam thos nas / ngo mtshar du gyur te bcom ldan 'das de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /58—251

bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed de dang (1)/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de dang / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho de dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag blta bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rab tu 'joms pas mdzod spu nas/ gzugs thams cad ston rme zhes bya ba'i 'od zer phyung ste/ 'od zer phyung nab des sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung bcu gnyis kyi bye ma snyed de dag las 'das te 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /der byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa rin po che bkod pa'i 'khor gyi khyams na bskal pa brgyar yang bsngags pa'i mthar mi phyin pa'i seng ge'i khri chen po la bzhugs te/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'dus pa chen po'i le'u'i chos kyi rnam cagrangs rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho yang mthong ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed chus yongs su gang ba'i rgya mtsho gcig lta bur gnas pa 'di yang mthong ngo / /de nas sgrib pa ci yang med par mthong ngo / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rgyang grags kyi tshad tsam gyi rin po che'i pad ma dag la 'khod cing chos nyan pa de dag kyang mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshim zhing mgu la yi skurangs shing rab tu dga' ste/ dga' ba dang /yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa ga la ba de 6logs su me tog gtor to/ /gtor ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'ongs 58—252

nas / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i spyi gtsug gi mtshams su me tog gi gdugs chen por gyur to/ /der thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des me tog gi gdugs de mthong nas ngo mtshar du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang me tog gi gdugs 'di lta bur gyur pa'i me tog 'di dag gang nas mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/grogs po dag me tog 'di dag ni bde ba thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de nas 'ongs te/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis nga 1la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir gtor to/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis bde ba thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rab tu 'joms pa de dang / bdud sdig can 'jig rten gyi khams me/de na ci bgyid pa blta bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor des gsol ba btab pa mkhyen nas/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bde ba thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rab tu 'joms pa de dang / bdud sdig can de 'khor 'di la ston cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs phye bas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos sor mo bcu las 'od zer stong phrag bcu 5phyung nas/ 'od zer de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung bcu gnyis kyi bye ma snyed po de dag las 'das nas bde ba thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams snang ba chen pos 4)khyab par gyur to/ /der thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang 5/bde ba thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dang / bcom ldan 58—253

'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rab tu 'joms pa de dang / bdud sdig can chos kyi khri chen po la 'dug ste 'dus pa chen po'i le'u'i gtam rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa yang mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de ngo mtshar du gyur nas rang rang gi pad ma'i stan las langs te/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rab tu 'joms pa de la phyag 'tshal 11nas/ de dag gis mu tig dang / me tog gis gtor to/ /gtor ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'ongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyi gtsug gi mtshams su me tog gi khang pa brtsegs pa chen por gnas par kun tu snang ngo / /de nas bdud sdig can gyisamatshon/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rab tu 'joms pa de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag mi mjed dkyi 'jig rten gyi khams su bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i gan du mchi'o / /bcom ldan 'das des bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de'i dus la dbab par shes na khyod song shig /de nas bdud sdig can gyis bcom ldan 'das de'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal bte lan bdun bskor ba byas nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho'i byin gyi rlabs nedang / rdzu 'phrul gyis skad cig thang cigs0)yud tsam de la mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir gnas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 8te/ lan bdun bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal 9te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po khyod kyis 'jig rten gyi 58—254

khams bde ba thams cad kyis brgyan pa de mthong ngam/ smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu bdag gis 'jig rten gyi khams ji tsam du yongs su dag pa de mthong ste/ ji ltar dag cing dri ma med pa'i sems can mchog byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gnas de ngo mtshar to/ /bdag gis de mthong nas kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /smras pa/grogs po khyod kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bosems bskyed nas17// khyod kyangatshwa bdud kyi las lta byed dam/ smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu lhag pa'i bsam pa la yang dag par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gang gis kyang bdud kyis /las byed mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/lhag pa'i bsam pa la yang dag par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams las ji lta ji ltar bdud kyi las byed pa de lta de ltar/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ches stobs dang ldan zhing brtson 'grus rtsom55)mo/ /btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu khyod kyis 'u)rnam grangs 'dis kyang gang dgas47)byang chub mchos sems dpa' rnams la bdud kyi las byed pa de nyid/ sangs rgyas kyi phrinas9rilas su brjod kyi bdud kyi las ni ma yin pa de ltar rig par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu bstan pa dang ske/ bdud kyi cho 'phrul bstan pa 'di bshad pa na 'khor de las srog chags nyi 7khris bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /bdud kyi 'khor de las kyang bdud kyi bu khris 11bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas mgrin gcig tu bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba thams cad kyis brgyan 12pa der skye bar gyur cig ces tshig de (/geskad ces smras pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang de dag 58wa 255

sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar lung bstan to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun du bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams (1)kyi byang chub 'di ni bar chad mang ba phyir rgol ba mang ba lags na/ gang 'di lta bu'i mdo sde 'di dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs tsho kyikyis nub par mi 'gyur zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / gang dag 'dzin pa dang klog pa dang / ston 5pa de dag la yang bdud dam bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ba dang / dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas pa dang mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di dag kyang kun tu bsrung ba dang sba ba dang / yongs su gzung ba'i slad du/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas legs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /blo gros rgya mtsho sems can gang dag mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di dag 'dzin pa dang / ston par 'gyur zhing 'dod pa brtson 'grus brtsams pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa de dag 'dul ba'i dbang nye bar gzungs ste chos kyi rnam grangs 'di byin gyis brlabs zin to/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung 5shig dang / tshig gang dag gis rgyal po chen po bzhi dag bkug nas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di kun tu bsrung ba dang / chos smra ba de dag kyang yongs su gzung 6ba'i phyir nan tan byed par 'gyur ba'i rgyal po chen po bzhi dgug pa'i tshig rnams brjod par bya'o/ /58—256

blo gros rgya mtsho dgug pa'i tshig de dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sa 3)me sa ma gu san dhi/ sa ra deni/ sa ra pa ti/ dha ne/ dham3)na ba ti/ dhu dhu me/ dhu dhu ma ti/ ā (5)brte/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ bi ra dzo ri/ ka ka re/ kās ru ṇi / hu hu/ hu hu ba ting ri/ hu hu san dhi(9)/ nir+gha ta ni/ a bar+bhe/ bī bar+bhe / ma dhu ma ti ma ra dzi0 )te/ bi shurnye/ bi shudha 11ba ti/ mi si le12 ma no ra nyi ha re/ blo gros rgya mtsho 'di dag ni dgug pa'i tshig rnams yin te/tshig de dag gis rgyal po chen po bzhi bkug nas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di kun tu bsrung ba dang / chos smra ba de yang yongs su gzung 1 tshoba'i phyir tshanan tan byed par 'gyur ro/ /sngags kyi tshig 'di rnams chos smra ba des legs par kha don sadu byas te/ phyogs bzhir byams pas khyab par byas la rgyal po chen po bzhi bsams nyi na/ sngags kyi tshig 1 'di dag gis rgyal po chen po bzhi bkug nas 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa de dag stan las langs 19te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to//bcom ldan 'das rgyal po chen po bzhi po bdag cag lhan cig tu 'thun par gang na yang dag pa dang ldan 2 nopa'i rgyud kyis chos kyi rnam 21grangs 'di 'chad par 'gyur ba der/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang kun tu srung dgeb dang chos smra ba de yang yongs su gzung ba dang / ci nas gang gis kyang ma 2gebasgribs pa'am gnod par bgyid par mi 'gyur bar bgyi ba'i slad du mchi bar bgyi'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho gzhan yang lha'i dbang po brgya byin dgug pa'i tshig brjod par bya ste/ tshig de dag gis lha'i dbang po brgya byin dgug 2 par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po 58—257

brgya byin dgug )par 'gyur ba'i tshig de dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dza yeX/dza ya ma ti/ ar+bhe mar+bhe ri mor riku re/ sid+dha ma ti/ shu bho rishārnyi 6)ka 3)re/ na da ne/ rādhe/ dān+ta 8)ma )9)/ taṅka re/ k+ṣa na1 ri/ k+ṣa yas /nyamu khe/ a bskyo ni bi bsna ni pa ri bas ni/ pa ri ts+tsha de/ smṛ ti smṛ nyi ti sarnyi/ge/ ā ga 3 lits+tsha kau shi ka /nirdzi tā/ a su ra/ dza yarnyi de ba/ sa ma ya ste/ a ra ba dho/dharma genirdzi to/ /ra ma hi/ swā sti tshaya nā ma bhu tā nyu 74/ a rak+ṣa dharma tsā ri tsār+shanye/blo gros rgya mtsho 'di dag ni lha'i dbang po brgya /tshebyin dgug pa'i tshig ste de dag gis 2 )lha'i dbang po brgya byin dgug 21par 'gyur ro/ /der chos smra ba des sngags kyi tshig 'di dag legs par kha ton du byas la gtsang ba dang / gtsang sbra'i cho gas khrus legs par byas te/ gos bzang po bgos la/ shar phyogs su me tog gtor te/ sangs rgyas thams cad bsamadza gepa'i dran pa dang / sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po dang rab tu ldan pas seng ge'i khri la 'dug ste lha'i dbang po brgya byin bsams 2 la/ kau shi ka 'khor legs par yongs su gzhag 3napa'i phyir tshur shog /sngags kyi 22grub pa mngon sum du gyis shig ces brjod na/ de'i bsam pa shin tu rnam par dag cing yongs su dag la tshul khrims yongs su dag pas bsams gi9ma thag tu lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'ongs nas 'khor yongs su 'jog par 'gyur/ sngags kyi grub pa yang nye bar bsgrub rdzo )par 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur shete / 'dug pa des bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yongs su gzung ba dang / yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du bdag chos smra ba de'i drung du mchi bar bgyi/ de'i 'khor 58wa 258

kyang yongs su gzhag0)par bgyi/ sngags kyisaston/grub pa yang nye bar bsgrub par bgyi'o / /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di sum cu gurtsa gsum gyi lha rnams la rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bshad par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'di las bstan pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis 'das pa dang /ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos la gus par bgyis te/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ kau shi ka khyod kyis dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba'i phyir seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa legs so legs so/ /de lta bu ni khyod kyisang)bya ba'o / /lha'i dbang po khyod kyis chos kyi55)rnam grangs 'di bsams 0non lha rnams ni rgyal zhing lha ma yin rnams ni pham par 'gyur bar shes par bya'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho gzhan yang bdud dang bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams tshar gcad57pa'i sngags kyi tshig 'di rnams brjod par bya ste/ sngags kyi tshig de dag gis bdud dang bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams tshar gcod 8)par 'gyur ro/ /sngags kyi tshig de dag gang zhe na / 'di lta ste/ sha me/ sha ma ba ti/ sha mi ta sha tru(9)/ i ku nyu )re/ mi ku77re/ mā ger dzi te/ge/ geka rā shenyuge/ ke yus re/ te dzo ba ti/ o ho ka ma ti/ bi sha ṭha/ nirma le/ ma lā pa na ye/ o kha re/ o kha rā/ gra se/kha yā gra se/ gra sa te/ he sna mu khyi18/ pa rā 19nu khi/ a mu khri( / sha mi tā na ni / sarba gra ha na brnya nā ni snye/ ni grosku hi tā ge/ sarba pa ra pra bā di na na/ bi 58wa 259

muk+ta 1 mā ra pā shā / sbya pi tā tsho )bud+dha mu drwa/ sa mut+ta ti tā9)/ sarba mā 'ogs)/su 6tsa ri ta pa 7rid pa ri shurgya/ gats+tshan+tu 8)sarba mā ra kurma 9)khyi/ blo gros rgya mtsho 'di dag ni bdud tshar gcad 1 ripa'i tshig /nyon mongs pa bsal ba'i tshig ste/de dag chos smra ba des legs par kha ton 17du byas la chos kyi khri la 'dug ste/byang chub kyi rnam pas mngon par bsgrubs pa'i byams pas 'khor thams nya cad la khyab par byas la/ bdag la sman par 'du shes bskyed de/1lha/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes dang / chos nyan pa la nad pa'i 'du shes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa'i 'du shes dang / chos kyi tshul la yun ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed la/ sngags kyi tshig 'di dag mngon du byas te/ chos kyi gtam byed na/ de'i khor yug dpag tshad brgya tshun chad du bdud dang bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams mig gis mi rtsol bar bya ba'i las kyi phyir 'ong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang dag 'ong ba de dag kyang bar chad byed par mi nus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la bdud sdig can gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang bdag byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos 'jig rten gyi khams/ bde ba thams cad kyis brgyan par 'phangs pa skyes bu dam pa de dag gis 7byin gyi rlabs 15dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul 'di bdag la mngon sum du gyur to / /bcom ldan 'das bdag deng slan chad bdud kyi sug las thams cad 'dor ro/ /gang dag na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ston pa dang / yang dag par rab tu ston par 'gyur ba'i grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/gtsug lag khang der chos mnyan pa'i slad du bdag nga rgyal ma mchis pa dang /gus pa dang bcas shing zhe sa dang bcas pas mchis par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 58wa 260

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sdig can legs so legs so/ /khyod chos la gus pa'i rnam par smin pa 'dis rim gyis bdud kyi las thams cad las shin tu 'das te/ gang skyes bu dam pa de dag gis thob (1)pa'i chos de dag rjes su 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /blo gros rgya mtsho gzhan yang mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dgug pa'i sngags kyi tshig rnams brjod par bya ste/ dgug pa'i sngags kyi tshig de dag gis tshangs pa bkug nas chos smra ba'i gan du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /sngags kyi tshig de dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi tre ka re/ ka ru ṇa ka re/mu di ta ka re/ u pe k+ṣa nadaka re/ bud+dha ka re/ dharma /cika re/ saṃ 6gha ka re/su kṛ bta bi dza 6)ye/ ma hās7)bi tā ne/ ni s+pha re/ dā ste(8/ o dzo ba ti/o dzo ga me/ dharmā na9)/ na da ne )/ sa t+ya pra tiṣ+ṭha 11de/ u pa pa ti/nya/ bi shu nyi rka/ sudza8 tsit+ta u pa sha me/ bya ba lo ka ya bra h+ma ṇa/5/ byu tiṣ+ṭha tshan ma ste/a be k+ṣa/ swa dharma sna 7tsa ra 1she/ ku ru sad+dharma 19pa ri grwa ha ṇa ri/ kri ta ma nu bā la57ya/ bud+dha ne/ tī rdunyam ma bya ba ts+tsha snye/ ba si/ smams ra ta( ge/ dharma tsakra pra bcadza 94( / ku ru sa twa bi sho dha dzā( cige/ pra ti gro hā ri ri na/ dharmā nām stag ra mā lāmanya/〉(2/ bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha nī/ mām bi ka u pa ya/ blo gros rgya mtsho mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dgug pa'i da nitshig 'di dag chos smra ba des legs par kha tonas du byas la tshangs pa'i lam la shin tu gnas te/ zhe 'gras pa med pa'i / sems kyi rgyud dang / dbang po shin tu sbas pa dang / shin tu bsrungs pa'i dran pa dang / shin tu dkar ba'i phyag rgya dang / shin tu yongs su dag pa'i lus kyi sa las dang / shin tu dben pas zin pa'i ngag gi las dang /shin tu brtan pa'i blo dang / legs par byas pa'i bzod pa'i las dang /58—261

shin tu yongs su sbyangs pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / legs par brtsams pa'i brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang / shin tu bsten pa'i mang du thos pa dang /shin tu yongs su bsgoms pa'i sems las su rung ba dang / shin tu rno ba'i shes rab kyi dbang po dang / shin tu brtson pa'i yang dag pa'i sbyor ba dang / byang chub kyi sems kyis legs par zin pa dang / shin tu yongs su bsgoms0)pa'i byams pa dang / shin tu brtan pa'i snying rje chen pos sems can thams cad kyi bde ba yang dag par skyed tsho pa dang / sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las shin tu yongs su dgrol ba'i phyir seng ge'i khri la 'dug ste/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa bsams 3)la chos kyi gtam yang dag par rab tu brjod na/des bsams 4ma thag tu tshangs pa tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig tu 'ong bar 5'gyur ro/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de la tshangs pa 'ong bar 'gyur ba'ilo9)ltas ni 'di lta bu 'di dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ 'khor thams cad byams pa'i sems su 'gyur ba dang / dbang po nyams pa med pa dang /gcig la gcig mi gnodaman par gnas pa dang / chos dang chos smra ba la ston pa dang ske/ bla ma ltar phangs par sems pa dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang sems rtse gcig pa dang / mi g.yeng bar yid la byed pa dang / rus shing ltar byed pa dang ske/ yid la byed pa dang / sems 6)thams cad kyis sems pa dang rna bcablags te nyan pa dang / chos smra ba de yang sngon lung ma mnos pa dang / sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams kyang mngon du 'gyur ba ste/ 'khor der nyanyami mjed kyi kyi bdag po tshangs pa 'ongs par rig par bya'o/ /de nas mi mjed7nyekyi bdag po tshangs pa 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa des/ bcom ldan 'das 58wa 262

la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du gnas te/ bsam gtan dang tshad med pa'i bde ba la gnas pa bor la gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ston pa'i 'khor der mchi bar bgyi'o/ /chos smra ba de la yang chos brgyad bsgrub77par bgyi'o((/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ ji ltar thos pa'i chos mi bskyud par bgyi ba'i slad du de la dran pa bsgrub par bgyi/ chos zab mo rtogs par bgyi ba'i slad du de la blo gros bsgrub par bgyi/ don gyi rnam paras nirtogs par bgyi ba'i slad du de la rtogs pa bsgrub par bgyi/ the tshom nga)thams cad gcad 6)pa'i slad du de la spobs pa bsgrub par bgyi/ skad dang nges pa'i tshig thams cad kyis yongs su tshim par bgyi ba'i slad du de la lung bstan pa phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub par bgyi/ 'khor thams cad zil gyis mi non par bgyi ba'i slad du de la 'dul ba bsrung 6chib bsgrub par bgyi/ mi dman par lung bstan par bya ba'i (7slad du de la chos kyi snang ba bsgrub par bgyi/ de bgyid cing chos bsgrub pa'i slad du de la nges par 'byung ba'i sgo bsgrub par bgyi ste/bcom ldan 'das chos smra ba de la chos brgyad po 'di dag bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /chos smra ba de la bsrung zhing sba ba dang / dam pa'i chos kyang yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi byin gyi rlabs dukyis ji ltar chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rgyas par 'gyur ba de ltar bdud thams cad dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad shin tu tshar gcad she par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' blo gos rgya mtshos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das te/ tha ma'i dus kyi tshe ci nas dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa'i sems can rnams kyi sug par mchi 58—263

ba dang / mdzod du chud pa dang / glegs bam du 'gyur zhing nub par mi 'gyur bar bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di byin gyis7brlab tu gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos gsol ba btab pa mkhyen nas/ mdzod spu nas 'di lta bu'i 'od phyung ste/'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang ba chen po ②khyab par gyur nas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal dang / rdo dang gyo mo dang gzugs su snang ba gang dag ji snyed pa —de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs su snang ngo / /rin po che bkod pa'i 'khor gyi ༄khyams na mchod pa'i las byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzugs kyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs nyid du gnas par kun tu snang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs 5pa'i gzugs de dag gis gsung gcig tu/ kye ma'o chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas byin gyis brlabs so/ /gang bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis brlabs pa de phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis byin gyis tsho6brlabs pa'o/ /gang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa de la bdud thams cad kyis bar chad bya bar mi nus so/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bdud dpung dang bcas/ g.yog 'khor dang bcas te7)/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la bar chad bya bar brtun nakyang de dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la bar chad bya bar mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir 9zhe na/ sa nipha ci'ags kyang srid/rgya mtsho thams cad ni skam yang srid/ ri thams cad ni rnam par 'thor71 yang 58—264

srid / rlung ni zhags pas bcing du rung yang srid/ nyi ma dang zla ba ni sa'i steng du ltung0)yang srid/ nam mkha' ni gzugs kyi rnam par bstan du rung yang srid / me ni chur 'gyur yang srid/ chu ni mer 'gyur yang srid/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi ni gzhan du 'gyur yang srid/ sems can thams cad kyi tsho sems ni gcig tu byar rung yang srid/ nam mkha' dang sa ni 'byar yang srid kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs rnyini sus kyang bskyod 4)pa'am g.yo ba'am 'khrugs ltapar byed mi nus so zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'i spyi bor phyag bzhag ste/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bya ba nye bar bzung ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di zung phyi shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' blo ri/gros rgya mtshos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis don gyi dbang gang gzigs nas 8de la rgya mtsho dang mtsho chen po ltar / gting dpag dka' ba'i dran pa dang blo rab tu thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag mchis bzhin du/ dge slong kun dga' bo nyi tshe ba'i 'tshal ba dang ldan pa la chos kyi le'u 'di lta bu 'di yongs su gtad9/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blo gros rgya mtsho dge slong kun dga' bo rang gi blo'i 1 stobs bskyed pas mdo sde 'di lta bu 'dzin pa ma yin gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs 11kyis 'dzin to/ /blo gros rgya mtsho sems can gang dag dge slong kun dga' bo las chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos na dga' ba dang / dad pa 58—265

dang ske/ mchog tu dga' ba thob par 'gyur ba yod de/ de dag 'di snyam du 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs0)kyis 'di ltar nyan thos kyang 'di lta bu'i mdo sde 'di 'dzin cing ston pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs ci latsam du bsam gyis mi khyab pa ngo mtshar to snyam du sems par 'gyur rol/ /de nas 'khor de las lha dang mi kha cig 'di snyam du sems te/ ci byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho 'di dranamatshon pa dang 3)rab tu ldan pa yin gyi/ gang bcom ldan 'das kyis mang du thos pa'i mchog tu bstan pa'i 3)tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ni de lta ma yin no snyam mo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos 6)'khor de'i sems kyi rnam par rtog pa sems kyis shes nas 'khor gyi sems can rnams la rnam par bltas te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol tol/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho 'di rab tu dran pa dang ldan pa lags kyi gang bcom ldan 'das kyis mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa 7tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ni ma lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag na sems can ji tsam nadu bsdu bar bsdus pa'i sems can gyi khams ni 'orab tu mang gi sa'i khams ni de lta ma yin no/ /zhes gang de skad du bya ba de la ji snyam du sems/ 'od srung 1 )sems can gyi khams de mang ngam / 'od srung gis 11gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa tshad ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'od srung yongs su rtag nya pa nye bar bzung ste/ sems can de dag thams cad snga phyi med par mi'i lus thob par gyur la/ de bzhin du ji ltar dge slong kun 58—266

dga' bo ltar dran pa dang gzungs kyi stobs dang yang ldan par gyur kyang kun dga' bo 0)lta bu'i sems can de dag gis ②dran pa dang gzungs kyi stobs de ni/byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho'i dran pa dang / gzungs kyi stobs bskyed par5)brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro ba nas dpe'i bar dudzagayang mi bzod do/ /'od srung byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis gsungs pa 'dzin to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gis〈gechos bstan pas de bzhin gshegs pa gnyis kyis (6)chos bstan pa la sgrib pa'am/ kun nas ldang ba'i bya ba mi byed dope/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen por shing rta'i srog shing tsam gyi char pa'i rgyun 'bab pa'i chu'itshubargyun gcigam7gis chu'i rgyun gnyis pa la sgrib pa'am kun nas ldang ba'i bya ba mi byed de/ chu'i rgyun thams cad kyang rgya mtsho chen pos blangs nas de la 'grib pa'am gang ba yang med do/ /'od srung de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi chos bstan pa kun tu 'dzin kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gis chos bstan pas de bzhin gshegs pa gnyis kyis77chos bstan pa la sgrib pa'am/ kun nas ldang ba'i bya ba mi byed de/ de'i dran pa'i stobs skyed 11pa la bri ba'am gang ba yang med do/ /bstan pa 'di bshad pa na srog chags brgyad 12stong gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed denyuge/ tshig 'di skad ces bdag cag kyang byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho'i dran pa'i stobs bskyed pa ci 'dra ba de ge'adra bar gyur cig ces smras so/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyis 'ilha'i dang / mi'i me tog gis bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' blo 58—267

gros rgya mtsho la gtor mngon par gtor to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' pad ma bkod pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang chos kyi sgo'i le'u 'di thos nas mos pa dang / mos nas kyang 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang /'don pa dang / rtog pa dang / de bzhin nyidalo1)du nan tan bgyisadza pa de bsod nams ji tsam zhig skyed ripar 'gyur/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' pad ma bkod pa la tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/stong chen po yis kyi'ajig rten khams 'di ni/ /gser gyis bkang ste bde gshegs phul ba bas/ /gang gis chos kyi mdzod 'di thos nas ni/ /mos pa'i bsod nams 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /gang gis 'jig rten khams khri rin chen bkang ske/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phul ba snibs/ /gang gis mdo sde 'di la 'jug byas pa/ /bsod nams de la snga mas bskyed du med/ /gang gis 'jig rten khams ni stong phrag bcu/ /rin chen bkang ste sbyin pa byin pa bas/ /gang gis mdo 'di bton nas ston pa yi/ /bsod nams de yi56)cha ni snga ma min / /zhing ni bye ba khrag khrig stong gi rnams/ /rin chen bkang ste 'jig rten slob dpon skyob/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar phul ba bas/ /gang gisi tshul 'dir rab tu sbyor ba dang / /phyogs bcu rnams su gang gā'i (nyabye snyed zhing —/ /rin chen bkang ste rgyal la phul ba bas/ /ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du gang gnas pa'i/ /bsod nams de la mnyam pa yod ma yin/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dang chos 'dzin dang / /chos sgrub pa dang srog chags snying rje ba//chos bzhi 'di dag bsod nams mtha' yas te/ /de dag mtha' ni bde gshegs 58—268

༄ga /'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/1)༄tshon /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sā ga ra nā ga rā nadza pa ri krats+tsha chosanā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcigs na / bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la/ dge slong brgyad stong gi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' mngon par shes pa mngon par shes pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa/ rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa/ gzungs dang mdo sde rtogs par khong du chud pa/ sems can thams cad 5spobs pas mgu bar byed pa/ mngon par shes pa'i ye shes ston pa la mkhas pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 58—303

'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa dang ldan pa 1shes pa la mkhas pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod cing bsngags la snyan par brjod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba shes pa la mkhas pas/ bdud thams cad skrag par bya ba shes pa la mkhas pa/ chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa la mkhas pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa shes pa la mkhas pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad yang dag par sgrub pa shes pa la mkhas pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mchod pa'i las yang dag par sgrub pa shes 4pa la mkhas pa/ 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyis ma gos pa / lus dang ngag dang sems kyi rgyan thams cad 5kyis brgyan pa/ byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po la spro ba'i go cha bgos pa/ bskal pa grangs med par brtson 'grus chen pos yid yongs su mi skyo ba/ seng ge'i sgra chen po bsgrags pa/ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyi 6zil gyis mi non pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi phyag rgyas btab pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyis 7dbang bskur ba thob pa khri nyis stong la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lhun po dang / ri rab dang / lhun po chen po dang / lhun po'i rtse 'dzin dang / lhun po mar me'i rgyal po dang / lhun po brtsegs pa dang /lhun po'i rgyal mtshan dang / lhun po'i rgyal po dang / lhun po'i rtse mo rdob pa'i rgyal po dang / 'brug 2sgra dang / rnga sgra dang / rin chen 'byung gnas dang /rin chen tog dang / rin chen rtse mo dang / rin chen 9dpal dang / rin chen 'byung dang / rin chen 'od dang / 1 rin chen khar ba can dang / rin chen rtse mo dang / lag na rin chen phyag rgya dang / rin chen dra ba dang / rin 58—304

chen bkod pa dang / rin chen 'od dang / rin chen gling dang / rin chen sgron ma dang / lag na rin chen dang / dga' byed dang / chos la dga' ba bkod pa dang / bkod pa'i rgyal po dang / mtshan gyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang / tshig bkod pa'i 'od dang / tshig rnam par dag pa'i 'od dang /gtsug na rin po che dang / lha brtsegs dang / rin chen brtsegs dang / 'od zer stong ldan dang / me lce dang / skar ma la dga' ba dang / zla 'od dang /sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / gser bzangs 1rnam dag 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad 5par mi 'jigs 5pa sbyin pa dang / byams pa la sogs pa bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad dang /'jam dpal la sogs pa sems dpa' dpe med pa drug cu cadang / bzang skyong la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa bcu drug dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa sum cu zhe rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dang / lha'i rgyal po rab 'thab bral la sogs pa ne'athab bral ba'i lha rnams dang / lha'i 7rgyal po yongs su dga' ldan la sogs pa dga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha rnams dang / lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul dga' la sogs pa rin 'phrul dga'i lha rnams dang / lha'i rgyal po dbang byed la sogs pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang / lha'i bu ded dpon la sogs pa bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu dkar po'i phyogs thams cad dang / rab tshangs pa la sogs pa 9tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa'i lha rnams dang / mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa la sogs pa tshangs chen gyi ris kyi lha rnams dang / lha'i rgyal po 'od 58—305

gsal la sogs pa 'od gsal gyi lha rnams dang / lha'i rgyal po dge rgyas la sogs pa dge rgyas kyi lha rnams dang / lha'i rgyal po 'bras bu che la sogs pa 'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams dang / lha'i rgyal po dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / lha'i rgyal po dri med 'od la sogs pa 'og min gyi lha'i bu rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan la sogs pa lha ma yin gyi dbang po drug khri dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa la sogs pa mi 'am ci'i rgyal po bzhi khri nyis stong dang / dri za'i rgyal po phreng thogs la sogs pa dri za'i rgyal po sum khri nyis stong dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po bdun khri nyis stong dang / bya'i rgyal po nam mkha' lding bzhi stong dang / de ma yin pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gzi brjid che ba gzi brjid che ba stong dag dang thabs cig 3)tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas te chos ston cing / lha thams cad kyi bkod pas legs par brgyan tshonapa'i seng ge'i khri la ri'i rgyal po ri rab rgya mtsho'i nang nas gyen du 'phags pa bzhin du bzhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan nas dge slong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor te lhamatshageme lhan ne 4lhang nge zhing bzhugs so/ /de nas de ltar 'dus pa'i 'khor de'i nang na de bzhin gshegs pa de ltar bzhugs pa'i steng gi bar snang la rin po che'i gdugs rin po che thams cad kyi 'od dang ldan zhing rin po che thams cad kyis legs par brgyan pa zhig byung ste/ rin po che'i gdugs des thams cad dang 58—306

ldan pa'i gling bzhi pa chen po'i 'jig rten 'di kun tu khebs par gyur to/ /rin po che'i gdugs de las kyang mu tig kha dog du ma'i rgyan phreng 'bum phrag du ma 'di lta ste/ mu tig dkar po dang / mu tig dmar po dang / mu tig dri ma med pa dang / gser lta bu'i mu tig dang / zla ba lta bu'i mu tig dang / pad ma lta bu'i mu tig dang / 1)nam mkha' lta bu'i mdog can gyi mu tig rnams 'phyang ngo / /mu tig gi rgyan phreng de dag las kyang 'od zer dag byung ngo / /'od zer de dag las kyang me tog kha dog sna tshogs pa/ kha dog 'bum phrag du ma dri zhim pa/ blta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba dag gi char mngon par bab bo/ /me tog de dag gis kyang 'khor gyi khyams thams cad pus mo nub pa tsam du gang bar gyur to/ /bar snang la yang tshona'abrug sgra chen po gragasam nopar gyur to/ /a ga ru dang / tsan dan gyi phye ma dag dang / tsan dan dus kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i phye ma dag gi char yang bab bo/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus tshe dang ldan pa mod galams gyi bu chen po stan las 5skulangs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te pus mo g.yasam6)pa'i lha nga sa la btsugasas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de58)logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de9/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sngon ma mthong ma thos pa'i cho 'phrul 'di lta bu gda' ba 'di dag su'i snga ltas tsolags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal 11gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ / mod gal7 gyi bu 'di ni klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho de bzhin gshegs pa la bltar 'ong ba de'i snga ltas 9/nyeyin no/ / de nas 1 ribacom ldan 'das kyis tshig de skad ces bka' stsal nas ring po ma lon par/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho klu bye ba phrag 58—307

brgyad cu 1rtsa bzhi dang / klu'i bu mo bye ba phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan thams cad dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang ske/ glu dbyangs brgya stong dag len cing bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal tshonate/ ji ltar thogs pa'i me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang ske/ byug pa la sogs pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang / glu dbyangs rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas/ btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnyen 'dab kyi 'khor dang bcas pas de'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das la tshul dang 'thun ripa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /'jig rten dag na 'jig rten phan par bzhed pa 'jig rten gyis mchod 'jig rten mig sbyin pa/ /'jig rten du skyes 'jig rten dri ma rnams kyis ma gos pad ma chus mi chags pa bzhin/ /'jig rten snang ba rnam pa par gzigs pa spyan gsum mnga' ba 'jig rten bde ba sbyin mdzad pa/ /'jig rten nyi ma rkyen la mkhas pa 'jig rten gtso bo khyod la de ring bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dul zhing dul bas yongs bskor stobs bcu mnga' ba sbyin pa rnams dang dul ba rnams kyis 'phags/ /'dren pa nyon mongs rdul dang mun pa dang ni dri ma tha ba bsregs shing myu gu bsregs/ /snying rjes nor gyi gtso bo bdun po sbyin par mdzad cing sems can rnams la byams pas 'phags/ /bsod nams 5zhing ste 58—308

'jig rten rtsa lag brtan po khyod la bdag ni mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi zhal gyi smin mtshams mdzod spu 'bar ba me tog kun da 1zla ba dung mdog 'dra/ /'di na tshon)tshangs pa'i gnas na 'khod pa'i lha rnams kyis kyang khyod kyi spyi gtsug mthong mi 'gyur/ /zla ba lta bu'i zhal nas byung ba'i rmad byung 'od kyis 'gro ba ma lus snang bar mdzad/ /de yis reg par gyur pa'i dbang gis mtshams med sems can rnams kyang bde ba nyid du gyur/ /khyod kyi rigasung ni shin tu yid 'ong tshig ste zla ba bzhin du yid kyang tshim par bgyid/ /lha cadang mi yi pasgra skad zil gyis gnon cing gcig tu nges par dag la gtsang ba ste/ /'dod chags zhe sdang mun pa rdul rnams rab tu zhi bar bgyid cing shes rab gsal bar bgyid/ /dga' dang mgu bgyid bde ba shin tu skyed 6par bgyid cing thar pa yang dag ston pa lags/ /khyod kyi ye shes dus gsum gtogs pa thogs pa ma mchis gar yang chags pa ma mchis te / /khyod kyis sems can rnams kyi spyod pa chung dang 'bring dang dam pa ma lus thugs su chud/ /gang dag gi nani dbang po bsam pa dag dang 'gro dang thar pa tha dad ji 9'dra ba/ /thams cad khyod kyis skad cig tsam gyis thugs su chud par 1 de slad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub shing rgyal drung du glags lta'i 11phyir brtson bdud rnams bye ba brgya phrag snyed/na / /khyod kyi thad du lhags par gyur kyang gnas las ma g.yos thugs brtser ldan pa'i blo mnga' ba/ /mnga' bdag khyod kyis bden dang brtul zhugs dpal dang yon tan rnams dang byams pas pham par mdzad/ /de slad mi rnams su zhig deng 'dir khyod la mchod pa'i slad du khyod la ngoms 1 par 'dzin/ /mnga' bdag khyod kyis chos rnams byed pa med dang ya ma brla 1 dang zla ba 'dra ba dang / /58—309

dbu 1)ba glog sprin chu yis chu bur 'dra zhing sgyu ma smigs rgyu lta bur thugs su chud/ /gang la rgyu med rtog pa mi 'byung khyod kyis chos de dag ni rtag tu bdag med de/ /de ltar 'gro ba'i 'dod pa lnga skyed camadzad pas mnga' bdag khyod ni thar pa lags par 'os/ /gang gi 5)don du bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang por dka' ba rnams ni bstan snyopa dang / /gang gi don du rtag tu 'gro la phan mdzad 'dren5ge pa rnams la mchod pa mdzad pa dang / /gang gi don du sbyin dang yang dag sdom dang dul dang bzod pa rtag tu bsten pa yi/ /rnam 'dren khyod kyi smon lam chen po shin tu rmad du byung ba de ni rdzogs par gyur/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos bcom ldan 'das la tshul dang 'thun pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu bar 'tshal lo/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /klu'i bdag 87po khyod ci dang ci 'dod pa de bzhin gshegs pa la dris shig dang / ngas dri ba dris 9pa de dang de lung bstan pas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dri ba lung bstan pa'i skabs phye nas/ bcom ldan 'das la klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams ngan 'gro dang ngan song thams cad yang dag par chad pa dang / mi khom pa brgyad las 'das pa dang / lha dang mi'i skye bar 'gro ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das 58—310

ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par sangs rgyas mthong ba thob pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad pa dang /'tsham pa'i yul du gnas pa 'thob pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dad pa dang / dang 1 ba'i shasatshan/che ba dang / las kyi rnam par smin pa la rton pa dang / mi dge ba'i chos thams cad spangs nas dge ba'i chos thams cad kyis 'bogs pa lags / bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos don du gnyer ba dang / chos 'tshal ba dang /chos kyi kun dga' la dga' bas dga' ba dang / thos pa tshol ngabs cho ga ma 'tshal ba dang / thos pa bsgrubs 5pas mngon par 'phags pa lags/bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams rab tu 'byung ba la mos pa dang / nags dang / nags 'dab 46na rgyu ba dang / 'phags pa'i rigs dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / yo byad bsnyungs pa la mngon par dga' ba dang / rab tu byung ba'i yon tan rnams yongs su rdzogs par mebagyid pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams rinachos zab mo'i tshul la gnas pa dang / chad pa dang rtag 9)par lta ba yongs su spangs pa dang / rgyu dang rkyen gyi chos rnams la zhugs pa dang / lta ba'i rnam pa thams cad dang bral ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyis mirnam par rtse 11ba dang / sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i ye shes mthong ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can gyi spyod pa dang / bsam pa dang / cho ga 'tshal ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams 58—311

yongs su smin par bgyi ba 1tshodang / gzung tshon/ba dang / bklaga' pa dang /brda sprod pa la mkhas pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 4rnams bdud 5phyir rgol ba bcom pa dang / skrag pa dang / 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i 6spyad pa spyod pa lags/bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams phyir mi ldog pa'i chos la yang dag par gzhol ba dang / bzod pa thob pa dang / lung bstan pa thob pa lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /klu'i bdag po legs so legs so/ /khyod de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di 'dri bar sems pa ni klu'i bdag po khyod 7legs so/ /klu'i bdag po de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung 8shig dang ngas khyod la bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te59)/klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /klu'i bdag po chos bzhi dang ldan na/byang chub sems dpa' rnams ngan 'gro dang ngan song thams cad yang dag par chad par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad la khong khro ba'i sems med pa dang / dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par snyeblangs nas thams cad srung 1 ba dang / gzhan gyi nyes pa mi gleng zhing brnyas par mi byed pa dang 1/ bdag gi 1 'khrul pa la 1 rtog par byed kyi gzhan gyi 'khrul pa la mi rtog pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na/byang chub sems dpa' rnams ngan 'gro dang / ngan song thams cad yang dag par chad par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems 58—312

dpa' rnams mi khom pa thams cad spong bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dkon mchog gsum po 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang /chos dkon mchog dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog gi bsngags pa rgyun du brjod pa dang / chos 'dod pa rnams g.yengs (1)par mi byed pa dang / gzhan dag gi 'gyod pa mi skyed tshonapa dang / sems can 'gyod cing 'dug pa rnams kyi 'gyod pa sel ba ste/ klu'i bdag po chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mi khom pa thams cad spong bar 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams 5)lha dang mi'i skye bar 'gro bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub kyi sems mi gtong zhing gzhan dag la yang sgrogs 4pa dang / tshul khrims yang dag par blangs pa mi gtong zhing nyams par mi byed pa dang / smon lam la bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir de dag la snying rje chen po skyed 5)pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams lha dang mi'i skye bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos brgyad dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams sangs rgyas mthong ba dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ brgyad gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa yid la byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la bsnyen bkur dang / mchod pa byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsngags pa rgyun du brjod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs byed du 'jug pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa lta ba la sems can rnams yang dag par 'dzud pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang na de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa thos pa der skye bar smon lam 'debs pa dang /58—313

rgyud zhum pa med cing rgya chen po la mos pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes 'dod pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos brgyad po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams sangs rgyas mthong ba dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnyed par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sgyu med pa dang g.yo med par bsnyen 1)bkur byed pa dang / chos la gces pa dang gus pa dang ri mo byed pa dang / bka'am blo bde zhing gso sla la des pa dang / nga rgyal med cing sri sne zhu byed pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos gsum dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'tsham pa'i yul du gnas pa thob par 'gyur te/ gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi brlang zhing gya gyu med pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / phrag dog 47dang ser sna bsal ba dang ske/ gzhan dag gi rnyed pa dang bkur sti dngamarabade bar sbyar ba la 6)dga' ba ste/ klu'i bdag po chos lhagasum po ri8)de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'tsham pa'i 9yul du gnas pa thob 1 par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos lnga dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dad pa dang ldan par 'gyur te / lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mos pa'i stobs dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi 11stobs dang / las kyi rnam par smin pa la 'jug pa'i stobs dang /byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ba'i stobs dang / chos nyid la rton 12pa'i stobs te / klu'i bdag po chos lnga po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dad pa 1snyedang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos gnyis dang ldan na 58—314

dga' ba'i shas che bar 'gyur te/ gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rgyu'i stobs dang / yang dag par sbyor ba'i stobs te/ klu'i bdag po chos de gnyis dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dga' ba'i shas che bar 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos gsum dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams las kyi rnam par smin pa la rton7par 'gyur te/ gsum〈migang zhe na/ 'di lta ste bdag med pa la mos pa dang / bzod pa'i stobs dang / yang dag pa'i las la legs par brtson50pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos gsum po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams las kyi rnam par smin pa la rton54)par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos gnyis dang ldan namachi5)byang chub sems dpa' rnams mi dge ba'i chos thams cad spangs nas dge ba'i chos thams cad kyis 'bogs par 'gyur te/gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/6) phung po gsum gyi yongs su bsngo ba dang ldan pa dang / bag yod par gnas pa ste/ de gnyis so/ /gzhan yang gnyis te47)/'di ltasaste/ dge ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa dang / rnam par smin pa la mi re ba ste7/ klu'i bdag po chos de gnyis dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams 1 mi dge ba'i chos thams cad spangs nas dge ba'i chos thams cad kyis 'bogs par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos lnga dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos don du gnyer ba yin te/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gzugs don du gnyer ba ma yin pa dang / sgra don du gnyer ba ma yin pa dang / dri don du gnyer ba ma yin pa dang / ro don du gnyer ba ma yin pa dang / reg bya don du gnyer ba ma yin pa ste/ lnga po ni de dag yin no/ /klu'i bdag po gzhan yang chos lnga dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos don du gnyer 58—315

ba yin te/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos don du gnyer ba yin gyi lus don du gnyer ba ma yin pa dang / yon tan don du gnyer ba yin gyi srog don du gnyer ba ma yin pa dang / shes rab don du gnyer ba yin gyi reg pa don du gnyer ba ma yin pa dang / dge ba don du gnyer ba yin gyi tshor ba don du gnyer ba ma yin pa dang / sems can yongs su bskyab pa don du gnyer ba yin gyi / bdag gi bde 1ba don du gnyer ba ma yin pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos lnga po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos don du gnyer ba yin no / /klu'i bdag po chos drug dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos 'dod pa yin te/ drug po dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste rab tu byung ba'i yon tan 'dod kyi/ gos tshon nacan gyi rtags 'dzin pa tsam 'dod pa ma yin pa dang ske/ chos nyan pa 'dod kyi 'jig rten rgyang pan pa'i gsang tshig nyan 'dod pa ma yin pa dang / chos bstan pa 'dod kyi 'jig rten gyi zang zing 'dod pa ma yin pa dang / chos la so sor rtog par 'dod kyi tshul bzhin lam yin pa yid la byed par 5'dod pa ma yin pa dang / chos bsgrub 6pa 'dod kyi yi ge dang nges pa'i tshig dang brda yongs su tshol 7ba 'dod pa ma yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos nyan 'dod kyi nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi chos 'dod pa ma yin pa ste/snyeklu'i bdag po chos drug po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos 'dod pa yin no/ /klu'i bdag po chos brgyad dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos kyi kun dga' la nadaga' bas dga' ba yin te/ brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste9/ byang chub kyi sems kyi gtam la dga'i theg pa dman pa'i gtam la ma yin pa dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po'i gtam la dga'i phyin ci log gi 58—316

gtam la ma yin pa dang / chos kyi lugs kyi gtam la dga'i 'jig rten rgyang pan po'i (1)gtam la ma yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi che ba nyid kyi gtam la dga'i 'khor ba bcad na pa'i gtam la ma yin pa dang / zab cing gting dpag dka' ba'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i gtam la dga'i bdag tu lta ba 'dzin pa'i gtam la ma yin pa dang / chos bdag med pa'i rang bzhin dang rkyen rnam par dag pa'i gtam la dga'i chad pa dang / rtag gepa dang / bdag dang ske/ sems can dang / srog dang skyes bu dang / gang zag tu 'dzin pa'i gtam la ma yin pa dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i gtam yang dag pa ji lta ba la dga'i/ dmigs 4par lta ba'i gtam la ma yin pa dang / rab tu byung ba la dmigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan bkod pa'i gtam la dga'i/ zhi ba la btang snyoms su byed pa'i gtam la ma yin pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos brgyad po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' 5rnams chos kyi kun dga' la dga' bas 6dga' ba yin no/ /klu'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni don gyi dbang rnam pa lnga mthong ba'i phyir thos pa yongs su tshol ba na chog mi shes te/ lnga gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams thos pa las shes rab 'byung bar yang dag par mthong ba'i phyir thos pa yongs su tshol ba na chog mi shes pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams thos pas 'gyod pa dang the tshom 7med par 'gyur ba yang dag par mthong ba'i phyir thos pa yongs su tshol ba na chog mi shes pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams thos pas kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba rtogs 8par 'gyur bar yang dag par mthong ba'i phyir thos pa 9yongs su tshol ba na chog mi 58—317

shes pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams thos pas sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa spang ba'i phyir/ nyon mongs pa spong bar 'gyur bar yang dag par mthong ba'i phyir thos pa yongs su tshol ba na chog mi shes pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams thos pas mi 'jigs par 'gyur la mi 'jigs pa las sems can thams cad kyi the tshom chad ti par 'gyur bar yang dag par mthong ba'i phyir thos pa yongs su tshol ba na chog mi shes pa ste lnga po de dag go/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni don gyi dbang rnam pa gnyis mthong ba'i phyir thos pa yongs su tshol ba na chog mi shes te gnyis gang zhe na/ 'phags pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba skye ba dang / chags pa med pa'i gzungs 'thobam5)pa ste de gnyis so/ /klu'i bdag po chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams thos pa sgrub pas mngon par 'phags par 'gyur te bcu gang zhe na/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti rnams la 'dod pa nyung zhing chog shes pa dang / yongs su tshol ba rnams la lus dang srog la mi lta ba dang / spyod lam rnams la dran pa dang / shes bzhin pa dang / ji skad thos pa la shas cher yongs su rtogs pa dang / 'du 'dzi med pas bya ba nyung ba dang / sbyor ba la brtson pa'i brtson 'grus kyis nam gyi cha stod dang / nam gyi cha smad la mi nyal ba dang / bla ma la gus pa dang / ri mo snyebyed pa dang / ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod pa phun sum tshogs pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten pa dang / snying rje chen pos 5sems can la lta ba dang /yon tan yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir 'phags pa'i skye bo la rim gro byed pa dang ske/ shes pas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten yongs su bskyab ne pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams thos pa 58—318

sgrub pas mngon par 'phags par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni phan yon rnam pa lnga po 'di dag yang dag par mthong nas/rab tu 'byung ba la mos par 'gyur te/ lnga gang zhe na/ bdag gis las byas pa chud za bar mi 'gyur ba dang / bdag gis byas pa'i bag chags kyis bsgo bar 'gyur ba dang / yongs su 'dzin pa thams cad la bdag gi sems gtong bar 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bdag smad par mi 'gyur ba dang / bdag grol zin nas kyang nyon mongs pa'i bcing ba rnams kyis bcings pa'i sems can rnams 'ching ba de las rab tu thar bar bya ba'i phyir chos ston par 'gyur ro snyam pa ste lnga po de dag go/ /gzhan yang rnam pa lnga ste lnga gang zhe na/ rab tu 'byung ba ni tshul khrims 'chal pa'i sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir tshul khrims dang 'thun pa yin no/ /rab tu 'byung ba ni thos pa nyung ba'i sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir thos pa dang 'thun pa yin no/ /rab tu 'byung ba ni sems rnam par g.yengs 1)pa'i sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir ting nge ri 'dzin dang 'thun pa ri yin no/ /rab tu 'byung ba ni shes rab 'chal pa'i sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir shes rab dang 'thun pa yin no/ /rab tu 'byung ba ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba'i lam la sems can dgod par bya ba'i phyir rnam par grol ba'i ye shes dang 'thun pa yin te/ lnga po de dag go/ /gzhan yang rnam pa lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ rab tu 'byung ba ni phung po lnga yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir nga rgyal bcom pa'o/ /rab tu 'byung ba ni kun 'byung ba spang ba'i 4phyir sred 5pa'i bag la nyalas spong ba'o/ /rab tu 'byung ba ni 'gog pa mngon sum du bya ba'i 58—319

phyir zhi ba dang / rab tu zhi ba dang /1 nye bar zhi bar byed pa'o/ /rab tu 'byung ba ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bsgom pa'i phyir lam la 'jug gol/ /rab tu 'byung ba ni 'phags pa'i sabaden pa rnams la sems can dgod pa'i phyir bden pa la 'jug pa ste/ lnga po de dag go/ /klu'i bdag po chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams nags dang nags 'dab5snyen rgyu zhing bas mtha'i gnas mal dag na gnas pa yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ lus dang srog la mi lta cab dang / dge ba'i chos thams cad la lta zhesab dang / mngon par shes pa'i shes pa skyed 6par 'dod pa dang / spyod lam rab tu zhi bas lha dang mi rnams mgu bar byed pa 7ste/ klu'i bdag po chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams nags dang /8 nags 'dabs9)na rgyu zhing bas mtha'i gnas mal 1 dag na gnas pa yin no/ /klu'i bdag po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ni don gyi dbang rnam pa bzhi mthong nas/ nags dang nags 'dab 11na rgyu zhing bas mtha'i gnas mal dag na gnas pa yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ dgon pa dang rab tu dgon pa 'di dag ni sangs rgyas kyis bsngags pa yin te/ dgon pa ni 12gnas na snying rje chen pos sems can thams cad rab tu thar bar bya ba la dmigs pa ni bdag gis 12bre mo 1 gtam zer ba yin gyi/ phyogs gcig tu gyur pa ni 15ma yin no snyam pa dang / bdag gis ni byang chub kyi snying po'i rgyan bsags kyi nyon mongs pa rnams 17ni ma yin no snyam 1 pa dang / bdag gis ni yongs su sbyang ba byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' du ma dag gi rjes su bslab dgos so snyam pa dang / bdag dgon pa na gnas te/chos thams cad yang dag par bsgrubs nas grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong 58—320

rdal dang / ljongs 3modang yul 'khor dang / pho brang 'khor dag tu song ste/sems can rnams la chos bstan par bya'o snyam pa ste/ klu'i bdag po 5bzhi po de dag dang ldan na nags dang nags 'dab rin rgyu zhing bas mtha'i gnas mal dag na gnas pa yin no/ /klu'i bdag po lagasum po 'di dag ni 'phags pa'i rigs dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / yo byad bsnyungs pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang phan yon phul dang rab mchog yin te/gsum gang zhe na/ dga' ba dang / mi dga' ba rnams la mi lta 5ba'i phyir 'du 'dzi'i bya ba med pa dang / sems rag las pa med cing gang du 'dod par 'gror yod pa'i phyir rang nyam dang / rang dbang dang / tha mal par gnas pa dang / sems can thams cad mnyam pa nyid du sems pa'i phyir de'i ting nge 'dzin myur du skye bar 'gyur ba ste/ gsum po de dag go/ /gzhan yang gsum ste/ de la tshul 'chos pa dang / kha gsag mi 'byung ba dang / de la rjes su chags pa dang / khong khro ba'i sems mi skye ba dang / sgrub cing 0'dug pa na khyim la rjes su lta bar mi 'gyur ba ste/ klu'i bdag po 7gsum po de dag ni 'phags pa'i rigs dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / yo byad bsnyungs pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang / phan yon phul dang rab mchog yin no/ /klu'i bdag po chos brgyad dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa'i rab tu 'byung ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ brgyad gang zhe na/'phags pa'i rigs kyis chog par 'dzin pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang /yo byad bsnyungs pa la gnas pa dang / mang du thos pa dang / sems nges par sems pa la dga' ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa la kun tu rmongs 58—321

pa mang khu 3tshodang / dran pa nye bar gzhag lapas gnas pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ske/ shes rab sgom dpa'i sbyor ba la brtson pa dang / brtsams gepa thams cad sgrub pa snying por byed pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos brgyad po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa'i rab tu 'byung ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos zab mo'i tshul la gnas pa yin te/ bcu gang zhe na/ bdag gi ngo bo nyid kyis chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid kyi rjes su 'gro ba dang / bdag dag pas chos thams cad dag pa'i rjes su 'jug pa dang / bdag bdag ri med pas chos thams cad bdag med pa la mos pa dang / bdag stong pas chos thams cad stong par som nyi med pa dang / bdag dben pas chos thams cad dben pa la 'jug pa dang / bdag zhi bas chos thams cad zhi bar so sor rtog pa dang /bdag ji lta ba bzhin pas chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du khong du chud pa dang /bdag zab pas chos thams cad zab par nges par sems pa dang / bdag bems 6po yin pas chos thams cad bems po yin par nges paras rtog pa dang /bdag gzung 9du med pas chos thams cad gzung du med par rab tu shes pa ste/bcu po de dag go/ /klu'i bdag po gzhan yang chos bcu dang 7ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos zab mo'i tshul la gnas pa yin te/ bcu gang zhe na/rnam par bsgrubs pas gnas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rab tu 11shes pa dang / phyin ci log las byung bar mthong bas chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur rab tu shes pa dang / phyin ci log tu 'du shes pas chos thams cad mig rgyu lta bur rab tu shes pa dang / rgyu'i bya ba dang / rkyen la 58—322

dmigs te skye ba'i 3)chos thams cad mig yor lta bur rab tu shes pa dang /'pho ba med pa'i mtshan nyid las phyir mi ldog pas chos thams cad chu zla lta bur rab tu shes pa dang / yul la mi gnas shing phyogs na mi gnas te ngo bo nyid med pas chos thams cad brag ca na lta bur rab tu shes pa dang / skad cig kyang mi sdod pas chos thams cad sprin dang glog snang ba lta bur rab tu shes pa dang /'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gis chags par mi 'gyur bas chos thams cad 'ja' tshon lta bur rab tu shes pa dang / glo cibur gyi nye ba'i nyon mongs pas nyon mongs pa can du mi 'gyur bas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rab tu dag par shes pa dang / skye ba dang / 'jig sa)pa dang / gnas pa dang bral bas chos thams cad nam mkha' lta bur rab tu shes pa ster / klu'i bdag po chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos zab mo'i tshul la gnas pa yin no/ /klu'i bdag po chos gnyis dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams chad nepar lta bar ltung bar mi 'gyur te/ gnyis gang zhe na/las kyi bya ba la 'jug pa shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rnam par sgrub pa shes pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos de 7gnyis dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams chad par lta bar ltung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos gnyis dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams rtag par lta bar ltung bar mi 'gyur te/ gnyis gang zhe na/ mi rtag pa'i chos la 'jug pa shes pa dang /skyes nas zhig cing zhu ste/ mi gnas par rab tu rnam par nanodabye ba shes pa ste/klu'i bdag po chos de 9gnyis dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams rtag par lta bar ltung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos bzhi dang ldan na byang 58—323

chub sems dpa' rnams brten te/1 'byung ba la mkhas pa yin te/ ma rig pa kun 'byung ba nas rga shi kun 'byung ba'i bar la 'jug pa dang / ma rig pa 'gag pa nas rga shi 'gag pa'i bar la 'jug pa dang / chad par lta bar yang mi ltung ba dang / rtag par lta bar yang mi gnas pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams rten cing 'brel par rinasa'abyung ba la 'jug pa la mkhas pa yin no/ /klu'i bdag po chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams lta bar gyur pa thams cad du lta bar mi 'gyur te/bzhi gang zhe na/ stong pa nyid shes pas bdag dang sems can du lta bar mi 'gyur ba dang / mtshan ma med pa nashes pas srog dang gang zag tu lta bar mi 'gyur ba dang / smon pa med pa shes pas 'byung ba dang 'jig par lta bar mi 'gyur ba dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba shes pas chad pa dang rtag par lta 4bar mi 'gyur ba ste/ chos bzhi po 'di dag 5dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams lta bar gyur pa thams cad du lta bar mi 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po chos drug dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon par 6shes pa'i shes pas rnam par rtse 7bar 'gyur te/ drug gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad la khong khro ba med pa'i lta bas de'i lha'i namig rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang /ngan du smras pa'i tshig dang du len pas lha'i rna ba rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang ske/ sems 9kun nas nyon mongs pa med pas gzhan gyi sems shes pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / sngon byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can thams cad la gtong bas sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa shes pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / 'thun par byed pa dang / bka' blo bde ba dang / ji skad smras 58—324

pa bzhin byed pas rdzu 'phrul bya ba shes pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang /chos rnams la slob dpon gyi dpe mkhyud med pas zag pa zad pa nyashes pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ba ste/ drug po de dag go/ /klu'i bdag po gzhan yang mar me byin pas ni lha'i mig rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /sil snyan dang /pheg rdob 3)pa dang / glu'i dbyangs thams cad byin pas ni lha'i rna ba rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa med par byin pas ni gzhan gyi sems shes pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i chos dran par byed cing bskul bas ni sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa shes pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /sgrib pa dang / 'gyod pa bsal bas ni rdzu 'phrul gyi dbya ba shes pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /chos byin pas ni zag pa zad pa shes pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i bdag po gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa la lta bas ni lha'i mig rnam par dag cadapar 'gyur ro/ /dam pa'i chos mnyan pas ni 5lha'i rna ba rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /sems kyis nges par brtags pas ni gzhan gyi sems shes pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /dge 'dun rjes su dran pas ni sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa shes pa 6rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /'dun pa drag pos ni rdzu 'phrul gyi bya ba shes pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /chos sgrub 7pas ni zag pa zad pa shes pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /de la mngon par shes pas rnam par rtse ba gang zhe na/ klu'i bdag po 'di la nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa dang / phyi rol gyi drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa 8dang / lha dang ske/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam 58—325

mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phyemanyu7chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de bas ni byang chub sems dpa'i lha'i mig de ches tshi'adas pa dang / ches gegasal ba dang / ches ri )khyad par du 'phags pa dang / ches gerimachog tu gyur pa dang / chesangagarnam par dag pa ste/ de'i lha'i mig des ni 75de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gyi yul ma gtogs par sems can du snang ba'am/ gzugs su snang ba'am/ chos su snang ba gang yang mi rtogs58)pa dang / mi mthong ba dang / mi shes pa ci yang med do/ /klu'i bdag po de la nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams lta kyi lha'i rna ba gang yin pa nas mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar rnams kyi lha'i rna ba gang yin pa de bas ni byang chub sems dpa'i lha'i rna ba de ches 3 )'das pa dang / ches 31gsal ba dang / ches72khyad par du 'phags pa dang / ches 3nyamachog tu gyur pa dang / chesamu tshornam par dag pa ste/ de lha'i rna ba'i dbang po des ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snyan gyi yul ma gtogs pa 15sgar grag pa gang yang thos par mi 'gyur ba ci yang med de/des ni sgra thams cad kyi sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' yongs su gcod pa rab tu shes so/ /klu'i bdag po de la byang chub sems dpas ni sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyu ba dang / sems kyi dmigs pa dang / sems kyi mtshan ma dang / sems kyi dpyod pa dang / sems kyi rgyu dang / sems kyi bsam pa dang / sems kyi 'bras bu dang / sems kyi nges pa dang / sems kyi brtag pa dang / sems kyi rnam pa sna tshogs dang / sems kyi rjes su chags pa dang / sems kyi khong khro ba dang / sems rnam par g.yengs pa tshadang /sems bsdu ba dang / sems bral bar g.yo ba dang / sems lhag par g.yo ba 58—326

dang ske/ sems bskul 37ba dang / sems gnas pa dang / sems kyi sngon gyi mtha' dang / sems kyi phyi ma'i mtha' dang / sems kyi da ②ltar byung ba dang /sems kyi gnas dang / sems kyi gnas pa thams cad yang dag pa hūṃ rje/ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/ shes nas kyang de bzhin du des sems can de dag la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam 'jug par byed do/ /des sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pas bdag dang gzhan rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha'i mur thug pa'i bar gyi 'chi 'pho yang dag pa caji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes shing dran te/ rnam pa dang bcas/yul phyogs dang bcas par yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du de kho na nyid dang gzhan ma yin par rjod 5)par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi bya ba rnams la yang mngon par 'du byed pa med pa thob ste bya ba thams cad ston to/ /klu'i bdag po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa ste/ de la rang gi sems la dbang byed pas don thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa 'di ni de'i rnam par rtse 6ba ste/ sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba yang kun tu )ston la gtan du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar yang mi byed pa lta bu'o/ / de la 8byang chub sems dpa'i zag pa zad pa shes pa mngon sum du byed pa'i mngon par shes pa gang zhe na/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi rnam par grol ba la ma chags te/ 9risangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rnam par grol ba la lhag par 1 ridamigs shing rang bzhin gyis zag pa zad pa shes kyi shes pa de mngon sum du byed pa ni ma yin la sems can thams cad kyi zag pa zad par bya ba kho na'i phyir yang 'khor ba'i rgyun la gnas pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa drug pa'o/ /klu'i bdag po chos bzhi dang ldan 58—327

na byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes mthong ba la 'jug pa yin te/bzhi gang zhe na/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su bsgos pa'i mngon par shes pa lnga dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen pos yongs su bsgos pa'i so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / thabs dang shes rab kyis yongs su bsgos pa'i gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pas yongs su bsgos pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun te/ klu'i bdag po chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes mthong ba la 'jug pa yin no/ /klu'i bdag po de la sgrib pa med pa'i 1ye shes mthong ba gang zhe na/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyang mthong la bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad kyang yang dag par bcom pa gang yin pa dang /'khor ba yang mthong la mya ngan las 'das pa la yang yang dag par gzhol ba dang ske/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa 2yang mthong la byang chub kyi snying po la yang yang dag par gzhol ba dang / sems can gyi spyod pa'i pa)rjes su yang 'jug la sems can gyi spyod pa dben par yang shes pa ste/ 'di ni sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes mthong ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes mthong ba ni 'dus byas kyi bya ba thams cad kyi rjes su yang 'jug la/ 'dus ma byas pa yang thob pa gang yin pa dang / 'dus byas thams cad kyi nye bar zhi ba yang mthong 5la 'dus ma 6byas kyang thob pa'o/ /klu'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' ni 'dus byas la spyod pa na yang 'dus ma byas shes pas sgrib pa med pa la/'dus ma byas pa thob pa la yang 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams 7kyis sgrib pa med de/58—328

der sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes mthong ba zhes bya'o/ /klu'i bdag po chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa'atusems can gyi spyod pa dang / bsam pa dang cho ga shes pa yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi rjes su 'jug pa'i shes pa dang /snyoms par 'jug pa la mkhas pa'i shes pa dang / shes pa dang / bsam pa las su rung ba'i bsam pa dang / sems la dbang byed pa'i thabs te/ klu'i bdag po chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems can gyi spyod pa dang / bsam pa dang cho ga shes pa yin no/ /klu'i bdag po chos lnga dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed pa yin te/ lnga gang zhe na/ bdag gi bde ba la mi lta bas yid yongs su mi skyo ba dang ske/ brtson pa brtan pas sems can la bde ba sbyin pa dang / snying rje chen po dang / sems can rnams kyi spyod pa ji lta ba de nalta bu'i spyod pa ril rjes su 'jug pa dang / gong du yang yon tan khyad par can la yang 'god par byed pa ste / klu'i bdag po chos lnga po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems can yongs su smin par byed pa yin no/ /klu'i bdag po chos drug dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / brda sprod pa la mkhas pa yin te/ drug gang zhe na/ gzungs thob pa dang / dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis sgrub pa dang / yang dag pa la tshul bzhin du 'jug pa dang / sems kyi rjes su 'jug pa shes pa dang / thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa thob pa dang /dgongs pa'i tshig ston la pa'i shes pa la mkhas pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos drug po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang /58—329

brda sprod pa la mkhas pa yin no/ /klu'i bdag po chos brgyad dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bdud phyir rgol ba bcom pa yin te/ brgyad gang zhe na/ sgyu ma'i chos nyid phung po lnga yongs su shes pa dang yang ldan la 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i nyon mongs pa dang bral te/ stong pa nyid la spyod yul ba yang yin pa dang /'du byed thams cad kyi skye ba med par nyu)yang rab tu shes la sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir bsams tshonabazhin du skye bar yang byed pa dang / brtson 'grus brtan pas byang chub kyi bsam pa yang yongs su mi gtong la khams gsum pas kyang yid rtag tu skrag pa dang / mngon par 'du byed pa med pa yang mi ltung la thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang yongs su tshol ba dang / sems can rnams la yang lta la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs kyang sogs sne)pa dang / mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid la yang yid ches la ye shes kyi tshogs kyang sogs 3 pa dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi shes pa la yang ma chags pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos brgyad po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bdud phyir rgol ba bcom pa yin no/ /klu'i bdag po chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' skrag pa dang 'jigs sku pa thams cad dang bral te byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa yin te/ bcu gang zhe na/ sbyin pas nye bar brtan ne)pa yin te mtshan gyis 7legs par brgyan pa dang / tshul khrims la gnas pa yin te ngan song thams cad yang dag par gcadam pa dang / bzod pa'i go cha 1)bgos pa yin te dbang po ma nyams pa dang / brtson 'grus brtan pa yin te dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs rnams kyis chog mi shes pa dang / bsam gtan la gnas pa yin te cang shes kyi sems dang ldan pa dang / shes rab dang ldan pa yin te nyon mongs 58—330

pa dang bral ba dang / thabs la mkhas pa yin te kun tu yongs su bsngo ba shes pa la mkhas pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa yin te don dang chos dang ske/ nges pa'i tshig dang spobs pa la mkhas pa dang / gzungs thob pa yin te / sems can thams 1)cad kyi the tshom〈migacod pa la mkhas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ④byin gyis brlabs pa yin te dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ste/klu'i bdag po chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' skrag pa dang 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral te byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa yin no//klu'i bdag po chos brgyad dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i chos la yang dag par gzhol ba yin te/ brgyad gang zhe na/ ji skad smras pa de bzhin du byed pa dang / bdag gi 'khrul pa la so sor rtog par byed kyi/gzhan gyi 'khrul pa la mi rtog pa dang / srog gi phyir yang gzhan dag la brnyas par mi byed pa dang / rnyed pa dang bkur sti 4thob pas kyang mtho bar mi 'dzin la ma thob pas kyang dma' bar mi 'dzin pa dang / sems can thams cad la yon gnas kyi sems bskyed de sbyin pa sbyin 9pa dang / bgo bsha'i ngang tshul can yin te/ chos la slob dpon cadape mkhyud mi byed pa dang / gzhan gyi bde bas dga' ba yin te phrag dog dang ser sna dang bral ba dang / sdug pa dang mi sdug pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba la 'gyod pa med pa ste/ klu'i bdag po chos brgyad po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i chos la yang dag par gzhol ba yin no/ /klu'i bdag po chos lnga dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bla na med 7pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi 8ldog pa yin te/ lnga gang zhe na/ pha 9rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su 58—331
