chos (1ribazhi dang ldan na 'khor ba la yang lta la mya ngan las 'das pa yang 5mi gnas pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na khams sna tshogs la yang rnam par lta la chos kyi dbyings las kyang mi g.yo'o / /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can rang bzhin med pas chos rang bzhin med par rtog du pa dang / chos rang bzhin med pas sems can rang bzhin med par rtog 4)pa dang / sems can rang bzhin med pas sangs rgyas kyi chos rang bzhin med par mos pa dang / sems can rang bzhin med pa la som nyi med cing the tsom 5nodang bral ba yin te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 'di bzhi dang ldan na khams sna tshogs la yang rnam par lta la chos kyi dbyings las kyang mi g.yo'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na don yang mi 'dor la gnod par yang kun du snang ngo / /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bsam pa mya ngan las 'das par song ba rnams yin/ sbyor ba 'khor bar song ba rnams ri niyin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su bskang ba la bsam pa song ba rnams yin/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi yul la yang kun tu 7 snang ba rnams yin te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 'di bzhi dang ldan na don yang mi 'dor la gnod par yang kun du snang ngo / /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na bsod nams kyis nanor dang ldan la thabs kyis 9nor med pa rnams yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rgya chen po la mos pa'i sems can 'dul ba'i phyir bsod nams kyis 'khor los sgyur 1 ba dang / brgya byin dang tshangs pa'i bsod nams kyang nye bar ston pa dang / 'gro ba phal pa 'dul ba'i phyir dbul zhing dman par yang nye 58—681

bar ston 1 pa dang / slong ba rigemathong na bdog pa thams cad gtong zhing /nor med par 55yang 'gyur ba dang / nor chen po dang ldan pa mthong na bsod nams kyis 4longs spyod zad mi shes par yang nye bar ston pa ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 'di bzhi dang ldan na bsod nams kyis (5)nor dang ldan pa yin la/ thabs kyis yinor med pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na a zhes bya ba'i sgos rnam pa med pa'i sgo la 'jug pa rnams yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'du byed thams cad mi rtag par shes pa sbyong ba nodang / 'du byed thams cad gzod (0ma nas sdug bsngal lo zhes byang chub rab 95tu rnyed pa dang / chos thams cad bdag med do zhes lta bar gyur pa yongs su sbyong ba 1 dang / mya ngan las 'das pa ni gzod 411ma nas zhi ba zhes ye shes la 'jug pa ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 'di bzhi dang ldan na/ a zhes bya ba'i sgos rnam pa med pa'i sgo la 'jug pa rnams yin no/ /rigs72kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams nyi cad mngon sum du 'gyur bas yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi mig shin tu rnam par dag pa rnams loyin / chos kyi mig gis snang ba thob pa rnams yin/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan mngon sum du gyur pa rnams yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la dbang bskur ba thob pa rnams tshayin te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 'di bzhi dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad 1 mngon sum du 'gyur ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na/ chos rnam par gdon mi za ba rnams la rnam par phye ba shin tu rnam par 'byed pa rnams yin no/ /58wa 682

bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ so so yang dag par rig pa shes pa 31sgrib pa med pa dang / bden pa bzhi kyirnam par dgod pa shes pa dang / rton57pa la gnas su shes pa dang / gzungs la g.yeng ba med par shes pa ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 'di bzhi dang ldan na chos rnam par gdon mi za ba rnams la rnam par phye ba shin tu rnam par 'byed pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na 'jig rten gyi bya ba dang / 'thunam par zhugs kyang nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis mi gos pa rnams yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'jig rten gyi chos mngon sum du gyur pa dang /'jig rten las sems can yang dag par sgrol ba du5dang / rjes su chags pa dang ske/ khong khro ba spong ba dang / gzod ma nas rnam par dag cing 'od gsal bas kyang rang bzhin gyis kun nasam nyon mongs pa med pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 7bzhi dang ldan na 'jig rten gyi bya ba dang 'thun cirapar zhugs kyang nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis mi gos pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na gzhan dag gis bltar mi mthong ba'i chos kyi dbang phyug rnams 9yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste / sems kyi dbang phyug dang / shes rab kyi dbang phyug dang / ye shes kyi dbang phyug dang / thabs kyi dbang phyug ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 'di bzhi dang ldan na gzhan dag gis bltar mi mthong ba'i chos kyi dbang phyug rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na/ de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba rnams yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can rnams sangs rgyas mthong ba yang dag 58—683

par 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / sems can rnams chos nyan pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / sems can rnams byang chub kyi sems yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang mi 'bral ba yin te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 'di bzhi dang ldan na de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na shin tu dul zhing mi 'khrugs pa'i chos can rnams yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'phags pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba 1ye shes mthong ba mngon sum du gyur pa dang / bden pa la nye bar brtags pas chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin pa dang / bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad yang dag par gcod pa la mkhas par gyur pa dang / nyon mongs pas mi 'khrugs pa'i chos can te/rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na shin tu dul zhing mi 'khrugs pa'i chos can rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na chos rnams blangs 2pa med par slob dpon rnams yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i dngos po phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba la brtan snyezhing bsam pa sgyu med pa rnams yin/ bdag gis bde ba la mi chags pa rnams yin/ gang ye shes yongs su tshol ba de yang / sems can thams cad kyi ched du yin gyi bdag 'ba' zhig 5gi phyir ma yin pa ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 'di bzhi dang ldan na chos rnams blangs 6pa med par slob dpon rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang 58—684

ldan na sems can thams cad kyi ston 17par gyur pa rnams yin nor/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bdag gi don gtongs zhing gzhan gyi don byed pa rnams yin / bdag gi bde ba thams cad gtong zhing / sems can rnams la chos kyi bde ba sbyin pa rnams yin/ ji ltar thos pa'i chos ston pa la ngal ba med pa rnams yin/ chos kyi 'tsho bas 'tsho'i 4)zang zing gis 'tsho ba ma yin pa ste/rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 'di bzhi dang ldan na sems can thams cad kyi rton 5par gyur pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rjes su bskor ba rnams yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gzungs rab tu thob pa dang / spobs pa rgyun mi 'chad 6pa dang / sems can gyi bsam pa shes pa la 'jug pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam du khrid cing mi phyed pa'i chos ston pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 'di bzhi dang ldan na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rjes su bskor ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la dbang bskur ba thob pa rnams yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ spyod pa thams cad las rab tu 'das pa rnams yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa las mi ldog cing mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob pa rnams yin / bsams 7bzhin du tshe dang / 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba yang ston la phyir mi ldog pa'i phyag rgyas kyang btab 8pa rnams yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya la yang dag par gzhol zhing sa bcur nges par byung na9ri/ sa nas sar 'phar ba la 1 mkhas pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos 'di 58—685

bzhi dang ldan na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la dbang bskur ba thob pa rnams yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhi pa bsgrub 37pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos nas snang ba chen pos kyang 'jig rten gyi nakhams khyab par gyur to/ /steng gi bar snang las lha bye ba khrag cikhrig brgya stong gis lha'i glu dbyangs blangs te/ lha'i me tog man dā ra ba'i 4char rab tu phab nas 'di skad ces kye ma'o bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bzhi pa bsgrub 5pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las bstan pa 'di ni bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa nas bsgrubs pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang bzhi pa sgrub 6pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan pa dang / mnyan nas mos pa dang / mos nas 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang /gzhan dag la yang ston pa dang / byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral ba'i sems can de dag ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ngan ngon dang ldan pa ma lags te/de dag ni ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas da ltar seng ge'i sgra sgrog pa bzhin du lha dang / mi dang / lha ma snyeyin gyi 'jig rten gyi mdun du seng ge'i sgra sgrog par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang bzhi pa bsgrub 7pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pas rnyed pa legs par rnyed do/ /zhes ched du rjod 8pa ched du brjod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhi pa bsgrub 9pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na/ lha dang mi'i srog chags brgyad khri bzhi stong ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 58—686

byang chub tu sems skyes 1so/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri nyis nastong ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lha'i cod pan gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di 'dzin pa dang / gzhan dag la rgya cher rab tu ston pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag chos du dang ldan par 'gyur/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di 'dzin pa dang /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag ni chos brgyad dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ de dag yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bsam pa nges te/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba dang / sems can thams cad la zhe sdang ba'i sems med de/ shin tu byams pa bsgom pa bsgoms par 'gyur ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba la gnas te/ snying rje chen po la gnas par 'gyur ba dang / chos 'dod de chos don du gnyer bar 'gyur ba dang /thos pa tshol bas mi ngoms te mtsho chen rgya mtsho lta bur 'gyur ba dang / lus dang srog 'dor zhing dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba brtan par 'gyur ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabasang kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ smon lam gyis yang dag par byung bar 'gyur ba dang / 'khor gyi nang du 'jigs pa med pas bdud dang phyir rgol ba bcom par 'gyur ba ste/ rigs kyi bu gang de bzhin 58—687

gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das 1pa'i mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di 'dzin pa dang ske/ gzhan dag la 2)rgya cher ston pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag ni chos brgyad po 'di dag dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na gang dag sa phyogs mthon dman can dang / ri nag po dang / chu mig dang /mtsho dang / lteng ka dang / rgya mtsho chen po de dag thams cad mi snang bar gyur to / /sa chen po 'di thams cad kyang lag mthilam ltar mnyam par gnas par gyur to/ /chu na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la yang gnod pa med par gyur tor / /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na shing skam 6)gang dag lo brgya lon pa de dag thams cad las kyang me tog dang / 'bras bu sna tshogs skyes par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su btud mngon par btud nas phyag 'tshal bar gyur to/ /de ma yin pa shing gzhan thams cad las kyang me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs skyes nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su btud mngon par btud nas phyag 'tshal bar gyur to/ /sa chen po las pad ma tshad shing rta'i 'khor lo tsam sna tshogs blta na sdug pa kha dog dang ldan pa dri dang 7ldan pa yid du 'ong ba skyes so/ /snang ba chen pos kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di gsalam bar gyur to/ /mi snang zhing ma dkrol bar steng gi bar snang las lha'i sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs kyi sgra byung ste grags par gyur to/ /ri'i rgyal po gangs can dang / ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang las kyang lha'i me tog sna tshogs sngon dri mi mnam pa 9rnams 58—688

kyang mchog gi dri langs par gyur te/ dri des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir dri zhim po bsnam 1par gyur to/ /ri'i rgyal po gangs can dang / ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang de las me tog gi char chen po bab ste/ de dag nabacom ldan 'das kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gang na ba der mngon par babs nas sa chen po 'dir me tog gi char de 5dag gis pus mo man cad lanub par gyur to/ /me tog gi shing de dag las me tog sna tshogs kyi char rab tu 'bab cing / sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs sna tshogs kyi sgra dag kyang byung ngo / /steng gi bar snang la rin po 5che sna tshogs kyi gdugs dpag tshad brgya stong phrag bcu'i tshad tsam kun du gnas par gyur to/ /rin po che'i gdugs de las mu tig gi do shal dang / rin po che'i dril bu g.yer ma'i dril bu sna tshogs kyi dra ba 'phyang zhibar gyur to/ /dril bu g.yer ma'i dra ba'i sgra yid du 'ong ba/yid dga' bar byed pa/ chags par byed pa des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di go bar byas par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā 7ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dga' bar bgyid pa/ mgu bar bgyid pa'i mtshan ma rgya chen po 'di lta bu 'di dang glu/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rgyan thams cad 8kyis brgyan par gyur pa gda' 9ba 'di su'i snga ltas lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 1 bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu 'di ni mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po ri 11spos kyi ngad ldang nas 'khor mi 'am ci stong phrag du ma dang 'khor dri za stong phrag du ma dang ske/ 'khor lha stong phrag du ma dang bcas te 'ong ba de'i snga ltas so/ /de skad 12gsungs ma thag tu de nas skad cig de la mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po sil 58—689

snyan dang / glu dbyangs len pa brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / 'khor brgya stong du mas bskor 1nas steng gi bar snang la me tog gi chu bo'i (55char 'bebs shing /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der 'ongs te phyin nas 'khor dang bcas pas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal 5te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar cami 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong 45)po bdag nyid kyis pi bang 6gi khog pa be+e drur+ya 7las byas pa/ 'dzam bu'i 87gling gi gser gyi sab le'u can/ sa le sbram dang / nor bu dang / rin po che du mas spras pa/sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas yongs su sbyangs pa blangs te/ sil snyan brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag dang lhan cig tu grag par byed do/ /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos pi bang 9de blangs ma thag tu de nas pi bang 1 tshogi sgra des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dbyangs kyis go bar gyur to/ /pi bang 1 gi sgra des 'dod pa na spyod pa'i rgyud kyi sgra dang / glu'i sgra dang / lha'i glu dbyangs kyi sgra rnams zil gyis mnan te mi gsal 12bar gyur to/ /de nas pi bang 12gi sgra 1 bskul bas 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu de dag gis/ lha'i rol mo bor te bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos pi bang 15de blangs ma thag tu de nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i shing dang / ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang / gangs can dang /spos kyi ngad ldang dang / btang bzung dang / btang bzung sachen po dang /de ma yin pa gzhan ri nag po rnams 1 dang / rtswa 18dang / shing gel pa dang /sman dang / nags tshal ji snyed pa de dag thams cad ldeg /rab tu ldeg /58wa 690

kun tu rab tu ldeg go/ /g.yo rab tu g.yo/ kun tu rab tu g.yo'o/ /'gul rab tu 'gul/ kun tu rab tu 'gul lo/ /'di lta ste dper na chang gis ra ro ba'i mi 'khyar1)/ rab tu 'khyar / kun tu rab tu 'khyar 3)ba de bzhin du shing de dag thams cad dang / ri thams cad kyang 'dud rab tu 'dud /kun tu rab tu 'dud do// //bam po gnyis pa/ mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos pi bang 5khog pa be+e drur+ya nelas byas pa blangs ma thag tu/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor der 7'dus pa'i nang nas phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma gtogs 2)par 'dod chags dang bral ba'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen 49rim dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang ske/ dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang ske/ lto 'phye chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa'i dgra bcom pa dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyis pi bang 1 cigi sgra de thos pa dang / pi bang 11gi sgra de ma bzod nas rang rang gi stan las langs te 'dar/ rab tu 'dar kun tu rab tu 'dar ro/ /'dud rab tu 'dud/ kun du rab tu 'dud do/ /gar byed 12rab tu gar byed1na/ kun du rab tu gar byed do/ /nyan thos chen po de dag thams cad kyang rang rang gi stan la mi dga' ste/ 'gul/ rab tu 'gul zhing spyod lam yang 'khrugs nas byis pa chung ngu bzhin du gar byed pa lta bur ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 1 lha'i cod pan gyis nyan thos chen po de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces 58wa 691

smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa nyan thos chen po dag nyon mongs pa dang bral ba/rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa bden pa bzhi mthong bar gyur pa yin na / ci'i phyir rang gi lus 'jog par mi nus shing / tshe dang ldan pa dag gyis pa chung ngu bzhin du gar byed pa lta bur 1ston/ nyan thos chen po de dag gis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos pi bang na'adi blangs pa dang /sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs sbyar bas pi bang gi sgra des bdag cag la dbang med par bdag cag gi lus/ rang rang gi stan la 'dug par mi dga' zhing la'adar / rab tu 'dar/ kun du rab tu 'dar te/ sems rnam par gzhag 5par yang ma nus so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis gnas brtan 'od srung chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa 'od srung chen po rgas gtugs 'khogs pa/ 'dod pa nyung ba chog shes pa/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan 'dzin pa dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod rten du gyur pa yin na/ ci'i phyir rang gi lus 'dzin par mi nus shing ske/ gnas brtan du gyur kyang byis pa chung ngu bzhin du gar byed pa lta bur piston / gnas brtan 'od srung chen pos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu dper na dmu rlung phyad pa'i rlung langs pa na shing dang / nags dang / ri thams cad gang snyegis bdag rnam par gzhag 7pa'i stobs med mthu med de/ de dag thams cad mi 'dod bzhin du g.yo rab tu g.yo/ 'gul rab tu 'gul lo/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du gang 'di mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos pi bangs blangs pa de'i sgra thos pas bdag cag dmu rlung phyad pas ri chen po bdas 9pa bzhin du bdag 'dzin ma nus par gyur to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ skyes bu dam pa 'di'i smon 58—692

lam dang / bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi khyad 17par ni 'di 'dra ste/ des nyan thos kyi bsod nams dang ye shes dang / gzi brjid thams cad zil gyis non to/ /byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dpal dang /gzi brjid dang / stobs la gang gi phyir pi bang 3gi sgra des bskul riba'am/ bskyod par 4mi nus pas btsun pa 'od srung chen po su zhig bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 5sems mi skyed6)/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang nyi che'i ye shes dang ldan pa rnams kyi stobs dang / gzi brjid de ni pi bang tsho7)gi sgra 'dis zil gyis non to/ /gang theg pa chen po la zhugs pa rnams kyi stobs dang ske/ gzi brjid de la ni zil gyis gnon par mi nus pa la ltos/ de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos pi bang 8gi sgra de sgrog pa na sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi byin gyi rlabasamatsho kyis pi bang 7de dang sil snyan brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag las tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag byung ngo ske/ /tha ma 'bring dang de bzhin mchog rnams kyi/ /chos rnams thams cad mnyam zhing chos rnams dben/ /zhi ba stong pa mi 'gyur 'khrugs pa med/ /gzod 11nas dag ste dri med nam mkha' bzhin/ /gang dag da ltar gyi dang 'das pa yi/ /sems can kun mnyam sems can sems can med/ /sems can skad du sgra rnams 'byung ba yang / /chos kyi sgra dang mtshungs te de yang med/ /zhing rnams 12thams cad zhing mnyam zhing min te/ /bar snang dang ni mtshungs shing mnyam par snang / /'phel 1 ba ma yin mi zad ma skyes te/ /gsob gsog nam mkha' lta bur rnam par dag /sangs rgyas kun mnyam sangs rgyas sangs 58—693

rgyas min1/ /chos dbyings nges par 'dres pa med pa ste/ /tshul khrims shes rab ye shes rnam grol mnyam/ /mtshan nyid gcig ste tsho mtshan mnyam mtshan nyid med / /nyon mongs thams cad nyon mongs ma yin grol/ /rtog dang rtog pa kun rtog rnam par rtog /nang na rgyu ba ma yin phyi rol min/ /'du shes mdud pa phyin ci log las gyur/ /rnam par rtog pas chos dbyings ming btags sgyu pa/ /ming de nyid kyang gzhan min de bzhin min/ /ming dang gzugs kyi rang bzhin rjes rtogs pa/ /de dag rtag tu mi chags 'jig rten spyod/ /gang rnams 'das pa'i bde gshegs grangs med pa/ /de dag gis ni gang gsungs chos mang po / /gzod 5nas zad cing dengs dang 'jigs las dben/ /de dag yul dang phyogs su 'gro ma yin/ /chos 'di dag ni yi ge las byung ste/ /yi ge gang dag zad can zad pa'i chos/ /yi ge zad pa'i chos nyid shes pas na/ /chos rnams kun la rnam par rtog mi byed/ /sems kyi rgyud ni rgyud mnyam rgyud ma yin//rang bzhin gzhan dang gzhan te chags pa med/ /sems dang sems byung chos mtha' med shes pas/ /'phags pa rnams ni mnyam pa'i chos la 'jug /mtha' dang mtha' med kun chad rnam par chad/ /thog ma tha ma bar ma mnyam gyur pa/ /dus gsum dag ni dben pas shes pa mnyam/ /shes pa de yang mtha' yod ma yin no/ /skye bo rtag tu ming dang gzugs la chags/ /mtha' dang mtha' med lta bas gos pa rnams/ /rgyu dang rkyen las byung bar shes pas na//bdag dang sems can rnam par rtog ma yin/ /bdag las ldang ba rtag tu ldang ma yin/ /chos de kun nas 6bslang ba med pa ste/ /gang dag ldang dang ldang ba med rtog 7pa/ /de dag bzod pa mnyam nyid rjes 'thun pa/ /chos kun rtag 58—694

tu bdag med rang bzhin te/ /sprin dang glog dang nam mkha' lta bu tsho1gsog /bdag dang sems can rtag tu rang bzhin stong / /'di ni gzungs kyi phyag rgyar ge'ajug pa'o/ /chos rnams mtshan nyid gcig ste ri mtshan nyid med/ /gang gis thar pa'i sgo gsum rnam rtogs nas/ /thug pa med pa'i chos rnams ston byed kyang ske/ /chos la yongs su rtog palo tshomi byed do/ /tha ma 'bring dang de bzhin mchog rnams kyi/ /chos 'di dag ni yi ge las byung ste/ /yi ge rnams la rnam par rtog mi byed/ /de lta bur ni don rnams bshad pa yin/ /don dngalo5)tshig 'bru gnyis la mi 'jug ste/ /gnyis med rtag tu don ni sgra dang bral/ /gang gis mtha' 'di dben par shes pa ni/ / de yis46)sngon gyi mtha' ni nye bar chad/ /gang dag sngon mtha' 7nye bar chad pa rnams/ /'gro ba'i don du 'dus byas rnams la spyod/ /yang dag mtha' ni rtag tu mtha' med shes/ / de yims)byams dang snying rje shin tu dag /gang gi byams dang snying rje rnam dag pa/ /sdug bsngal dang ni bde ba mtshungs mnyam sbyor/ /rgod dang khengs pa ma yin brtan pa yi/ /skyes bu mchog de don gyi cho ga shes/ /chos kyi tshul 'di zhi zhing dben pa ste/ / 'chang ba 49na ni dga' ba 'thob 1 par 'gyur/ /nam yang 'phel ba med cing 'bri ba med/ /chos nyid 'di ni ngar 11'dzin med cing zhi/ /bar snang lam gyi sgra ni gzung 12med de/ /gang gis bshad pa med kyang grags par gyur / /gang gis bshad dang gang la bshad pa rnams/ /de dag thams cad dbang can brdzunal pa yin/ /tshigs su bcad pa mngon par bsgrubs nya ripa 'di bshad pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' brgya 5stong mi skye ba'i chos la bzod 9pa rab tu thob par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' 58wa 695

lha'i cod pan gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta bu 'di dag ga las byung / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu khyod kyis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po 1 la dris shig dang / des de'i lan glon par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po tshigs su bcad pa mngon par bsgrub napa 'di dag ga las byung / smras pa/sems can thams cad kyi sgra ga salas byung ngo / /smras pa/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po sems can thams cad kyi sgra ga las byung / smras pa/ rigs kyi bu sems can thams cad kyi sgra ni nam mkha' las 'byung ngo / /smras pa/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po sems can thams cad kyi sgra khong pa'i nang nas mi 'byung ngam/ smras pa / rigs kyi bu de la ji snyam 5du sems/ sems can thams cad kyi sgra lus kyi nang gi khong nas byung ngam/ 'on te sems las 'byung / smras pa/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po lus las kyang ma yin/ sems las kyang ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lus ni bems po 7g.yo ba med pa/ byed pa med pa rtswa dang bong ba dang rtsig pa dang / shing dang / mig yor lta bu'o/ /sems ni gzugs med pa / bstan du med pa/ thogs pa med pa/ rnam par rig pa med pa ste/ sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /smras pa/ rigs kyi bu lus dang sems ma gtogs par gzhan gang nas sgra 'byung bar 'gyur/ smras pa/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po sems can rnams kyi sgra ni yid la byed pa las 'byung bar btags so/ /smras pa/ gal te nam mkha' med na sgra ga las 'byung / smras pa/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po nam mkha' ma gtogs par gzhan gang nas sgra 'byung bar 'gyur/ smras pa/ rigs 58—696

kyi bu de'i phyir rnam grangs 'dis sgra ji snyed pa de dag thams cad ni nam mkha' las 'byung bar rig par bya'o/ /nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid ni sgra ste(17/ rnam par rig ma thag tu 'gag go/ /'gags nas nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid du yang dag khuganasamo so/ /de'i phyir chos thams cad ni nam mkha' dang mnyam zhes bya ste rnam par rig pa med pa rnam par shes par 2)bya ba ma yin mod kyi sgra dang sgra'i brdas brjod do/ /brjod pa de yang tha snyad do/ /gang sgras brjod ra pa 'di 'dra bar rab tu shes pa de ni chos gang la yang mngon par mi chags so/ /gang mngon par mi chags pa de ni rnam par 6)mi 'phro'o/ /gang rnam par mi 'phro ba de mi 'khor ro/ /gang mi 'khor ba de mi phyed pa'o/ /gang mi phyed pa de mi skye'o//gang mi skye ba de mi 'jig par 'dod do/ /gang mi 'jig ri pa de dang ba'orinani/ /gang dang bte ride dag pa'o/ /gang dag pa de dri ma med pa'o/ /gang dri ma med pa de 'od gsal ba'o/ /gang 'od gsal ba de sems kyi rang bzhin no/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 1 rigang yin pa de 'jug pa'o/ /gang 'jug pa de mtshan ma thams cad gnon pa'o/ /gang mtshan ma thams cad gnon pa de skyon med pa la 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med pa la 'jug pa gang yin pa de ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob pa ste/ des na skyon med pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob pa zhes bya'o / /gang bzod pa rab tu thob pa des thams cad bzod de/ de stong par yang bzod de gang zag tu yang bzod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang zag las stong pa gzhan ma yin te/ 11gang zag nyid stong pa'o/ /de mtshan mar yang bzod de mtshan ma sna med par bzod pa'o / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mtshan ma'i ngo 58—697

bo nyid mtshan ma med pa'o/ /de smon par yang bzod/ de smon pa med patuyang bzod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ smon lam gyi ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid smon pa med pa'o/ /de sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das par yang bzod de sems can rnams 'chi 'pho7ba dang skye bar yang bzod do / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'chi 'pho dang skye ba ni sgyu ma'i ngo bo nyid do/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar ④mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni 'gag pa med pa ste/ chos thams cad dang 'gal ba med pa yin no/ /bdag bzod pa'i rjes su 'gro yang sems can thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro bas kyang 'gro/ bdag bzod pa〈perjes su 'gro yang chos thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro bas kyang 'gro ste/ 'ong ba yang meda')/ 'gro ba yang 6)med do/ /chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings la gnas par yang yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /ji ltar chos kyi dbyings la gnas pa de ltar sems can thams cad gnas te/ gang gi gnas de 'thobasnyepa'i gnas med pa'i tshul gyis rjes su thob pa de sgra'i brda'i tha snyad kyi sgra nye bar bzung nas/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa ni gang gis kyang brjod pa'am / bsnyad pa'am/ bstan par mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ don de ni brjod du med pa/ sgra med pa/ bshad du med pa yin yang brjod du med pa'i don brjod pas bstan pa 'di ni〈)rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i che ba nyid do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kye77ma mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po 'di ji tsam du chos zab mo la bzod pa ston par spobs pa dang / 'di 58—698

lta bur rgya che ba'i yul la nye bar spyod cing longs spyod pas 'byor ba dang / chos ston pas zab mo'i bzod pa 'di lta bu dang ldan pa ni ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed cig la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun na des 'di spobs pa 'di lta bu grub par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi skar ma'i gzugs ji snyed pa bgrang ba'i tshul gyis tshad gzung 37bar nus sam/ de bzhin du mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po 'dis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed cigashosal dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub btsal gaba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi gan na tshangs par spyod pa spyad pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag kyang tshad gzung 4bar mi nus te/ des na 'di'i spobs pa 'di 'dra'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po khyod de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mang po de dag las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa'i 5dge ba'i rtsa ba mang po de lta bu bsdoms pas ci bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'am / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par sgrub pa na/ gang dag gis nam phyi du yang ngoms par mi 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mi ngoms pa bcu gnyis po 7)'di dag ste/ bcu gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin 58—699

gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / rim gro bya bas mi ngoms pa dang / chos mnyan pas mi ngoms pa dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung 1)bas mi ngoms pa dang /chos rgya cher rab tu bstan pas mi ngoms pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya bas mi ngoms pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bsgrub napas mi ngoms pa dang / dgon dpa la gnas pas mi ngoms pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su bskang bas mi ngoms pa dang / ye shes mngon par rab tu dang zhing 4yongs su smin par bya bas mi ngoms pa dang / chos nges par sems 5shing tshul bzhin la rab tu sbyor bas mi ngoms pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su btsalas6bas mi ngoms pa dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad yang dag par bsgrub 7pas mi ngoms pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bsgrub 8pa na gang dag nam du yang ngoms par mi 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mi ngoms pa bcu gnyis te/ des na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dge ba'i tshogs bsags pa la mi ngoms pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes 9bgyi ba mchis te/ byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin de la brten na yon tan rin po che'i khyad par gyi chos thams cad 'thob 1 tshopar 'gyur ro zhes bgyi ba zhig bdag gis thos na/ bcom ldan 'das gang thos pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams yon tan rin po che'i khyad par gyi chos thams cad 'thob 11par 'gyur bar bgyi ba'i slad du/ byang chub sems dpa'i 1 ting nge 'dzin dkon mchog 'byung 58—700

gnas de bzhin gshegs pas legs par bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 1 bka' stsal pa/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po de'i phyir shin tu na legs par nyon la yid la zung shig ridang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dkon mchog 'byung gnas ngas 4khyod la bshad do/ /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po 'di la byang chub sems dpa' ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog rgyun mi 'chad 5pa dang / chos dkon mchog rgyun mi 'chad 6pa dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog rgyun mi 'chad 7par bya ba'i phyir sems bskyed pa rin po che brgyad cu napo 'di dag la 'jug go/ /brgyad cu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ de thams 9cad mkhyen pa'i sems rin po che mi brjid 1 pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa'i sems rin po che mi gtong ba dang / dge ba rin po che thams cad kyi sems mi 'dor ba dang / dge ba rin po che thams cad la rab tu sbyor ba'i sems mi 'dor ba dang / yi dam la brtan pa'i sems rin po che yongs su mi 'dor ba dang ske/ bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba'i sems rin po che byang chub tu yongs su sngo 11bas rnam par smin pa la mi re ba'i sems rin po che la 'jug pa dang ske/ mi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa gsum rnam par spangs pas/ lus kyi rgyan gyi sems rin po che dang / ngag gi skyon rnam pa bzhi rnam par spangs pas ngag gi rgyan 12gyi sems rin po che dang / brnab sems dang gnod sems dang log par lta ba dang bral bas sems kyi rgyan gyi sems rin po che dang / tshul khrims ma nyams shing skyon med de 'dren ma ma yin zhing thun tshags ma yin pas tshul khrims 58wa 701

kyi rgyan gyi sems rin po che dang / sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pas khong khro ba med pa'i sems rin po che dang / sems can thams cad kyis nyes par byas pa la ci 17mi snyam napas bzod pa dang nges pa'i sems rin po che dang ske/ byang chub kyi yan lag la lta bas lus dang srog la mi ltas ba'i sems rin po che dang / mtho dman med pas rjes su chags capa dang khong khro ba dang bral ba'i sems rin po che dang / zhum pa med pas brtson 'grus brtan pa'i go cha'i sems rin po che dang / lhod pa med pa'i brtson pa thams cad nyams 'og tu chud par byed pa'i sems rin po che dang / byang chub kyi lam gyi tshogs bsags pas dran pa dang / blo gros dang / rtogs pa dang / ngo tsha shes pa dang mos pa brjid 5pa med pa'i sems rin po che dang / sems la dbang byed pas bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dang bskyed pa'i sems rin po che dang / dam pa'i chos bsags pas chos yongs su tshol ba'i sems rin po che dang / 'jigs pa med cing spobs pas thos pa 'dzin pa'i sems rin po che dang / sdig pa 'dod pa 6med pas zang zing med par chos ston pa'i sems rin po che dang / chags pa'i sems med pas slob dpon chos mi 'chab pa'i sems rin po che dang / nan tan snying por byed pas tshul bzhin du yang 7yid la byed pa'i sems rin po che dang / de ltar byed pas ji ltar thos pa'i chos rnams la nan tan byed pa'i sems rin po che dang ske/ gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pas shes rab kyis so sor rtog pa'i sems rin po che dang / sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab pas byams pa chen po'i sems rin po che dang / sems can thams cad la lta bas snying rje chen po'i 58—702

sems rin po che dang / chos la dga' mos dad pas dga' ba chen po'i sems rin po che dang / chos thams cad nges par sems pas btang snyoms chen po'i sems rin po che dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pas 'khor ba na yongs su mi skyo ba'i sems rin po che dang / bdag gi bde ba la mi chags pas sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed pa'i sems rin po che 1dang / chos 'dzin pas lderabasdu ba'i dngos po'i sems rin po che dang / thams cad du rnam par 'phrul pas mngon par shes pa chen po'i sems rin po che dang / ma thos pa'i chos mnyan pa'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten 3pa'i sems rin po che dang ske/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sogs 4pas sdig pa'i grogs po spong ba'i sems rin po che dang / tha dad pa med pas sems can thams cad la sbyor ba mnyam pa'i sems rin po che dang / sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa la 'jug pas/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i nad yongs su shes pa'i sems rin po che dang / sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i nad rab tu zhi bar byed pas chos kyi sman thams cad yongs su tshol ba'i sems rin po che dang ske/ chos kyi bdag nyid pas ma bslabs 5pa rnams la mi brnyas pa'i sems rin po che dang / sems can thams cad la 'dud pas nga rgyal med pa'i sems rin po che dang / 'chos 6pa med pa'i 7g.yo dang sgyu med pa'i sems rin po che dang ske/ dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas 8pas chos la dga' ba'i sems rin po che dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la byas pa gzo bas dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i sems rin po che dang / brtan pa'i grogs po'i phyir byas pa shes shing byas pa 9gzo ba'i sems rin po che dang / ltos pa med pas lan du phan 58—703

'dogs pa la mi re ba'i sems rin po che dang / dkar po'i phyogs srung 1)bas dgon pa la dga' ba'i sems rin po che dang / las byas pa chud mi gson pas rtag tu rab tu 'byung ba'i sems rin po che dang / sdom pa'i spyod pa sogs rimipas 'phags pa'i rigs la dga' ba'i sems rin po che dang / sems can thams cad mgu bar byed pas sbyangs pa'i yon tan thams cad dang yo /byad bsnyungs pa'i sems rin po che dang / shes rab kyis mi ngoms pas 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa'i sems rin po che dang / lus dang sems dben pas dga' ba la 4dben pa'i sems rin po che dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po yongs su rdzogs par byed pas bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis mi ngoms pa'i sems rin po che dang / sems can thams cad kyi the tshom gcad 5pa'i phyir ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su tshol ba'i sems rin po che dang / sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sems rin po che dang /chos mnyan pa dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir chos rjes su dran pa'i sems rin po che dang ske/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la gzhol ba'i phyir dge 'dun rjes su dran pa'i sems rin po che dang / byang chub kyi sems las mi g.yo ba'i phyir tshul khrims rjes su dran pa'i sems rin po che dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad yongs su bor bas gtong ba rjes su dran pa'i sems rin po che dang / skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rjes su dran pa'i phyir lha rjes su dran pa'i sems rin po che dang / mtshungs par byed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rjes su dran pa'i sems rin po che dang / don thams cad rtogs pas don so so yang dag par rig pa'i sems rin po che dang / chos kyi dbyings 58—704

'dres pa med pas (1chos so so yang dag par rig pa'i sems rin po che dang /sems can gyi tshig thams cad rtogs pas nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa'i sems rin po che dang / tshig 'bru'i rang bzhin rjes su rtogs pas spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa'i sems rin po che dang / rnam par shes pa sgyu ma lta bur yongs su shes pa'i tshul gyis ye shes la rton tshon/pa'i sems rin po che dang /bkri ba'i don gyi mdo sde las dang bya ba dang 'gal bas nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde la rtonas ripa'i sems rin po che dang / gang zag gi rang bzhin rjes su rtog pas chos nyid la rton pa'i sems rin po che dang / khams gsum thams cad la mngon par zhen pas 'jigs pa'i phyir 'du byed thams cad la mi rtag pa dang /sdug bsngal bar so sor rtog pa'i sems rin po che dang / sems can thams cad la bdag med pas chos thams cad la bdag med par so sor rtog pa'i sems rin po che dang / 'dod pa'i khams las 5)shin tu 'da' bas mi gtsang bar so sor rtog pa'i sems rin po che dang / shin tu zhi zhing nye bar zhi bas mya ngan las 'das pa la zhi bar so sor rtog pa'i sems rin po che dang / bdud rtsi'i sgo la yang dag par gzhol bas rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la mos pa'i sems rin po che dang /mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob pas chos thams cad la ma skyes pa dang ma byung bas 6mos pa'i sems rin po che dang / lta ba thams cad la mngon par zhen pa med pas chos thams cad la sgyu ma dang / smig 7rgyu dang / chu zla dang /mig yor dang / rmi lam lta bur yang dag par gzhol ba'i 8sems rin po che dang ske/ rtag pa dang chad pa dang bral bas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang 58—705

'thun 1pa'i sems rin po che dang / gnyis dang bral bas mthar lta ba thams cad sel ba'i sems rin po che dang / theg pa gcig tu khong du chud pas gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'i sems rin po che dang / skyon med pa la 'jug pas spyod pa thams cad las ldog pa'i sems rin po che dang / chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir yang dag par skyon med pa la so sor rtog pa'i sems rin po che dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i phyir byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad yang dag par sgrub pa'i sems rin po che ste/'di dag ni chos rin po che brgyad cu'o/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po de ltar gang chos brgyad cu po 'di la 'jug pa dang thob pa dang / nan tan byed pa de ni dkon mchog 'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /chos 'di dag ni ting nge 'dzinang sgrub pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpas gang gi tshe dkon mchog 'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin 'di rab tu thob par gyur pa de'i tshe/ des gang la dbang thob par ma gyur pa'i rin po che'i 'jig rten gyi'am/ 'jig rten las 'das pa de gang yang med do / /mi 'am ci'i bdag po de la 'jig rten gyi rin po che ni gang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rin po che ni gang zhe na/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po de la 'jig rten gyi rin po che ni 'di lta ste/ lha dang mi rnams kyi che ba nyid dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa'i che ba nyid dang / 'jig rten skyong ba'i che ba nyid dang / 'khor los sgyur 5ba'i che ba nyid 'dang / tshong dpon dang ske/ khyim bdag dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs shing sā 7la chen po lta bu'i che ba nyid do/ /de de ltar lha dang mi rnams kyi che ba nyid rab tu thob kyang rgyags pa 8mi skyed/ bag med pa mi skyed rdo9/ /de bag yod par gyur pas/58—706

byang chub sgrub par byed pa'i chos rnams yang dag par bsgrub pa71 ste/ 'di ni 'jig rten gyi rin po che zhes bya'o/ /de la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rin po che gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rin po che'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos mirin po che gang zhe na/ chos gang 'jig rten las sgrol ba'o/ /'jig rten las sgrol ba'i chos gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/'phags pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab ste/ shes rab kyi riri'ajig rten las sgrol lo/ /shes rab rin po ches ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thams cad bsdus te/ shes rab ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi gtso bo yin no/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po 'di lta ste dper na klung thams cad kyi gtso bo ni rgya mtsho chen po'o/ /ri thams cad kyi gtso bo ni ri'i rgyal po ri rab bo/ /skar ma thams cad kyi gtso bo ni zla ba'o/ /snang ba thams cad kyi gtso bo ni nyi ma'ol/ /ri dgas thams ri cad kyi gtso bo ni seng ge'o/ /skye dgu 5thams cad kyi gtso bo ni rgyal po'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa thams cad kyi gtso bo ni brgya 6byin no/ /tshangs pa la dbang du bya ba rnamasam kyi gtso bo ni tshangs pa chen po'o/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po de bzhin du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi gtso bo ni shes rab ste/ de'i phyir shes rab ni chos thams cad kyi rgyal po zhes bya'ol/ /mu stegasam la gnas pa bsgral ba'i phyir bde bar 'gro bas lam mo/ /nyon mongs pa'i mun pa sel ba'i phyir sgron 9ma'o/ /g.yul las rgyal ba'i phyir dpa' bo'o/ / /sman rab tu sbyor ba'i phyir sman pa'o/ /gtsug lag thams cad shes pa'i phyir slob 11dpon no/ /chos thams cad phigs pa'i 12phyir mda'o/ /nyon mongs pa gcod pa'i phyir ral gri'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i tshang tshing dral ba'i 58—707

phyir thong gshol lo/ /mnyam pa'i phyir mi 'gal ba'o1ri/ /'thab pa med pa'i phyir rtsod pa med pa'o/ /'byung ba med pa'i phyir mi 'gag pa'o/ /bden pa'i don rnams yongs su shes pa'i mthar thug pa'i phyir mi 'khrugs pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhog pa'i phyir dran pa'o/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams la mnyam pa nyid do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang napa rnams bskyed 5pa'o/ /dbang po rnams sbed pa'o / /stobs rnams kyis mi rdzi ba'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams rjes su rtog pa'o/ /lam ston pa'o/ /zhi gnas zhi bar byed pa'o/ /lhag mthong rig par byed pa'o/ /rab rib med pa'i phyir snang bar byed pa'o/ /chos kyi snang bas mun pa sel ba'o/ /rdul dang bral ba'i phyir rdul med pa'o/ / brnyas thabs 5dang bral ba'i phyir mtho bar sems pa med pa'o/ /ya nga ba'i lam las rab tu 'das pa'i phyir kun tu mthong bar byed pa'o/ /phyi nang dang bral ba'i phyir yul med pa'o/ /lta bas byas pa med pa'i phyir stong pa sgrol ba'o/ /rnam par rtog pa nye bar zhi ba'i phyir/ mtshan ma med pas rab tu phye ba'o/ /khams gsum pa las rnam par 'das pa'i phyir smon pa med pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i phyir mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i phyir nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do/ /bdud kyi las dang bral ba'i phyir g.yo ba dang rlom sems 'joms sgyu pa'o/ /mi rtog pa'i sbyin pa'o/ /mi gnas pa'i tshul khrims so//rab tu mi gnas pa'i bzod pa'o/ / blang ba 7med pa dang dor ba 8med pa'i brtson 'grus so/ /sgro btags pa med pa'i bsam gtan 9no/ /rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i sgo'o/ /thams cad la mngon du phyogs 1 pa'o/ /thabs dang 'brel ba'o11/ /sems can la bdag med par yang dag par gzhol ba'o/ /58—708

dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa'o/ /bya ba med pa'o/ /bya 1)ba dang bral ba ste/ mi 'amar /ci'i bdag po 'di ni shes rab rin po che'o/ /shes rab rin po che 'di ni dkon mchog 'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i byang chub sems dpas 'thob 3bo / /'di 'thob 3pa na 5rin po che thams cad yang dag par 'du ba yin no/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po 'di lta ste/ dper na chu bo 3thams cad kyi sgo ni rgya mtsho chen po ste/ rin po che thams cad sogasar pa rin po che thams nacad yang dag par 'du ba ste/ de las rin po che thams cad 'byung ngo / /mi 'am ci'i bdag po de bzhin du dkon mchog 'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pa'i 9byang chub sems dpa' yang rin po che thams cad kyi sgo yin te/ chos dkon mchog thams cad sogs 1 pa rin po che thams cad yang dag par 'du ba'o/ /dkon mchog 'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin las dkon mchog gsum 'byung ste/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog go / / des na 11dkon mchog 'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin ni rin po che thams cad sogs 12pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis 1lha'adi skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po 'dis 1 dkon mchog 'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin 'di thob pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 5bka' stsal pa/ rigs sakyi bu khyod kyis 1 de mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po la dris 1ldeshig dang des 19khyod la ston par 'gyur rol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po khyod kyis na chodakon mchog 'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin 'di thob bam/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu ting nge 58—709

'dzin 'di ni 17thob pa 'am/ dmigs par so sor nye bar gnas pa ma yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin 'di ni sus kyang mi thob bo/ /ting nge 'dzin 'di ni gzugs su bgrang ba'am/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes par bgrang ba ma yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin 'di ni gzugs su snang ba ma yin no / /ting nge 'dzin 'di ni mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /lus dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i gzung ba ma yin/ skye ba'i mtshan nyid ma yin/ 'jig (2pa'i mtshan nyid ma yin/ gnas pa'i mtshan nyid ma yin/rgyun 'chad dpa'i mtshan nyid ma yin/ mtshan nyid gcig pa ma yin/ mtshan nyid tha dad pa ma yin/ mtshan nyid ma yin/ mtshan nyid dang bral ba ma yin/mtshan nyid med pa yang ma yin te/ brjod par bya ba ma yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin 'di ni yongs su rtogs 3par mi nus te/ kun tu rtogs par ma yin rnam par rtogs 5par ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gal te ting nge 'dzin 'di yongs su rtogs pa'am/ kun tu rtogs pa'am/ rnam par rtogs par gyur khya na ni brtag 7pa'i gzhi nyid du 'gyur gyi ting nge 'dzin ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba ni chos thams cadaman mnyam pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid gang yin pa de dang ngas9mnyam mo/ /de dang sems can thams cad kyang mnyam mo/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir ting nge 'dzin 'di dang sems can thams cad mnyam mo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can thams cad ni stong pa ste/ stong pa'i mtshan nyid ni ting nge 'dzin 'di'o/ /sems can thams cad ni mtshan nyid med pa ste/ mtshan nyid med pa'i mtshan nyid ni ting nge 'dzin 'di'o/ /sems can thams cad ni smon pa med pa ste/ smon pa med 58—710

pa'i mtshan nyid ni ting nge 'dzin 'di'o/ /sems can thams cad ni dben pa ste / dben pa'i mtshan nyid ni ting nge 'dzin 'di'o/ /sems can thams cad ni bdag med pa ste/ bdag med pa'i mtshan nyid ni ting nge 'dzin 'di'o/ /de ni lus dang ngag dang sems kyis reg 11par mi nus so/ /gang la la dag chos la reg par byed pa dang / mnyam par byed pa dang / mngon par mnyam par byed pa de dag thams cad ni legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la nga rgyal can du bstan 5)to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i spyod pa bag mchis pa 'di lta bu dang / chos la spobs pa 'di lta bu ni ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu bya ba thams cad kyang kun tu ston la bya ba thams cad kyis kyang mi gos pa 'di ni thabs dang shes rab las byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sa'o/ /rigs kyi bu mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po 'dis rgyud kyi sgra dang / glu'i /sgra dang /sil snyan dang / pheg rdob 4pa byas pa'i tshul 'dis ri mi 'am ci ne bye ba phrag bdun bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas sol/ /dri za bye ba phrag sum cu bla na med pa yang dag param rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas so/ /lto 'phye chen po bye ba phrag bzhi bcu yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas so/ /rang gi 'khor gyi srog chags brgyad khri bzhi stong yang byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas so/ /shes rab dang thabs kyi ye shes 'di dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni gang dang gang gi tshe 'khor gyi che ba nyid thob pa de dang de'i tshe/ sems 58—711

can grangs med dpag tu med pa yongs su smin par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na rgyu med par me mi 'bar ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 1chen po dben pa na gnas pa yang sems can yongs su smin par bya ba mi 'bar ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na rgyu yod na me 'bar ro/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skye bo 2phal po che'i nang na 'dug na/ sems can yongs su sbyin par bya ba 'bar ro/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir rnam grangs 'dis 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' ji lta ji lta bur yul dang 'khor chen po 'byor par gyur pa/ de lta de lta bur sems can dpag tu med pa yongs su smin par byed par rig par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos rgyud kyi sgra dang / glu'i sgra dang / sil snyan dang /pheg rdob 4pa bgyis pas sems can yongs su smin par bgyid/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu mi 'am ci dang / dri za dang / lto 'phye chen po glu dang / rol mo'i dbyangs sgra la mos pa rnams la mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos gang gi tshe pi bang 5gi sgra thos par byed cing sil snyan dang / glu snyedabyangs sbyor ba de na 0mi 'am ci dang / dri za dang / lto 'phye chen po de dag dga' ba dang / rab tu mgu ba chen po 'thob 7bo/ /de dag dga' ba dang /mos pa dang / rab tu mgu ba thob nas rgyud kyi sgra dang / sil snyan gyi sgra dang /glu dbyangs kyi sgra de dag las sangs rgyas kyi sgra 'byung ngo / /chos kyi sgra dang dge 'dun gyi sgra 'byung ngo / /byang chub kyi sems la dga' ba dang / thams 8cad 58—712

mkhyen pa'i sems bskyed par sbyor ba'i sgra 'byung ngo / /sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang /shes rab kyi sgra 'byung ngo / /byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang /btang snyoms kyi sgra dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag 1pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi narkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang /byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong dang /bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i sgra 'byung ngo / /mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang /bdag med pa'i sgra 'byung ngo / /stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa dang / mngon par 'du byed pa med pa dang / skye ba med pa dang ske/ 'byung ba med pa dang / dngos po med pa'i sgra 'byung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' )sde snod kyi chos kyi rnam grangs dang / gzungs dang rdo rje'i tshig dang ske/ 'khor gsum yongs su sbyong ba'i sgra 'byung ngo / /phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i sgra dang / chos thams cad la rnam par gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / chos thams cad la yang dag par gzhol ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang /chos thams cad la dbang byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / rnam par bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / rin chen sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang /rin chen 'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / rin chen brtsegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / nyon mongs pa spong ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang /dga' byed cating nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / pad ma bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra 58—713

dang ske/ pad ma bla ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / nam mkha'i 1)mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i ting nge na/'dzin gyi sgra dang la/ dam pa'i chos puṇ+ḍa rī ku'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / khyad (4)par can gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / rnam par rgyal bar dbang byedango5rating nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / cher bsgyings 6ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / rnam pa la sems dbang byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / seng ge bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / nyi ma sgron 7ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / mtha' yas 'khyil pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / rgyun gyi rjes su song ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / rdo rje'i nadakyil 'khor ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / rdo rje lte ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / sa 'dzin ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / ri rab sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / ri rab rgyal mtshan ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang ske/ rin chen mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / sems la dbang byed ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / sems can thams cad kyi sems la rnam par lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / spyod pa thams cad kyi yul las nges par (9)'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / zab mo sbed par sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang ske/ spobs pa sna tshogs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / bltar 1 rimi mthong ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra 1 dang / chos thams cad la rnam par lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / rnam par rol ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / mngon par shes pa thams cad las nges par 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'jig pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / gzugs thams cad kun 58—714

tu ston pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / sgra thams cad la 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / lus thams cad rnam par gzhig pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang ske/ spyod pa nyu)thams cad la dbang ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / shes rab sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / lag na sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang /sa byang chub mngon sum snang byed ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / so so 5yang dag par rig pa la 'jug pa ston pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra dang / yon tan gyi rnam pa thams cad la 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra 'byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu de ltar rgyud kyi sgral nidang / sil snyan gyi sgra dang / glu dbyangs kyi sgra de dag las chos kyi sgra 'di lta bu 'di dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgra 'byung ngo / /sgra de dag gis sems can de dag yongs su smin par byed par 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos 'di lta bu dang ldan pa yin no/ /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i yon tan bsngags pa bstan pa 'di bshad pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi lag par lha'i me tog man dā ra'i ri phur ma grub nas/ de dag gis me tog gi phur ma de dag mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po la gtor to/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos byin gyi rlabs 'ji lta bus 7)me tog de dag lag pa g.yas par blangs te/ me tog gcig kyang sa la ma ltung 8bar de lta bu'i byin gyi rlabs kyi byin gyis brlabs 'onas me tog blangs pa de dag bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor to/ /de nas me tog de dag gtor ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi mthus skad cig de la stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams 1 rime tog rin po che'i gdugs gcig gis khebs par gyur to/ /me tog rin po che'i gdugs de las mu tig gi 58—715

do shal bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag rab tu 'phyang ngo / /me tog gi nyu)do shal 'phyang ba re re las kyang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma byung ngo / /'od zer thams cad kyi rtse mo las kyang pad ma sna tshogs blta na sdug pa/ kha dog dag nadang ldan pa dri dang ldan pa/ yid du 'ong ba dag byung bar gyur to/ /pad ma thams cad la yang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku skyil dmo krung cabacas shing bzhugs par kun tu snang ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis kyang mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ra sdong po la legs so zhes bya ba gnang ste/ skyes bu dam pa khyod kyis sems can mang po yongs su smin par byas so/ /sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir gang yul las rnam par grol yang yul thams cad kyang ston/'khor ba las grol yang bsams phyi bzhin du srid par skye ba kun tu ston/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i skyon med pa 7thob kyang / khams gsum na nye bar spyod 8pa 'di lta bu ni 9 byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba yin te/ legs so legs so/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyi dbu la rin po che'i gdugs gzhan dag byin gyis brlab po 1 snyam mo/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po 11sdong po de'i tshe rin po snyeche'i gdugs bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 12so/ /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po rin po che'i gdugs bkod 1dpa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbu'i thad drang gi steng na rin po che'i gdugs rnams gnas par kun tu snang ngo / /'khor der thams cad kyi lag pa g.yas pa nas kyang rin po che'i gdugs rnams 58—716

byung bar gyur te/ de dag gis 1rin po che'i gdugs de dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la mngon par bkab bo// //bam po gsum pa/ mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po 'di snyam du sems te/'di ltar bdag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nyan thos dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun tshon bcas par bshos la spyan drangs te/ 'di ltar bdag gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas par ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang du bdag gi gnas su gshegs par gsol to / /de ltar na bdag gi gnas yongs su spyad par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i tshogs 4tshad med pa la phan btags par yang 'gyur ro/ /de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / yongs su spyad par bya bar spro bar 'gyur te/ de'i phyir de dag gi yun ring po'i don dang phan pa dang / grub pa dang ske/ bde ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsgrub 5pa 'thob 6par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 7te/ thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la thugs brtse 8ba dang / sems can tshad ma mchis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba spel ba'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang ske/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig 9tu ri spos kyi ngad ldang gi ngos la bdag gi gnas su dgung bdun zhig bzhugs par 1 bdag la gnang bar 58—717

mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i0)'khor dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur dang yongs su spyad par bgyi bar spro'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tsho mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po la thugs brtse ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos kyi tshogs dang bcas pa la zhag bdun ri spos kyi ngad ldang gi ngos la bzhug ri par gnang ngo / /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos bcom ldan 'das kyis caganang bar rig nas/ tshim zhing mgu la yi dur rangs shing rab tu dga' ste dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas dpung dang bcas g.yog 'khor dang bcas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal tsinas lan gsum bskor bas byas te/ sil snyan dang rol mo'i dbyangs sgra byas nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa na byas te/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de nas song nas ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang ba la gnas so/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir rang gi khyim rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te/ 'khor gyi khyams rgyar kun nas dpag tshad lnga brgya pa/ be+e drur+ya 9)sngon po dang / 'dzam bu'i 1 5klung gi gser gyi pad mas legs par brgyan pa/ rin po che du mas rnam par spras pa byas so/ /'khor gyi khyams der gdan khri rtsa ba rin po che las byas pa/ lha'i ras brgya stong bting ba brgya stong phrag mang po bshams so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan seng ge'i khri 'phang du dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa rin po che thams cad kyis 17spras pa/ rin po che'i kha khyer gyis 12bskor ba/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ba/ snying po mchog gi bdug pas bdugs pa/ bla re bres pa/ dar gyi lda ldi mang po bres 1 pa lha'i me tog gtor ba bshams so/ /seng ge'i khri de'i 58—718

phyogs bzhir rin po che'i shing ljon pa 1 sna tshogs blta nan sdug pa bzhi sprul te/skye bo thams cad bsdus nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /u dum bā 5ra'i me tog ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba brgya lam rnyed 'gyur ba/ /mi mchog de ni da ltar byung gyur gyis / /skyob la gus dang bcas pas mchod pa gyis / /nga rgyal dag dang rgyags dang g.yo spongs la/ /phrag dog ser sna de bzhin sgyu rnams dang / /rgod pa thams cad yongs su spong pa byos la/ /ston la gus dang bcas pas mchod pa gyis/ /spos ngad ldang ba 'di na lha yul ba'i/ /me tog khyad par 'phags pa ji snyed pa/ /de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas su/ /skyes bu khyu mchog la ni mchod pa gyis/ /sems can mchog la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ /dri zhim yid 'ong khyad par 'phags pa'i dri/ /dus kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i tsan dan gyis/ /spos kyi ngad ldang 'di la bdug pa gyis/ /glu dbyangs sil snyan rnam mang yid 'ong ba/ /mi 'am ci dag rtag rtsen negar byed pa / /ldan par byos la dga' zhing dang ba yis/ /rkang gnyis mchog la mchod pa rab tu gyis/ /mtshungs pa med pa mthong ba rnyed dka' ba/ /de bzhin gshegs la lha yis47rigadugs rnams dang / /ba dan dag dang rgyal mtshan chos gos dang / /bla re mang po yid na'ong gzung bar 9)rgyas/ /sangs rgyas mchod pas bde 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /brgya byin dang ni 'jig rten skyong bar 'gyur / /tshangs pa dag dang dbang byed dbang phyug dang / /lha dang mi yi 1 bdag po chen por 'gyur/ /mi mchog mchod pas gzugs dang kha dog dang / /grags dang brjod dang 'khor dang longs spyod dang / /de bzhin dbang phyug dang ni snyan tshig dang / /de bzhin gzung 11bar 'os pa'i tshig tu 'gyur/ /gang 58—719

dag 'dir ni lha dang de bzhin du/ /mi rnams kyi —1)ni 'dus byas bde ba dang / /bde ba bde bas tshim par 'dod pa rnams/ /'jig rten mgon po de la mchod pa gyis/ /rang rgyal byang chub de bzhin nyan thos dang / /de ltar dam pa mchog gi theg pa dang / /bdud kyi dpung rnams rab 'joms na/gang 'dod pas/ /sems can mchog de la ni mchod pa gyis/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos rang gi g.yog 'khor thams cad la go bar byas te/ me tog cadang / dri dang /phreng ba dang / byug pa bsngogs nas ro brgya pa'i zhal zas bshams te/ ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang gi lho phyogs kyi ngos la 'dug nas sil snyan dang glu dbyangs blangs 5te/ rgyud kyi sgra dang glu'i sgra dang ldan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis 6dbyangs las tshigs su bcad de7)/ bcom ldan 'das la dus bskul ba/ phan pa mdzad cing bde mdzad dga' mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /zhal yang rab 'dzum zla ba'i ngos ltar dri mi mnga'/ /skyes snamachog dge sbyong dam pa lha dang mis mchod pa/ /bde bar gshegs khyod 'dir gshegs pa yi 9 dus 'di lags/ /stobs bcu rnams kyi stobs mnga' pha rol dpung 'joms71 )pa/ /gzhan gyi tshogs rnams 'joms shing 11'gro la phan pa mdzad/ /'jo dang rnyog pa rnams dang dri ma tha 12spangs pa/ /phan pa mdzad pa khyod 'dir gshegs 12pa'i dus 'di lags/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan rdul sbyangs the tshom 1 rnam par gtor/ /dran dang blo gros blo yangs mos rtogs blo gros ldan/ /'gro rgyal rtag tu 'gro ba 'gro med 'gro ba spangs/ /phan pa mdzad cing dga' mdzad rab tu dgyes pa'i thugs / /nyi ma zla ba nor bu glog rnams 15mdzes pa'i 'od/ /brgya byin tshangs pa srid gsum lha tshogs 'od 'phrog cing / /'od mdzad dpal stug 9thub khyod 58—720

'od ni phan bgyid pas/ /'od 'di bsal 1nas rgyal ba'i 'od ni lhag nage yi/ /khyod kyi lha skad klu skad mi ci'i glu ྅sgra yis/ /yang dang yang du 'bar ba'i nyon mongs zhi bar bgyid // /skad mchog yangs pa tshangs pa rnams kyi sgra skad kyis(5la/ /nyon mongs thams cad zhi bar bgyid pas 'bar ma lags/ /sman pa gang dag phyogs bcur rgyu yang de dag gis/ /gang du'ang 'gro ba'i nyon mongs zhi bar bgyid 6mi nus/ /sman pa'i rgyal po bla med gang tshe gsung 7brjod pa/ /de tshe nyon mongs kun zhi bde ba thams 8cad sbyin/ /shin tu ngo mtshar 'od dang stobs mchog mtshungs med stobs/ /gsung ni skyon bral 'khrul pa mi mnga' dgra 'dul ba/ /rdul med rab rib bdag gi 'o mun pa shin tu bcom/ /dgra bral phan mdzad khyed kyi dus legs 'dir gshegs gsol/ /sbyin dang dul dang legs spyod mi mnyam mtshungs dang mnyam/ /tshul khrims brtul 1 cizhugs mi 'khrugs 31brtul zhugs 12dka' thub dgyes/ /bzod dang dul dang shin tu dge la nges pa'i thugs/ /dga' gsung dgra rnams nya kyi ni dga' spong gshegs su gsol / /dbang po stobs dang lam dgyes bsam gtan mngon mkhyen rol/ /dran dang blo gros rtogs dang mos la gnas pa'i 'thugs/ /'od 7ni rab tu lhag ge shin tu dgyes pa'i thugs/ /yon tan mnga' ba khyod 'dir gshegs pa'i dus 'di lags/ /byams dang snying 17rje dga' dang btang snyoms bsgoms 1 pa'i thugs / /skyon gyi mun pa bcom zhing bag la nyal dang bral/ /tshangs pa'i lam ni rab bslabs rgyal ba'i lam la gnas/ /dga' mdzad bde bar gshegs pa dus 18lags gshegs su gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 19mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos dus bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa gsan nas dge slong gi dge 58—721

'dun la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos dus bskul gyis 1lhung bzed dang / chos gos thogs la zhag bdun gnas pa'i gtsug lag khang skyong yang skos tshonashig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar bdag gis —)khang pa brtsegs pa/bkod pa 'di lta bu sprul la khang pa brtsegs pa der/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos kyi tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs te/ rin po che bkod pa'i seng ge'i khri la bzhugs capa'i khang pa brtsegs pa bdag gis lag pa g.yas par blangs te/ nam mkha'i ngos las ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang du bkur bar byin gyis brlab bo snyam mor/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan de'i tshe 'di lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ ting nge 'dzin de la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar khang pa brtsegs 6pa tshad dpag tshad bcu pa bkra ba blta na sdug pa/ gru bzhi pa/ ka ba bzhi zug pa/ cha mnyam pa/ shin tu rnam par phye 7 ba byung ngo / /khang pa brtsegs pa der stobs dang ldan pa'i pad ma bkod pa'i khri rnams kyang byung ngo / /khang pa brtsegs pa der 8bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan rin po che'i pad ma bkod pa'i seng ge'i khri 'phang du mi bdun yod pa byung (ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis khang pa brtsegs pa bkod pa dang 1 / seng ge'i khri bkod 11pa 'di lta bu 'di byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol tol/ /bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos chen po 'di dag dang thabs cig 12tu khang pa brtsegs pa seng ge'i khri bshams pa 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis khang pa 58—722

brtsegs pa 'di sug pa g.yas pas blangs te/ ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang du 'tshal nas gzhags7par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan la thugs brtse ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos chen po de dag dang thabs cig btu khang pa brtsegs pa der ji ltar khri bshams pa de dag la bzhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis khang pa brtsegs pa de lag mthil g.yas par blangs te/ steng gi nam mkha' (kyelas rdzu 'phrul gyis song ngo / /de nas 'dod papasninan spyod pa'i lha'i bu dang ske/ gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul 'di mthong nas tshim zhing mgu la yi rangs shing 45rab tu dga' stem46)dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das dang byang57)chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lha'i cod pan la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa thams cad thogs te/ sil snyan dang pheg rdobs pa byas nas bcom ldan 'das khang pa brtsegs pa na bzhugs shing / nam mkha'i ngos las gshegs pa la mchod pa byas te/ ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang du phyin to49)/ /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos bcom ldan 'das khang pa brtsegs pa na bzhugs shing nam mkha'i ngos las gshegs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas mi 'am ci dang / dri za brgyad khri bzhi stong gis bskor te/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang ske/ phreng ba dang / byug pa thams cad thogs nas sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang glu dbyangs len pa'i bkod pa byas te/ bcom ldan 'das bsu ba'i phyir byung ngo / /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po dpung dang bcas 'khor dang 58—723

bcas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal tshonas ji ltar thogs napa'i me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa de dag dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang / glu dbyangs len pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dus la bab par 4rimakhyen nas/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / de ma yin pa gzhan lha'i bu rnams dang / thabs cig 5tu mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos ne'akhor gyi khyams 7bkod pa ga la ba der gshegs te rang gi seng ge'i khri ji ltar bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang nyan thos kyi tshogs thams cad so so ci rigs napar 'khod do/ /9mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / 'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu de dag la smras pa/ grogs po dag de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cig 1 tu gdugs tshod gsol gyis31/ khyed thams cad 'dus la tshur spyon/ de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po slas dang bcas / bu dang bcas/ rang gi skye bo dang bcas/ 'khor dang bcas/g.yog dang bcas te rang rang gi lag gis bza' ba dang / bca' ba gya rnam pa snyemang po ro dang ldan pa/ ro brgya pa'i zhal zas sna tshogs bcom ldan 'das dang /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / dge slong gi dge 12'dun dang /'khor la brims nas 1 bde bar bstabs te tshim par byas so/ /tshim par byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lhung bzed bzhag ste/ phyag bcabs 9par rig nas / dpung dang bcas 15g.yog dang bcas te/ chos nyan pa'i phyir bcom 58—724

ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ji ltar bdag la 'os pa'i stan la 'dug (go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po dang skye bo'i tshogs phal po che de dag la chos kyi gtam yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par 'dzin du bcug nago / /gzengs 5)bstod do/ /rab tu dga' bar mdzad do/ /de nas 4)bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi gtam ni 'di yin te/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum (5cu rtsa gnyis kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yin no/ /rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis gang khye'adi lta ste/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa sbyin 7)pa na byang chub kyi sems sngon du 'gro ba'i ni/sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / theg pa chung ngu spangs pa'i sems kyis sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / slong ba la zhe sdang ba med pa'i sems kyis sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / len pa rnams la sbyin gnas su 'du shes bskyed de sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / len pa rnams la dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'du shes bskyed de sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / nang gi kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dri ma spangs te sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / kun tu 'dzin pa med pa'i sems kyis9skudaga' ba dang / dang ba dang mchog tu dga' ba thob nas sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / lag pa brkyang 1 riste grol bas gtong ba rnam par 1 gtong ba la dga' bas sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / rgya chen po la mos te zhum pa med pa'i sems kyis sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / snod thams cad la mi gnas par sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / rnam par smin pa la re ba med par sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang /lan la re ba med pa'i blos 12sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos tshol ba'i blos sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su bsngos te 58—725

sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / gdung ba med pa'i sems kyis sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang ske/ bsdu ba'i dngos po sngon du 'gro bas sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / chos 'dzin par gyur cig snyam ste sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang nya)/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung dang 'thun 2par gyur cig snyam ste sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / bdag bdud kyi phyogs tshar gcod par gyur cig ces te sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / bdag byang chub kyi lam rnam par spyod par gyur cig ces (5sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / bdag skyes bu dam pa'i las byed par gyur cig ces 4)sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / bdag yi dgas ra kyi lam rnam par spong bar gyur cig ces te sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang /bdag gi bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba'i rgyur gyur cig ces57sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / bdag gis 7longs spyod chen por 'gyur ba'i bsgrub 5)pa rab tu bzung bar gyur cig ces te sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / chos la dga' bar rab tu gnas par gyur cig ces te sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang / bdag la dge ba'i bshes gnyen dkon par ma gyur cig ces te sbyin pa de sbyin pa dang /bdag la sems can thams cad dga' ba'i mig dang ldan par gyur cig ces te sbyin pa 9sbyin pa dang / bdag gi sbyin pa des bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub 1 par gyur cig ces 11 sbyin pa 12sbyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gtong ba phun sum tshogs pa gzhan rnams kyi rjes su slob par ma 12gyur cig ces te sbyin pa 3 sbyin pa dang / bdag mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po bsags pa yongs su 'dzin par gyur cig ces te sbyin pa 1 sbyin pa dang ske/ bdag sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong ba dang / bdag sangs rgyas 58—726

kyi chos thams cad mngon sum du gyur cig ces te sbyin pa sbyin pa ste/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa'i 1)pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yin no/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yin no/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang bral bas lus yongs su dag pa'i tshul khrims dang / bdag gi lha sangs rgyas la mi slu ba'i mtshan nyid kyis ngag yongs su dag pa'i tshul khrims dang /brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang / log par lta ba med pas sems yongs su dag pa'i tshul khrims dang / lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa myong bas dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yongs su dag pa'i tshul khrims dang / nyi natshe ba'i sa thams cad mi ston pas byang chub kyi sems dang / bsam pa mi brjed pa'i tshul khrims dang / shin tu nyams pa med cing g.yo skudang bral bas lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su dag pa'i tshul khrims dang / skye bo phal pa thams cad sdud pas 'phags pa'i skye bos bsngags pa'i tshul khrims dang / sems can thams cad la sems snyoms par byams pa sngon du 'gro ba'i tshul khrims dang / sems can thams cad yongs su skyob pas snying rje chen po la rab tu sbyor ba'i tshul khrims dang ske/ dam bcas pa'i stobs kyis bslab pa rdzogs pa med pa yang dag par 'dzin pa'i tshul khrims dang / kha na ma tho ba chung ngu la yang 'jigs par lta bas ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul khrims dang / shin tu mi gtong bas skyon med pa'i tshul khrims dang / spyod pa 5)shin tu dag pas thun 58—727

tshags ma yin pa'i tshul khrims dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan du 'gro bas rang gi rnam pa mang po la dbang 1byed pa'i tshul khrims dang / skye bo mkhas pas 3rig pa'i phyir sngags pa'i tshul khrims dang / ngan song ngan 'gro thams cad kyi lam las sgrol ba'i tshul khrims dang / bde ba'i dngos po thams cad la rab tu gnas pa'i tshul khrims dang / sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims yongs su rdzogs par byed pas sangs rgyas kyis caganang ba'i tshul khrims dang / yi dam la brtan pas mi lhod pa'i 5tshul khrims dang / rang gi sems nges par sems pas bdag la mi stod 6gzhan la mi smod pa'i tshul khrims dang / nyon mongs pa med pas nges par sems pa'i snying rje'i tshul khrims dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad la 7nye bar byed pa'i tshul khrims dang / rab tu dga' bar byed pa la 8dga' bar byed pa'i tshul khrims dang / 'dod pa dang / chags pa med pas chog shes par byed pa'i tshul khrims dang / nan tan snying por 9 byed pas bsgrub 1 pa rlabs 1 po che'i tshul khrims dang / khyim gyi gnas thams cad la mi lta ba'i 12rab tu 'byung ba la gzhol ba'i tshul khrims dang / chos kyi dga' ba la dga' mos pas dgon pa la dga' ba dang ldan pa'i tshul khrims dang / 'phags pa'i rigs la rton dpas 'dod pa nyung zhing chog shes pa la nges pa'i 1 tshul khrims snyedang ske/ sdig pa 'dod pa thams cad dang bral bas sbyangs pa'i yon tan la yang dag par rab tu sbyor ba'i tshul khrims dang / sems can med par rnam par spyod pas 15dmigs pa med par sbyor ba'i tshul khrims dang / chad pa dang rtag pa yongs su spong bas lta bar song ba thams cad dang gti mug sel ba'i tshul khrims dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang mi 'gal bas byang chub kyi 58—728

rjes su 'thun0)pa'i tshul khrims te/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yin no/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnamasam kyi bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yin no/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lus la mi lta bas bzod par blta da)ba dang / srog la mi chags paralo ribazod par blta pa ba dang / zhe sdang ba'i sems med par 6)bzod par blta ba dang / nyes par 7smras pa'i tshig dang du len pas bzod par blta ba dang / nyam chung ba'i sems can la snying rje skyed na pas bzod par blta ba dang / ma bslabs 9pa la mi brnyas 1 pas bzod par blta ba dang / gnod pa byed pa rnams la lan glan 1 pa'i mthu yod kyang lan mi ldon pas bzod par blta ba dang / yan lag dang nying 12lag thams cad bcad 1 kyang mi 3 'khrugs shing gnod sems med pas bzod par blta ba dang / brlang ba med pas 3debazod par blta ba dang / gshe ba la slar mi gshe bas bzod par blta ba dang / bsam pa dag pas bzod par blta ba dang ske/ rnyog pa'i sems med pas bzod par blta ba dang / dkrugs pa'i sems med pas bzod par blta ba dang / gzhan gyi sems bsrung khobs bzod par blta ba dang / sems can thams cad la 1 phan pa'i dngos pos bzod par blta ba dang / snying rje'i blo dang ldan pas bzod par blta ba dang / nga rgyal med pas bzod par blta ba dang / sems can thams cad la brnyas thabs 18med cing 'dud pas bzod par blta ba dang / 'bar ba med pas bzod par blta ba dang / nye bar zhi bas 19bzod par blta ba dang / nges par sems 58—729
