pas bzod par blta ba dang / bdag gi 'khrul pa la so sor rtog pas bzod par blta ba dang / gzhan gyi 'khrul 1pa'i skyon la mi lta bas bzod par blta ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgoms pas bzod par blta ba dang /chos la sems sbyor bas bzod par blta ba dang / dang ba'i (2)dngos pos bzod par blta ba dang / sems la gdung ba med pas bzod par blta ba dang /bzhin 'dzum zhing khro gnyer med pas bzod par blta ba dang / gsong po smras bas bzod par blta ba dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum la dngang ba 4)med pas bzod par blta ba dang / ma skyes pa dang ma byung ba la mos pas bzod par blta ba dang / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob pas bzod par blta ba ste/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum 5cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag gis/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yin no/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams 0kyi brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yin no/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi rigs rgyun mi 'chadam par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / chos kyi rigs rgyun mi 'chadam par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus snyertsom pa dang / dge 'dun gyi rigs rgyun mi 'chad 9par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sems can tshad med pa yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / 'khor ba tshad mid pa yongs su gzung ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sangs rgyas tshad med pa la mchod pa dang rim 7gro bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba tshad med pa bsags 1158—730

pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / thos pa tshad med pa gzung tuba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sems can thams cad la legs par smra ba smra ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sems can thams cad la rab tu gding bar byed pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sems can thams cad la bya ba ci yod ces bya ba la spro ba'i phyir brtsonatshan/'grus rtsom pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong ba'i phyir brtson 'grus com pa dang / sems can thams cad tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la gzud pa'i da phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang /bzod pa'i stobs thams cad dang / des pa mi nyams param bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / bsam gtan dang rnam par thar pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang ske/ snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad bskyed pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang ske/ chags pa med pa'i shes rab mchog yongs su bskang ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang /btang snyoms tshangs pa'i gnas pa'i gnas pa yongs su bskang ba'i 5phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / mngon par shes pa thams cad la brtson 'grus bskyed pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su bsdu ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom 6pa dang / bdud thams cad gzhom pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom 7pa dang /stobs brtan pa chen pos pha rol gnon pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang /pha rol rgol ba thams cad chos dang 'thun pas na tshar gcad 9)pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su bskang ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / lus dang ngag dang 58—731

sems kyi rgyan gyi phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / bya ba thams cad nyams 'og tu chud par byed cing brtson pa mi gtong ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang /sems zhum pa med par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis mi rdzi ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom 3pa dang / ma rgal tshon)ba sgrol /ma grol ba dgrol / dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang ske/ bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan gyi tshogs bsags 5pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba'i phyir 6brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas par rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro zhing sangs rgyas la blta ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang /sems dang lus dben pa'i phyir de'i brtson 'grus de dben pa las nges par byung ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'jug pa'i phyir de'i brtson 'grus de 7blang ba med cing dor ba med la/ gdeg pa med cing gzhag pa med de/ skye ba med cing 'byung ba med pas bsdus pa yin te/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yin no/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis byang chub sems dpa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yin no/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ dran pa yongs su dag pa dang / blo gros yongs su dag pa dang /rtogs pa yongs su dag pa dang / ngo tsha shes pa yongs su dag pa dang / khrel yod pa yongs su dag pa dang / mos pa yongs su dag pa dang / bsngo ba yongs 58—732

su dag pa dang / byang chub kyi sems mi brjid pa yongs su dag pa dang /dbang po sbas pa yongs su dag pa dang / mi gnas pa yongs su dag pa dang /de la ma chags pa yongs su dag pa dang / mngon par shes pa bskyed pa yongs su dag pa dang / sems las su rung ba yongs su dag pa dang / lus dben pa yongs su dag pa dang / brag ca 1 shes pa yongs su dag pa dang / nang nye bar zhi ba yongs su dag pa dang / phyi rol du mi rgyu ba yongs su dag pa dang /dmigs pa'i lta ba spong ba yongs su dag pa dang / bdag med pa dang /sems can 2med pa dang / srog med pa dang / gso ba med pa dang / gang zag med par so sor rtog cing khams gsum pa la mi gnas pa yongs su dag pa dang ske/ byang chub kyi yan lag gi sgo yongs su dag pa dang / sems can la lta ba'i snying rje chen po yongs su dag pa dang / shes rab la 'jug pas rab rib med cing snang ba yongs su dag pa dang / rgyu dang / 'bras bu dang / rnam par smin pa dang mi 'gal ba yongs su dag pa dang / chos la sems pa'i bzod pa yongs su dag pa dang / tshul bzhin gyi rnam pa'i chos la so sor rtog pa yongs su dag pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa bsdu ba yongs su dag pa dang / byang chub kyi snying po bsgrub pa yongs su dag pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ma 'dres pas yongs su dag pa dang / mi g.yo 5ba'i bsam gtan bsgrub ne pa yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin thob pa la mi g.yeng ba yongs su dag pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pas7lta ba yongs su dag pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi dbang po'i mchog dang /mchog ma yin pa shes nas so sor ci rigs par chos ston pa yongs su dag pa ste/58—733

mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yin no/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yin no/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ thos pa tshol bas mi ngoms pas mang du thos pa dang /tshul bzhin yid la byed pas chos rnams la dpyod pa'i shes pa la mkhas pa dang /byang chub mngon sum du byed pa'i bdag nyid sna)chos bsgrub napa shes pa dang /phung po la mkhas pa la 'jug pas rnam par grol ba shes pa dang / chos kyi dbyings la mkhas pa'i shes pa dang / skye mched la mkhas pa'i shes pa dang /rgyu dang bya ba khong du chud pas stong pa'i rnam par rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la mkhas pa dang / bden pa la mkhas pa'i shes pa dang / der mi ltung bar skyon med pa la 'jug pa shes pa dang / bsams 5)bzhin du skye bas skye ba la so sor mi rtog pa'i shes pa dang / gzodamu ma nas rnam par dag pas chos thams cad mi skye bar shes pa dang / phyin ci log tu gyur pa yongs su smin par byed pas sems can thams cad bdag med par shes pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mtha'i phyir chos thams cad chos gcig tu shes pa dang / nam mkha' snyedang mtshungs pa'i phyir zhing thams cad zhing gcig tu shes pa dang / chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis 5mi khyab pa la zhugs pas sangs rgyas thams cad sangs rgyas gcig tu shes pa dang / yi ge shes pa la mkhas pas chos kyi tshig rab tu dbyer ba bstan pa shes pa dang / legs par bshad pas sems can thams cad tshim par byed pa'i phyir chags pa med pa'i spobs pas chos rgya cher shes pa dang /58—734

thos pa thams cad 'dzin pas gzungs brjid pa med pa'i shes pa dang / bdud de dag byang chub tu yongs su smin par byed pas/ bdud kyi las thams cad khong du chud pa'i shes pa dang / rnam par bsgrubs te so sor nye bar gnas par shes pas chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rtog pa'i shes pa dang / shin tu yongs su grub pa med pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad rmi lam dang / smig rgyu dang / chu zla dang glu/ mig yor dang / brag ca tsholta bu'i tshul nadu ston pa shes pa dang /shes pa rnam par dag pa'i phyir sems can gyi sems kyi spyod pa thams sa cad khong du chud pa'i shes pa dang / shin tu bslabs ri pa'i phyir 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa brtags 5par shes pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo'i phyir stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rnam pa'i chos shes pa dang / gzod ri tshom nas bralam ba med pa'i phyiram nochos thams cad rang bzhin gyisal9zhi ba dang / rab tu zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi bar shes pa dang / ma rig 1 )pa dang / gti mug gi mun pa kun tu bcom pa'i phyir chos thams cad la rab rib med cing snang ba thob pa dang / chos thams cad gar yang mi 'gro gang nas kyang mi 'ong bar shes pas shes rab kyi 'od dang ldan zhing sems can thams cad la rnam par thar pa'i chos ston pa dang / las dang bya ba khong du chud pas sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang 'gro bar skye ba ston pa dang ske/ don dang chos dang nges pa'i tshig dang spobs pa'i tshul la mkhas te phyad 11par de kho na'i lung 1 ston pas/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa dang /bdag dul ba dang / zhi ba dang / grol ba dang / sbas pa dang / byang bas yongs su mya ngan las zlo 1 ba'i phyir don yod pa'i chos ston pa dang / dam pa'i 58—735

chos yongs su 'dzin pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis de shes rab las nges par byung bar rig nas/ chos kyi grong khyer thams cad yongs su skyong bar byin gyis rlob pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa la yang dag par gzhol te/ mtha' la gnas pa'i tshul nges par byas pas lung bstan pa'i sa rab tu thob pa yin te/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yin no/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan na thabs la mkhas par rig par bya'o/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' bdag zad par mi byed pas sems can la lta 1ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir bsod nams chen po la gnas pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi sbyin gnas kyi phyir sbyin gnas mi tshol ba dang / sems can dbul po yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir rgya chen po don du mi gnyer ba dang / sems can thams cad ngag bsdam pa la sbyar ba'i phyir/ lkugs nanapa dang / dig pa lta bur ston pa dang ske/ bud med dang bu mo yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ bud med yongs su 'dzin pa dang / khye'u yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ khye'u'i gzugs su ston pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang 'thun ripar bya ba'i phyir / gzugs thams cad ston pa dang / sems can myos pa yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ myos pa ma yin yang myos pa'i lus su ston pa dang / de la mos 4pa'i sems 5can rnams la chos ston pa'i phyir/ smyon (6)pa dang sems g.yengs pa'i 7gzugs su ston pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya 58—736

ba'i phyir/ lo brgyar bsags pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po 'dor ba dang / chos 'dzin du gzhug hu)pa'i phyir/ sems can rnams la dga' ba dang tshon/ thams cad la rtse ba dang / longs spyod ston pa dang / de la mos dkyipa'i sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ g.yon can ma rungs pas 'tsho ba'i lus su ston pa dang / bud med gang tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag dang / rgyal po'i chung mar gyur pa bu med pa bu'i tshe 'dod pa'i mya ngan gyi zug rngu dang ldan 4zhing /sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba la de na byang chub sems dpas de dag dge ba la dad cing / yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir de'i bur khas len pa dang /'brog dgon par song ba'i sems can dbul po la bza' ba dang / btung ba dang ske/ nor sbyin zhing bgo bsha' 'ubya ba'i phyir 'gron pos mang po'i nang du ded dpon du 'gyur ba dang / gter chen po mdun ri du byas te nanor gyi phung po chen po byinalo)nas chos ston pa dang / mya ngan gyi zug rngu dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams kyi mya ngan gyi zug rngu bsal nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis sna tshochos ston pa dang /gter stor ba'i /17sems can rnams kyi mdun 12du gter chen po nye bar bstan nas 'tsho ba yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir chos ston pa dang / de dag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'jug 1 pa'i phyir gzhan mu stegs can spyod pa can dang /kun tu rgyu ba rnams kyi nang du rab tu 'byung ba dang / sems can 'dod chags kyi lcags kyus zin pa rnams yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir smad 'tshong ma'i 1 khyim dang / slas kyi nang du bu 15mo'i gzugs mdzes pa blta na sdug par ston pa dang ske/ sems can rnams mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos kyis yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir 'dus pa chen po dang / tshogs pa mang po'i nang du rnga dang / rnga 58—737

sri dang ga dang rnga pa na ba dang dung gi sgras sa chen po mdzes par byas nas/bdag nye bar ston cing sems can 'dun (2)pa de dag la rol mo'i dbyangs sgra de dag las chos ston pa'i sgra 'byin cing bzo'i 'daganas thams cad nye bar ston pa dang ske/ mya ngan du son pa'i 'gron〈5)pa bza' ba dang / btung ba zad pa la mngon par shes pa chen pos rnam par rtse 8)zhing de'i stobs kyis ⑤bza' ba dang /btung ba byin nas bkres pa dang bral zhing skom pa dang bral ba'i sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / sems can gang dag dmus〈6)long du gyur pa de dag gi nang du dmus (7)long lta bur gyur nas/ dbul po mig med pa de dag la rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis bza' ba dang / btung ba 'byor bar byas nas/ mig52)byin te rangs9gi gzugs bstan nas/ ji ltar de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar chos ston pa dang /rgyal po'i khri mon 1 ridu bcug pa'i srog chags brgya phrag du ma g.yon can (1sna tshogs dang ldan pa de dag yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ bsamasasngo/rtebazhin du bdag rkun por ston cing de g.yon can no zhes shes par byas nas/ khri mon〈nyedu bcug pa dang de der zhugs nas rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis bcings pa de dag gi lus bkrus shing bskus te/ gos bzang po bskon nas bza' ba dang / btung bas lus tshim par byas te/ bcings pa dam po de dag las bgrol yinas ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ba de lta bur chos ston pa dang / sems can gang dag rgyal pos gsad7par bskra7ba srog 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa'i 1 thob pa sdug bsngal gyis nyam nya thag pa de dag yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rdzu 58—738

'phrul gyis gzhan dag cig sprul te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis gshed〈sna)ma la bkrisam nas gsad separ 'os pa'i mi de dag bcings pa de las bkrol te/ 'jigs pa dang bral ba srog rnyed pa dang / dbugs phyin pa de dag la ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ba de lta de lta bur chos ston pa dang ske/ phyogs gang na don dang / nor dang / zhing dang / khyim58)gyi dngos po dang / bran pho'atshadang / bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / dmag mi'i phyir 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / mtshang 'bru57bar gyur pa der byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thabs kyis dbus su 'dug nas rdzu 'phrul gyis don dang / nor dang rin po che yongs su btang ste/de dag 'dum ④par sbyor ro/ /de dag dum par rigs58)nas bla na med pa yang dag par7)rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thabs la mkhas pas yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad kyi 7dbang po nyams pa med kyang sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir dbang po nyams par yang ston71)pa dang / spyod lam phun sum tshogs kyang sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir spyod lam thams cad 'khrugs par yang byed pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' thabs la mkhas pas gzhan mu stegs can ston pa dang ske/ ring du gnas pa bdud kyi spyod yul la spyod pa bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mu stegs can de dag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dgug pa'i phyir de dag gi mdun du dkon mchog gsum gyi bsngags72pa brjod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thabs la mkhas pas sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir bsam gtan dang rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 58wa 739

'jug pa rnams las log nas bsams 1bzhin du 'dod pa'i khams su skye ste/mya ngan las 'das pa 'dod pa rnams la skye ba'i sdug bsngal bstan nas dben pa thob pa rnams bla ma'i lam bsgom tshonadu gzud pa'i ciphyir/ mya ngan las 'das pa ston pa dang / skyon med pa la ma zhugs pa la la mya ngan las 'das par 'gro bar 'dun pa rnams kyi mdun du/ byang chub sems dpa' thabs la mkhas pa sangs rgyas kyi sku ston pa dang / sangs rgyas la dad pa thob cing / sems mnyam par bzhag 5pa rnams byang chub kyi sems len du gzud pa'i phyir/ rkyen 'di shes pa la 'jug pa nye bar ston pa ste/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thabs la mkhas par rig par bya'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa dang thabs la mkhas pa la 'jug pa yongs su dag pa'i le'u 'di bstan pa na/ mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i 'khor dang / de ma yin pa gzhan lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za'i srog chags dgu khri brgyad stong ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyes so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor byang chub sems dpa' las byang chub sems dpa' khri brgyad 0stong ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob par gyur to/ /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong 7po ni shes rab sgron nam zhes bya snyeba'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob par gyur to/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi gtam gyis rab tu dga' bar byas/ yang dag par 'dzin du btsud9/ gzengs bstod1 / yang dag par bstan pas/tshim zhing mgu la yi 11rangs shing rab tu dga' ste/ dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas/ rin thang med pa'i ras bcos ma phrugs gcig bcom ldan 'das 58—740

la mngon par bkab bo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / nyan thos kyi dge 'dun thams cad la yang rin thang med pa'i gos kyis so sor bkab bo/ /gnas thams cad ni yongs su longs spyad nyapa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la phul lo / /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i bu brgyad stong pos rin po che'i pad ma bkod pa dang / rin po che'i gdugs brgyad stong du tshang bas tshon)bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bkab ste/ gtor ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi mthus de dag thams cad 'khor gyi khyams der bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i drang thad kyi steng gi bar snang la dpag tshad stong tsam na/ rin po che'i gdugs gcig tu gnas par gyur to/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po 5)sdong po'i bu brgyad stong pos bcom ldan 'das kyi cho 'phrul chen po 'di mthong nas tshim zhing mgu la yi 4)rangs shing rab tu dga' ste/ dga' ba dang yid 5)bde ba skyes nas/ lhag pa'i bsam pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de dag gis byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang thos pas bdag cag byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos yang dag par sgrub ri ripar 'gyur ba byang chub tu yongs su smin par bgyid pa'i chos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis )bdag cag la bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis na mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i bu de dag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa mkhyen nas ta la bdun srid kyi steng gi bar snang la skyil 9)mo krung 1 ribacas te bzhugasamanyu1nas sku las 'di lta bu'i 'od phyung 12ste/ ci 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /gang mi 'am ci dang / dri za dang / lto 58—741

'phye de dag dang / 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu de dag gi rol mo sil snyan rnam pa sna tshogs de dag thams cad ma brdungs ma dkrol bar mdzes pa dang ldan par 'khrol lo/ /ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang na dri'i 2)shing dang me tog gi shing dang 'bras bu'i shing ji snyed pa de dag las kyang rol mo sil snyan gyi sgra byung ngo glu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spu'i khung bu thams cad nas kyang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgyad stong byung ngo / /'od zer thams 95)cad kyi rtse mo las kyang pad ma tshad shing rta'i 'khor lo tsam dag byung ngo / /pad ma'i ri/snying po thams cad la yang byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs skyes bu chen po ༄mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis sa)kun tu brgyan 6pa'i lus dag gnas par kun tu snang ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi mthus rol mo sil snyan de dag las ni yongs su 'dri ba'i tshigs su bcad pa byung ske/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams 7)cad ni sgra dbyangs dang skad gcig gis natshigs su bcad nas nges par lan 'debs595so/ /de la sil snyan las tshigs su bcad pa/ bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /ji lta bur ni skyed tshapa dang / /byang chub snying por 'dug 317bar du/ /sems ni brjedapa12pa med par 'gyur / /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams nya kyis smras pa/ sems can kun gyi ched 14kyi phyir/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs15/ /snying rje che dang ldan pa ni/ /byang chub sems brjed mi 'gyur ro/ /sil snyan rnams 7kyis smras pa / de dag bsam pa ji lta bu/ /rab tu 'byor pa nyu ci 'dra zhig /de dag snying rje chen po la/ /nges par sems pa 18ji ltar skye/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis 19smras pa/ g.yo med lhag pa'i bsam pa ste/ /de dag sbyor ba bcos ma min/ /mya ngan 'da' sgor 'jog pa ni/ /de dag snying rje 58wa 742

de 'dra'o/ /sil snyan rnams kyis7smras pa/ de dag gtong ba ji lta bu/ /ji ltar byin nas 'gyod med cing / /rnam smin don du mi gnyer bar/ /byang chub tu ni sngoshebar byed/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams ridakyis smras pa/dngos po kun la mi lta ba/ /des ni byin nas 'gyod pa med/ /byang chub lam du 'jog byed pa/ /de phyir rnam smin re ba med/ /sil snyan rnams54)kyis smras pa / ji ltar tshul khrims53)ldan gyur kyang / /tshul khrims kyis ni rlom sems medam/ /theg chen bla na med pa la/ /ngang tshul ngan can smin par byed(nyu/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams ⑦kyis smras pa/ byang chub sems kyi tshul khrims〈kyeldan/ /stong pa nyid kyis (9)rlom sems med/ /byams 3 7pa chen po skyed711pa ni/ /ngang tshul ngan can yongasal smin byed/ /sil snyan rnams 3 kyis smras pa/ji ltar na ni sems can gyi/ )/ /spyosatshwa shing bsdigasalgepa bzod byed cing / /sems kyis〈 7gnod pa mi byed la/ /mchog tu dga' ba skye bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rme/shernams kyisam37smras pa/ bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs gso ba'i sman pa snyam/ /de dag ngan par smras pa yi/ /tshig thos zhe sdang mi 'gyur ro/ /sil snyan rnams 2 )kyis smras pa/ de dag brtson 'grus ji lta bu/ /pha rol gnon pa'ang ci 'dra zhig /ji ltar zhum pa med sems kyis61/ /byang chub spyad du 2pa spyod par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams sa kyis smras pa/ chos dang sems can bsrungatshan ba ni/ /pha rol gnon dang brtson 'grus so/ /dge ba'i rtsa bas brtan 22pa ni/ / des na 27sems ni zhum mi 'gyur/ /sil snyan rnams kyis 2 smras pa/ de dag ji ltar dran dang ldan/ /blo gros rtogs nu par khong du chud/ /ji ltar bsam gtan 2958—743

bsam gtan byed/ /de la chags 51pa med par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis tsho smras pa/ g.yeng ba med pa dran dang ldan/ /tshul 'chos 5med pa 4blo gros ldan/ /thabs 5kyis bsam gtan 6bsam gtan 7byed / /des na de la chags na mi 'gyur/ /sil snyan rnams kyis 9smras pa/ ji ltar shes rab ldan pa dang / /yang dag lta ba drang po dang / /chos rnams rnam / par dbye ba la/ /mkhas shing 'jigs 11pa med par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ thos pas shes rab kun tu 'phel/ /rten pas lta ba drang por 'gyur/ /chos kyi 12sbyin pas nges 'gyur te/ /tshul bzhin gyis ni don rtogs 'gyur/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ ji ltar thos 12pa btsal 1 bas na/ /de dag thos pa mang du 'gyur/ /gang gis che ba'i bdag 'gyur bar/ /thos pa'i chos rnams ston par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ gus par byas te thos tshol 15zhing / / sgrub pa'i 7thos pa mang du 'gyur/ /zang zing med par 1 chos sbyin pa/ /des ni che ba'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ de dag byams pa ji lta bu/ /de dag snying rje ci 'dra zhig18 /de dag dga' ba ji lta bu/ /btang snyoms kyang ni ci 'dra zhig /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ sems dang btang 19stoms byams pa ste / /sems can 'grol ba'i 21nying rje'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dga' dga' 2 ba ste/ /gnyis spangs pa ni btang snyoms so/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ ji ltar sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur/ /sems kyang ji ltar mthong bar 'gyur/ /chos thos nas ni ji lta bur/ /de dag the tshom 2 skye mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ sangs 58—744

rgyas rjes su dran bsgoms 1 pa/ /des ni 'dren pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /the tshom named cing bsam dag pas/ /chos thos nas ni som nyi med/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ bsod nams tshogs ni ji lta bu/ /ye shes tshogs kyang ci 'dra zhig /de dag zhi gnas lhag mthong la/ /brtson pa yang ni ji lta bu/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ ngoms mi shes pa bsod nams tshogs / /'dri ba rnams ni ye shes tshogs/ /zhi ba'i sems ni zhi gnas te/ /chos shes pa ni lhag mthong ngo / /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ de dag gi (sne ni spyod yul gang / /de dag gnas kyang ji lta bu/ /de dag gnas pa ci 'dra zhig /de dag sbyor ba'ang ji lta bu/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pal/ de dag spyod yul stong pa nyid/ /gnas ni pha rol phyin pa'i lam/ /gnas pa bsam gtan bzhi rnams te/ /sems can rab grolas sbyor ba'o/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ de dag bdud kyi las gang yin/ /sangs rgyas phrin tshor)las ji lta bu/ /ci 'dra ba yi 6las byas na/ /byang chub la ni gzhol bar 'gyur / /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ theg pa chung ngu bdud kyi las/ /sangs rgyas phrin 7las theg pa che/ /sdig pa thams cad spong ba ni/ /byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur ba'o/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ de dag grogs bsten ji lta bu/ /sdig pa'i grogs po ci 'dra zhig /log par lta la 8mi gnas shing / /ji 9ltar yang dag song bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ gang zhig byang chub lam ston pa/ /rtag tu bde sbyin grogs po'o/ /byang chub sems las gang zlog pa/ /de dag sdig pa'i grogs por lha rishes/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ /lam du 'jug par 'gyur 58—745

ba yiX17/ /lta ba drang po ji lta bu/ /sbyor ba rnam par shes nas su/ /ji ltar lta de 'jig mi byed/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ las dang bya bar 'jug pa ni/ /de dag drang por lta ba yin/ /log par sbyor ba rnam shes nas/ /lta ba de dag 'jig mi byed/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ji ltar dam pa'i chos bsrung tsho zhing / /sems can yongs su smin par byed/ /ji lta bu yis thabs kyis ni/ /de dag byang chub bsgrubamatsha)par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ brtson 'grus kyis 3)ni chos bsrung kyi ste/ / bsdu bas 7)yongs su smin par byed/ /mtha' gnyis52)rnam par spangs pas ni/ /byang chub sgrub par byed pa yin/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa / de dag shes pa'i lam 3)ci 'dra/ /nga rgyal las ni ji lta bu/ /ji ltar bka' blo 1 bde ba dang / /thams cad dus su 'thun nyu1par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ rtsod pa med pa nya shes pa'i las//nga rgyal las ni rtsod pa 'byung / / nges par nyi bka' blo bde ba ste/ /gus pa yis khuni 'thun dpar 'gyur/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ de dag lam ni ji lta bu/ /log pa'i lam yang ci 'dra zhig /bla med byang chub lam du ni/ /ji ltar sems can rab tu 'god/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ lam ni pha rol phyin pa drugayo/tsho /theg pa chung ngu log pa'i lam/ /shes rab thabs la bslabs 1 pa ni/ /sems can lam la 'dzud 18pa'o/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ ji lta 19bur na nor chen 'gyur/ /de dag rnyed pa'ang ci 'dra da tshozhig /gter rnams kyang ni ji lta bu/ /gang gis de dag 'gro tshim byedarka/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ nor bdun dang 58wa 746

ni rtag tu ldan/ /chos rnyed pa ni rnyed pa'o/ /de dag gter ni gzungs 1)yin te / rab tu rnyed nas tshim par byed/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ de dag gi ni pha ma gang / /nye du'i tshogs ni ji lta bu/ /g.yog rnams kyang ni ci 'dra zhig /gang gis mkhas pa de dag mdzes/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ ma ni shes rab pha ni thabs/ /nye du byang chub phyogs rnams yin/ /dge ba rnams ni g.yog yin te/ /des ni mkhas pa de dag mdzes / /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ ji ltar bdag med rtogs nas ni/ /byams pas 'gro ba khyab par byed/ /bdag med pa dang byams pa dag45 /de la ji ltar mtshungs par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ gang dag stong nyid rab shes pa/ /de ni bdag med khong du chud/ /gang gis 'gro ba stong shes pa/ /de ni de yi byams pa mchog /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ 'du byed rnams ni rang bzhin gyis/ /'ong ba med cing 'gro med na/ /las dang las kyi rnam par smin/ /ji lta bur na 'thad ri dpar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ dam pa'i don du 'ong med de/ /gang du'ang 'gro ba yod ma yin/ /kun rdzob tu nam4)lam 'jug cing / /rnam par smin pa nye bar ston/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ stong nyid mtshan ma med pa dang / /smon lam rnam par spangs par ni/ /mtshan nyid gcig tu rab rtogs nas/ /de kho na ni ji ltar shes/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rigazugs rnams kyis smras 0)pa/ stong nyid gang yin de mtshan med/ /mtshan ma don du gnyer med pa/ /mtshan nyid gcig 7cing don gcig ste/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo bstan to/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa / gang gis mya ngan 'das 'gro 58—747

ba'i / /stong par rtog pa ji lta bu/ /sems can lta ba ji lta bu/ /yongs su smin byed ji lta bu/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras phu)pa/shes rab kyis ni stong par rtogs kyi/ /thabs kyis sems can rnams la lta/ /snying rjes yongs su smin par byed/ /des ni mya ngan 'das par 'gro/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/ chos 'di dag ni chos nyid kyis/ /skye ba med cing 'byung med par/ /tshul mchog 'di 'dra shes nas ni/ /gang gis 'khor bar skye bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ mi skye ba dang mi 'byung ba/ /de ni shes rab spyod yul lo/ /bsams cadabazhin du ni gang skye ba/ /de ni thabs kyi tshul yin no/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras pa/gtong la dga' bar ji ltar 'gyur/ /ji lta 5bur ni ne phyir mi ldog /ji ltar bzod pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar rnam par nges par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ mnyam par gnas par gtong la dga' / /chos kyi dbyings las phyir mi ldog /mi skye ba la bzod pa ste/ /chos shes nas ni rnam par nges/ /sil snyan rnams kyis smras 7)pa/ byang chub snying po snying po gang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub mtshan nyid gang / /ci 8)phyir rdzogs sangs rgyas shes 9bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ji ltar grol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs rnams kyis smras pa/ byang chub snying po nam mkha' ste/ /byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do/ /gang yang kun nas gti mug med/ /de bzhin nyid phyir de bzhin gshegs/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po'i bu de dag gis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag thos nas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob bo/ /de dag gis bzod pa rab tu thob nas rang rang gi gos dang rgyan 58—748

bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bkab ste/ 'di skad ces kyang gsol to1kyi/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gi slad du bdag cag gis nyan pa'i rna ba 'di lta bu thob pas sangs rgyas ni bdag cag gi ched du byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das sil snyan dang glu dbyangs 'di dag las the com tshon/'dri ba'i sgra 'di lta bu byung ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs 'di dag gis dris pa de dag thams cad kyi lan btab pas 'khor 'di'i dogs pa thams cad spangs pa dang / bdag cag kyang chos kyi sa snang ba dpag tu ma mchis pa skyes pa ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das sil snyan de dag las sgra 'di lta bu byung ba'i rgyu ci lags/ su'i byin gyi rlabasam kyis na byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs 'di dag gis lan 'debs par gyur5 / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzangs (6dag de dag thams cad ni sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi brlabs ri su blta'o/ /bzhin bzangasas dag de bzhin 9gshegs pa'i byin gyi brlabs 3 rikyis/ nam mkha' las kyang chos kyi sgra 'di lta bu byung na sil snyan las chos kyi sgra ci 11phyir mi 'byung ste/bzhin bzangs 12dag de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs lha ni bsam gyis 1 )mi khyab bo/ /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po'i bu de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad 15kyis sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs 17bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par gyur cig/ //bam po bzhi pa/ de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i slas mi 'am ci mo brgyad khri bzhi stong mu tig kha dog sna tshogs kyi do shal thogs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 1 nas ji ltar thogs pa'i mu tig gi do shal de dag gis bcom 58—749

ldan 'das la mngon par bkab bo/ /mu tig gi do shal de dag phul ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi 1mthus de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu (5)gtsug gi drang thad kyi 3)steng gi bar snang la mu tig gi do shal gyi khang pa brtsegs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong du gyur 4te/ khang pa brtsegasam5)pa de dag thams cad kyang gru bzhi lham pa/ ka ba bzhi zug pa/ cha mnyam pa/ ngos shin tu rnam par phye ba sha stag go/ /khang pa brtsegs 6pa de dag ni 7rin po ches spras pa'i khri rtsa ba yang rin po che las byas pa / lha'i ras bcos ma'i zung du ma bkram pa dag byung bar gyur to/ /khri de dag thams cad la yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa dag bzhugs par kun tu snang ngo / /de nas mi 'am ci namo brgyad khri bzhi stong gis bcom ldan 'das kyi cho 'phrul 'di lta bu 'di mthong nas/ tshim zhing mgus49 ste yid rab tu dga' nas dga' ba dang /yid bde ba skyes te bsam pa thag pa nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de dag byang chub tu sems bskyed tshanas dga' zhing 11mchog tu dga' ste dad pas12thob nas/ thams cad kyis 1 sgra skad dang dbyangs gcig tu tshul dang 'thun sapa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /bla na med pa'i dgra bcom mchog gsung ba / /don dgongs mtshungs pa ma mchis bsam mi khyab/ /don dang chos dang 'dul ba rab bslabs tshapa/ /sems can mchog la mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug tha ba 'jig /dgon par bzhugs dgyes bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba/ /rin chen mdzod dang rin chen ston pa po/ /bcom ldan rgyal po'i sargyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan sngar dri bral nyon mongs mi mnga' 58—750

bte/ / sa yi dbang tsho1po pha rol dgra 'joms napa/ /pad mo lta bur srid gsum mi gos pa/ /bde gshegs mchog brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i nang na mig dang 'drar spyod cing / /nyi zla 'di yi ri 'od ni spa bkong ba/ /'khor los sgyur54)ba'i rigs su rgyal por skyes/ /'khor lo55mtshan mnga' 'khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ming dang gzugs la nam yang mi chags shing / /mgon dang dpung dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen gyur/ /khyod dang mtshungs med lhag pa ga la zhig /mtha' yas dbyangs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /brnyes dang ma brnyesam7nam yang chags mi mnga'/ /'jig rten chos rnams zil gyis mnan te bzhugs / /chags sred 'khri shing dra ba grol mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan 'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dul ba thugs ni rtag tu mnyam par gzhagarin /nyon mongs bsregs te stobs bcus rab bzhugs shing / /'gro la zang zing mi mnga' sbyin stsol pa/ /sbyin pa'i gnas la mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra mchog dam pa mtshan gyi 'od 'phros pa9ri/ /lam log phyin ci log ni rnam par spangs/ /'jam zhing snum la snyan 1 ripa'i gsung gsung pa/ /srid pa gsum las 'phags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi mchog gdung bas gdungs pa mi mnga' ba/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni bye ba'i zhing du gshegs/ /'gro ba rab tu sgrol ba'i gru 11 mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan bran 'dra khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan brtson 'grus dag la ston mdzad pa/ /chags shing zhen pa'i 'gro dang mngon shes drug /ldan zhing mkhas pa'i nyan thos rnams kyang 'grel12/ /'gro drug nye gshegs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser gyi kha dog 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi gnas dbang po dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ston gyi 1 zla 'dra'i 1 zhal la phyag 'tshal lo mi mchog 58—751

yon tan mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs bsregs ①shing bsnyengs rinapa mi mnga' ba/ /skye dgu dkyi'adi dag bsgral dka' chu bzhi canasgrol/ /bsgoms shing dbang po thul ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ /khyod la skyabs su mchi bar zhu)mchid kyis 'tshalam/ /thub pas sbyin pa bsam gyis mi khyab stsal/ /bslangs na dbang po dgyes par rab 'gyur ba/ /pha rol dag la sbyin pa mchog stsol ba/ /gtong dpa' 6bcom ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can nga rgyal rgyags khengs gti mug pa/ /rgyu dang rkyen dang bya ba 'gal bgyid rnams/ /'phags pa bla na med pa'i lam mchog la/ /rnam par 'dren pa chen po khyod kyis bkod/ /phung po rang bzhin gyis ni stong mkhyen nas/ /las dang nyon mongs zil gyis mnan te bzhugs/ /'dren pa 'gro ba rnams kyi som nyi gcod/ /bcom ldan dus gsung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden pa'i chos la dgyes 7)shing mnyam par bzhagan /chos rnams kun la mnga' dbang pha rol phyin/ /bla na med pa kha lo sgyur ba mchog /bcom ldan ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo 'chos 49)pa mi mnga' g.yo sgyu rnams dang bral/ /bdud kyi sde rnams 'joms 1 pa'i stobs po che / /mi mchog lam dang lam ma lags la mkhas/ /rlung dmar 11lta bur ci la'ang chags mi mnga'/ /gzir bar gyur gsal pha rol shin tu gnas/ /thub pa bas ma 'tshal ba'i bang mdzod mnga'/ /spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe na gang gā yi12/ /bye ma snyed kyi mi mchog rnams la mchod/ /mthu brnyes mi g.yo bsam gyis mi khyab pa / /chags pa'i skyon mi mnga' zhing thang la bzhugs/ /gnas na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rnams kyis bsten1 / /de slad mi rnams mchog la phyag 'tshal mo skye dang na dang rga shi rnam par spangs/ /tshe rabs bye ba bsam mi khyab pa 1 dgongs//58—752

bcom ldan 'das kyi 911mkhyen pa'i gdugs 'od kyis/ /'jigs pa chen po'i dra tshonab rab tu 'dral/ /'dren pa rmi 'drar chos rnams thugs su chud/ /phyag dang zhabs la bkra shis mtshan mnga' zhing / /bkra shis bgyidam kyilas 'jam pa'i ran caslong ba/ /bcom ldan bkra shis mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzungs 5rnams la ni dbang gi pha rol phyin/ /zang zing mi mnga' chos kyi sbyin pa stsol/ /thub pa chos kyi rnga ni rab brdungs pa/ /chos rje bcom ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya'i rigs dus 6rgyal po'i las byung ba/ /dbang po zhi zhing thugs kyang rab tu zhi/ /ston pa srid gsum 'jig rten rnam 7gzigs pa/ /bde gshegs zhi thugs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud rnams dpung dang bcas pas rno ba yi/ /ral gri thogs nas byang chub drung lhags kyang / /khyod kyi ba spu tsam yang ma g.yos te / /bcom ldan ri rab mtshungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mi yi na dam pa bzod pa'i 9pha rol phyin/ /sku rnams kun la nongs pa bgyis kyang bzod/ /yang 'byung ba dang skye dang 'chi bas dpa'/ / /bzod gsung bcom ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu brnyes bde bar gshegs pa mi g.yo ba/ /gnas dang gnas min 11mkhas pa bsnyengs mi mnga'/ /khyod kyis sems can mang po byang chub bkod / /chos gnas rgyal ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dus bgyis nyam 12chung snying po med par mkhyen/ /skye ba'i tshogs ni nyung ba ma lags sel/ /khyod kyi mkhyen pa srid gsum khyad par 'phags/ /ye shes pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo//sems can long ba sdug bsngal mgon med pa/ /de dag khyod kyis dkon mchog gsum tshim bgyis/ /khyod ni bdud dpung bcas pa skrag mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan mgon gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs dang bsam gtan dang ni dbang 58—753

po bsgoms1/ /khyod kyis bdud ni dpung dang bcas pa bcom/ /srid pa rnams kyi nang na mchog gyur pa/ /thub pa dbang po bsgoms dunaskul phyag 'tshal lo /dad pa'i rtsa ba rgya chen chos bstan pa/ /mtshungs med byang chub la ni lachags mi mnga' / /grib ma lta bur mkhyen nas bde gsungs sa)pa/ /bcom ldan gdugs 'dra khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dren pa rmi lta'adrar chos rnams thugs su chud/ /'phags pa'i 'khor lo rmi 'dra rab tu bskor/ /'dus bgyis yang dag tu ni〈)rmi lam 'drar/ /mkhyen nas sems can mang po dran par mdzad/ /khyod kyi ljags mchog dag pa dri mi mnga' tsho/ /ljags kyis rang gi zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khebs / /ljags ni pad ma 'dab 8ma brgya lta bu/ /ljags skyon mi mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid gsum kun la chags pa mi 9 mnga' ba/ /'gro ba rnams la 'dod pa'i skyon mi gsung / /'dod pa'i chags bral smad pa ma lags pa / /byang chub mchog la 1 srog chags mos par mdzad/ /nyon mongs dgra dang sdig pa'i dgra spangs pa/ /ser nyinasna'i 'dod chags bral zhing chags mi mnga'/ / mi yi 12dam pa gser ltar dpal stugs12pa/ /khyod kyi mtshan dang grags pa chub par grags/ /gnas dang dbang po rnam par 'byed sal mkhas/ /'di na bzhugs shing 'gro ba'i mig tu gyur/ /gnas dang yig 'bru tshig gi don bslabs sa pas / /khyod kyis chu bo bzhi la khozam pa btags/ /glang po rin thang ma mchis sbyin pa mdzad/ /'dren pa mi dang lha rnams sgrol ba po/ /khyod kyi yon tan mtha' ma mi rnyed de/ /mgon po khyod la bdag ni thal mo sbyar1 / /mi yi mchog la rdul ni sbyin byin pas/ /mi mjed 'dzam bu'i 18rgyal por gyur lags na/ /'dir 19ni dbang po dang bas 2 thal sbyar nas/ /skyabs su nye bar mchi ba smos 58—754

ci 'tshal/ /phung po gsog ste nyam 7chung snying po med/ /stong pa sgyu ma chu zla 'dra bar ni/ /gi tam khyod kyis de dag yang dag mkhyen/ /phung po khams mkhas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sred pa'i sradadzan bus dam du mdud bor te/ /srid pa'i 'gro bar dra bar rab grags pa/ /srid par 'gro ba rnams kyi dra ba de(gyi/ /bde gshegs khyod kyi ri4)mkhyen pa'i 'od kyis dral/ /tshangs pa'i sgra skad lta bu'i gsung brjod pa/ /sho be ma lags mi 'gyur 'drid ma lags/ /phun tshogs gsung de de dag thos nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar te skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /phyag gi mthil gyis sa 'dir reg pa na/ /nags tshal bcas par rnam (5pa drug g.yos kyang / /'dir ni gzhan la gnod par 'gyur ma mchis/ /bdud phyogs dgra bcom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lha yi stso)rgyal po che dang mkhas pa gang / /khyod kyi57 chos don gnyer zhing mchis pa rnams/ /de dag so sor chos bstan thos nas su/ /zhabs gnyis la ni rab tu gtugasam58)par bgyid/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po'i slas rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la yang dag par zhugs nas bud med kyi dngos pos bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi nus na/ ji ltar bdag cag bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te/ skyes pa'i dngos po 'thob 9pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyangasamangon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos de nyu1ribacom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la legs par bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang /58—755

bcom ldan 'das kyis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i slas de dag la 'di skad ce sa bka' stsal to/ /sring mo dag de'i phyir shin tu legs par nyon la yid la zung shig 1dang / ji ltar bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po 'thob na cing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba ngas khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po'i slas rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes gsol te / bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sring mo dag chos gcig dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob cing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ chos gcig po de gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pas byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems bskyed 5)pa dang ske/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i sems bskyed 6pa dang / 'jig rten gsum las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la brjed 8pa med pa'i sems bskyed 9pa ste/ sring mo dag chos gcig po 1 'di dang ldan na bud med bud med 11kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i lus thob par 'gyur ro/ /sring mo dag gzhan yang chos gnyis dang ldan na bud med bud med 12kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i lus 1 thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phrag dog med pa dang / ser sna med pa ste/sring mo dag chos 'di gnyis dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /sring mo dag gzhan yang chos gsum 58—756

dang ldan na bud med bud med7kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lus kyi sdom pa gsum yongs su dag pa dang / ngag gi sdom pa bzhi yongs su dag pa dang / yid kyi sdom pa gsum yongs su dag pa ste/ sring mo dag chos gsum po 'di dag dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur rol/ /sring mo dag gzhan yang chos bzhi dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ g.yo med par sbyin pa sbyin 3)pa dang / g.yo med par bslab 3)pa'i gnas 'dzin pa dang / g.yo med par tshul khrims sten 4)pa dang / g.yo med par chos nyan pa ste/ sring mo dag chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na bud med bud medapodakyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /sring mo dag gzhan yang chos lnga dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/chos don du gnyer ba dang / chos thos nas tshul bzhin du so sor rtog pa dang /bsam pa thag pa nas bud med kyi dngos po la smod pa dang / rtag par rgyun du skyes pa'i lus 'thob 6par sems skyed 7 pa dang / ji skad lde smras pa de bzhin du byed pa ste/ sring mo dag chos lnga po 'di dag dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /sring mo dag gzhan yang chos drug dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te/skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ drang ba dang / mnyen 9pa dang / sgyu 1 med pa dang / g.yo med pa dang / bstsal 1158—757

ba med pa dang / bcos pa med pa ste/ sring mo dag chos drug po 'di dag dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi kyenodangos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /sring mo dag gzhan yang chos bdun dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /bdun gang zhe na / 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sku thob par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thob par bya ba'i phyir chos rjes su dran pa dang ske/ rang gis phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun bsdu ba'i phyir dge 'dun rjes su dran pa dang / smon lam yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir tshul khrims rjes su dran pa dang / nyon mongs pa nathams cad yongs su dor ba'i phyir gtong ba rjes su dran pa dang / byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir lha rjes su dran pa dang / de dag dgrol ba'i phyir sems can thams cad la sems pa ste/sring mo dag chos bdun po 'di dag dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /sring mo dag gzhan yang chos brgyad dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ zas la srid pa ma yin pa dang / skom la sred pa ma yin pa dang / me tog dang / spos dang phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma la srid pa ma yin pa dang / skyed mos tshal du 'gro bar sred pa ma yin pa dang / rgod pa dang 'jo ba la sred pa ma yin pa dang / glu dang gar dang rol mo'i dbyangs sgra la srid pa ma yin pa dang ske/ dga' ba dang rtse ba la sred pa ma yin pa dang / rna ba dang / sgra dang /sna dang / dri dang / lce dang / ro dang / lus dang / reg la dga' ba la 58—758

sred pa ma yin pa ste/ sring mo dag chos brgyad po 'di dag dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /sring mo dag gzhan yang chos dgu dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/chad par lta ba ma yin pa dang / rtag par lta ba ma yin pa dang / bdag tu smra ba ma yin pa dang / sems can du smra ba ma yin pa dang / srog tu smra ba ma yin pa dang / gang zag tu smra ba ma yin pa dang / 'byung bar lta ba ma yin pa dang /'jig par lta ba ma yin pa dang / rgyu dang rkyen la 'jug pa la mkhas pa yin te/sring mo dag chos dgu po 'di dag dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /sring mo dag gzhan yang chos bcu dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po 7)las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad la byams par gnas pa dang / gzhan gyi longs spyod la brnab sems mi skyedadza pa dang / skyes pa'i sems su yid la byed pa skyed ri pa dang / srog gi phyir yang rdzun 4)gyi tshig mi smra ba dang / phra ma'i tshig mi smra ba dang / zhe gcod pa'i tshig mi smra ba dang / tshig kyal pa mi smra ba dang / pha rol po dgar zhing rtse ba la phrag dog med pa dang / gnod sems kyi bag la nyal mngon par mi 555sgrub pa dang / yang dag par lta ba dang ldan par 'gyur56)ba dang rnam par smin pa la re ba med pa ste/ sring mo dag chos bcu po 'di dag dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i 7dngos po thob par 'gyur ro/ /sring mo dag gzhan yang bud med zab mo la mose pa yin te/ de gzugs la dbumachos ba 58—759

rdos 51pa lta bur so sor rtog kyang nagazugs kyis rgyags shing myos ③par mi 'gyur ba dang / tshor ba la chu'i chu bur lta bur canaso sor rtog kyang 95)bde ba'i tshor ba la rjes su chags pa med pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba la khong khro bar mi 'gyur ba dang / bde ba yang ma yin sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa'i tshor ba'i56)kun tu gti mug par mi 'gyur ba dang / 'du shes la smig rgyu lta bur so sor rtog cing bud med kyi 'du shes mi skyed/ skyes pa'i 'du shes mi skyed pa dang /'du byed rnams la chu shing gi phung po lta bur so sor rtog ste/ 'du byed thams cad la snying po med par rtogs nas 'du byed thams cad la mi gnas shing de la chags 7pa mi skyed pa dang / rnam par shes pa la sgyu ma lta bur so sor rtog ste/sems dang yid dang rnam par rig pa de 8sgyu ma byas pa bzhin du rtogs nas chos thams cad la chags pa med zhe sdang med gti mug med pa dang / lus la 'byung ba chen po bzhi dang ldan par so sor rtog 9ste/ 'di lta ste/ sa'i khams dang ldan pa dang / chu'i khams dang ldan pa dang / me'i khams dang ldan pa dang ske/ rlung gi khams dang ldan par lus la so sor rtog go/ /lus 'di ni bsdus pa rtswa dang / shing dang / bong ba dang / rtsig pa dang / mig yor lta bu ste/ 'di bdag ma yin/ sems can ma yin/ srog ma yin/ skyes bu tsho ma yin/ gang zag ma yin gyi phyin ci log sngon du song bas rgyu dang bya ba dang /las kyi 11byung ba'o/ /gzhan yang bud med mig la kha zas las skyes pa sha'i gong bu ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa 1 rang bzhin gyis dben par yang dag pas1 ji lta ba bzhin du so sor rtog pa dang / de bzhin du rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /lus dang / yid la ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa dang / rang bzhin gyis 1 dben 58—760

par yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du so sor rtog7)pa'o/ /gzhan yang bud med lus la gzugs brnyan lta bur 'jug pa dang / ngag la brag ca (0lta bur 'jug pa dang / sems la sgyu ma lta bur 'jug pa'o/ /sring mo dag chos 'di dag dang ldan na bud med bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i dngos po thob cing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i slas de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das las bud med kyi dngos po las sgyur k+ṣ-i ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas tshim zhing mgu ste/ yi5gerangs shing rab tu dga' nas dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshalam nas tshul dang 'thun 6pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /dri med dri bral dri ma gcod mdzad pa/ /rdul med rdul bral lhas pa'i gzi brjid mnga'/ /pad ma'i 'dab 'dra'i kyispyan dang mdzes pa'i thugs/ /dri med zla zhal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dga' mdzad zhi 3rimadzad nyon mongs gcod mdzad pa/ /dga' ba stonas495pa rtag tu dgon par dgyes / /rin chen 'byung gnas rin chen mdzod mnga' ba/ /yon tan mchog mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pha rol gshegs pa gzhan gyi tshogs rnems 'joms la/ /pad ma lta bur stong mchog bka' mchid gsung / /lam mchog stsol cing 1 dam pa'i don ston pa/ /mchog tu dga' mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo / /chu bo bzhi rgal 12bden bzhi'i bka' mchid gsung / /sa la rgyu ba 'di la mig stsol ba/ /'khor lo mchog gi mtshan ni stong mnga' ba/ /rdul med phan mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs rdul bsal dam pa mthu bo che/ /58—761

mgon po 'gro la mchog gi don mdzad pa/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams stobs med 'jig mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan stobs bcu khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sred pa'i 'khri shing gcod 1)mdzad mnyam pa med/ /brnyes pa dag dang ma brnyes mtshungs mnyam thugs/ /'jig rten mthar 'byin snang ba'i sgron mdzad pa/ /rgya mtsho lta bu khyod la phyag na 'tshal lo/ /dul zhing stobs bcu chen po dam pa mnga'/ /sbyin pa stsol cings nortag tu gtong la dgyes/ /dul ba zhi gnas yon tan pha rol phyin / /nyon mongs rdul bsal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan mchog 'gro ba kun la dam pa stsol/ /skye bo'i 'dren pa lha yisangasamachog pas mchog /byams dang stobs dang bzod la nges par dgyes/ /mchod 'os bde gshegs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mar me lta bu dri med zla ba 'dra/ /phyi nang nyon mongs dri ma gcod mdzad pa/ /nyon mongs spangs pa yon tan bsod nams gter/ /zhi ba thugs zhi khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad pa stsol ba dge sbyong zhi mdzad pa/ /ston pa skye mched drug las thar mdzad pa/ /rjes su dran drug shin tu yongs dag dran//rgyal ba dge sbyong rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dom gang 'od ni gser gyi kha dog bltar / /gsung snyan nedam pa rnam par dag pa'i dbyangs/ /bcom ldan gang zag dam pa skyes bu mchog /srid gsum zhi mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab mun pa ma mchis pha rol gshegs/ /rtag tu dka' thub brtul zhugs rab tu spyod/ /de bzhin khon gzhan min de bzhin gsung / /mun par sgron ma 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs grags ldan yon tan bas ma 'tshal ske/ /de bzhin nyid kyi chos kyi gnas ston pa/ /yon tan brjod pa mthong zhing grags bsgrags pas/ /mchog tu dga' mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /58—762

bsngags la gnas shing brtul zhugs dka' thub 'phags/ /khengs dang nga rgyal rgyags pa gcod mdzad pa/ /ye shes 'byung gnas rdul bral blo gros mchog /skye bo mthar phyin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /17la ying ka tshangs dbyangs thugs rje can / /'dod pa rtsod bgyid〈(dri ma sel mdzad pa/ /phung po yongs mkhyen mkhas pa bde bar gshegs/ /yon tan tshogs mchog mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan ston pa yon tan bstod ldemachod pa/ /zab mo blta dka' shin tu rtogs par dka'/ /'dzum zhal zla 'dra gsong por gsung mdzad pa/ /bdud stobs 'jomasam nomadzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam thugs kha lo sgyur (3)ba rab dul thugs/ /kun gyis mngon bstod mnyam pa'i lam la gnas/ /thub 'chipa mchog gsung bden pa'i bka' mchid can/ /bde gshegs mnyam thugs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam stsol snyan pa shin tu 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bdud kyi sde mang 'joms 47mdzad nga rgyal dang / /lhag pa'i nga rgyal mi mnga' tshul mi 'chos/ /thub pa dge sbyong rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs dang mthu dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan dgyes/ /rtag tu 'dod chags skyon dang rab rib bral/ /bde bar gshegs pa mi nagayo gnas la zhugs/ /stobs bcu mchog mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag dang zhabs ni dri med dra bas 'brel kyi/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi ba mi mnga' ba/ /rgyal bar 1 ri'os pa 'gro ba kun las rgyal/ /nam mkha' mnyam thugs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i slas mi 'am ci'i bu 11mo brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs 12pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa mkhyen nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis 1 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /58—763

'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos nyid de gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer du ma kha dog sna tshogs byung ste/ 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po dang / le brganam1)dang / shel dang dngul gyi kha dog lta bu'o/ /de dag gis ciga'ajig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med par 'od kyis khyab par byas te dzi / tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du mngon par 'phags nas nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od mog mog por byas te/ slar log nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tu nub bo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar nas/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te zhe sa dang bcas shing gus pa dang bcas par bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de tshigs su bcad pa mngon par bsgrub pa pa 'dis bcom ldan 'das la 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i don zhus pa/ bde bar gshegs pa cis slad 'dzum ston pa/ /zla ba dri ma med zhal khyodas la zhu/ /dri med gzi brjid mnga' ba khyod la zhu/ /gser gyi kha dog lta bu khyod la zhu/ /bde bar gshegs pa ci slad 'dzum ston pa/ /dam pa'i gzugs rnams mnga' ba khyod la zhu/ /'gro ba rnams kyi don mdzad khyod la zhu/ /lha dang mi rnams kyis mchod khyod la zhu/ /bde bar gshegs pa ci slad 'dzum ston pa/ /sbyin dang dul la dgyes pa khyod la zhu/ /tshul khrims yongs dag gyur pa khyod la zhu/ /bzod pa'i stobs dang stobs stsol khyod la zhu/ /bde bar gshegs pa ci slad 'dzum ston pa/ /brtson 'grus stobs dang mthu mnga' khyod la zhu/ /bsam gtan mngon shes dgyes pa khyod la zhu/ /shes rab 58—764

nam mkha' mnyam pa khyod la zhu/ /bde bar gshegs pa ci slad 'dzum ston pa37/ /rtag tu byams pa'i thugs can khyod la zhu/ /rtag tu thugs rje ldan pa khyod la zhu/ /dga' dang (gebatang snyoms dgyes pa khyod la zhu/ /bde bar gshegs pa ci slad 'dzum ston pa/ /srid pa gsum po mthar 'byin khyod la zhu/ /spyan gsum dri ma mi mnga' khyod la zhu/ /bdud rtsi chos rnams gsung ba khyod la zhu/ /bde bar gshegs pa ci slad 'dzum ston pa/ /bdud rnams tha mar 'byin pa khyod la zhu/ /ngan pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms pa khyod la zhu/ /bden pa dam pa gzigs pa khyod la zhu/ /bde bar gshegs pa ci slad 'dzum ston pa/ /stobs bcu dam pa mnga' ba khyod la zhu/ /the tsoms dag ni gcod mdzad khyod la zhu/ /yon tan stong gis brgyan pa khyod la zhu/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdongs po'i slas rnams nga 6las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed do / /bsam pa thag pa nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 85byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ bud med kyi dngos po las bsgyur zhing skyes pa'i dngos po thob par bya ba'i phyir nga'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs pa mthong ngam / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo mi 'am ci'i slas brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag gis 9bsam pa thag pa nas dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa 'dis 'di ni 1 shi 'phos nas bud med kyi dngos po las gyur te skyes pa'i lus thob nas dga' ldan gyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang lhan cig tu sangs rgyas bcom 58—765

ldan 'das rnams kyi rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'di kun 'gro7)ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /byams pa de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub thob pa na mnyes par byed cing dam pa'i chos kyang kun bgro batshanabyed par 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa bzang po'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la yang rim gyis mnyes par byed par 'gyur/ de dag gis )dam pa'i chos kyang kun bgro ba 3)byed par 'gyur/ 'dzin par 'gyur ro//de dag rim gyis byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos yang dag par bsgrub (lde)par bya ba thams cad kun tu rdzogs par byas nas/ gang gi tshe mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs 6pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba de'i tshe de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar 'gyur te/ des de me dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par yang 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas bdag cag la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad do/ /ngan song ngan 'gro thams cad kyi lam bkum mo/ /bde 'gro thams cad kyi lam rnam par sbyangs so/ /bdag cag byang chub kyi lam la rab tu bkod do/ /bdag cag la chos kyi gter bstan to/ /bdag cag ye shes kyi sa la bkod do/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'bar bar bgyis so/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs bstan to/ /thabs la mkhas pa bstan to/ /bdag cag byang chub kyi sems yang dag par 'dzin pa nastsal to/ /chos bsgrags pas rab tu dga' bar mdzad do/ /dga' ba dang dang ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba thob pas gzengs 9bstod do/ /chos zab mo'i bzod pa la rab tu dga' bar mdzad do/ /bdag cag phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la rab tu bkod do/ /bdag 58—766

cag ni bcom ldan 'das la byas pa gzo 1ba lags kyi byas pa mi gzo 2ba ma lags kyang bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis sha dang khrag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la lan mi lon na gzhan gyis lan ldon dpar mi 'gyur ba lta casmos kyang ci 'tshal/ de nas 'khor de'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' kha cig 'di snyam du sems te/ ma la mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po 'di ji srid cig na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur / 'di'i ming ni ji skad ces bya bar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun ni ji snyed cig tu 'gyur/ longs spyod dang yongs su spyod pa ni ji 'dra zhig tu 'gyur/ de'i sems can bkod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa ni ji 'dra ba zhig tu 'gyur snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sems kyi rnam par rtog pa thugs kyisapo)yongs su mkhyen nas 'dzum pa mdzad pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer du ma kha dog tha dad pa kha dog brgya stong phrag du ma byung ste/phyogs bcu kun gyi phyogs re rer yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bar byasam note/ sems can rnams kyi ngan song gi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byas nas lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dun par byas te slar log nas bcom ldan 'das la lan stong du bskor ba byas te/bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsugs tu nub bo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon chad ma mdzad pa'i 'dzum pa namathong nas stan las langs te thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal 9te / lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug ste 58—767

pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pas gsol pa/ bde bar gshegs kyi 'dzum pa ci 'dra ba/ /de ring phyung ste thug 1)med bye ba'i zhing / /rgya chen phyogs bcu'i gang gā'i rdul mtha' yas/ /khyab pa de 'dra sngon chad yong ma mthong / /tshangs pa de bzhin 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /nor bu me dang nyi ma zla ba'i 'od/ /mi dbang gzi brjid kyis ni mog mog gyuran / /'dzum mdzad 'di yi 3rgyu ni lung bstan gsol/ /su yi ched du dpa' bo khyod kyis 'od phyung bas/ /'dir ni ngan song gsum zhi byang chub yan lag rdzogs/ /chos kyi rje yis bdag cag rnams kyi dogs pa sol/ /mi rnams kyi ni yid gnyis ma lus legs par khum/ /'khor kun dga' bas rtog bgyid na / /su slad de ring 'dzum pa bstan/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod nas bskor ba byas te rang gi stan la 4)'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe glang po che'i lta stangs ru)kyis phyogs bcur gzigs nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po 'dis tshul 'di lta bu dang / rgya che ba 'di lta bu dang /rnam pa 'di lta bu 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa byas pa mthong ngam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po 'di bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad na nebla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya 58—768

ste / dkon mchog 'byung gnas 1)zhes bya ba'i bskal pa la 'jig rten gyi khams zla ba dri ma med ces bya bar nayon tan gyi rgyal por snang ba zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su 'jig rten du 'byung ngo / /kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams zla ba dri ma med pa de ni lag mthil ltar mnyam par 'gyur 5te/ bai drur+ya 4nodakar po las grub pa/ zla ba lta bur snang ba/ shin tu dri ma med pa/shin tu rnam par dag pa/ mching bu med pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun yang tshad med par gyur 5te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog pa/ rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob pa sha stag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag ni nam mkha' la khang pa brtsegs pa na longs spyod de96/ de dag nam mkha' la khang pa brtsegs pa na 7gnas pa na be+e drur+ya nadakar po las grub pa'i sa chen po der bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan gyi rgyal por snang ba de'i gzugs brnyan mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis mthong ma thag tu chos 'di dag thams cad ni gzugs brnyan lta bu'o 9 zhes dran pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang chos gang la the tsom 1 za ba na de de bzhin gshegs pas de la snang bar gyur pa de la zhu bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa des kyang byang chub sems dpa' de dag la zhus pa'i lung bstan pas sems rangs par mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis 11chos de thos 58—769

nas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams de na grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang /ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor yod par mi 'gyur rol/ /sems can de dag thams cad kyang nam mkha' la khang pa brtsegs pa na 'khod par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bud med du gdags pa'ang med par 'gyur ro/ /sems can de dag thams cad kyang pad ma'i snying po las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams de na kha zas su gdags pa med de/ sems can de dag thams cad ni bsam gtan la dga' ba dang /chos la dga' ba'i zas can du 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams de na gzhan rnam par gzhag pa med de/ sems can de dag thams cad ni theg pa chen po la nges par 'gyur ba dag gon/ /'jig rten gyi khams de na tshul khrims log par zhugs pa'am/ lta ba log par dazhugs pa'am/ cho ga log par zhugs pa'amal/ 'tsho ba log par zhugs pa'i sems can 'ga' yang med par 'gyur ro//sems can de dag thams cad ni nan tan dang ldan pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la brtson 'grus brtsams par 'gyur ba sha stag go/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na bdud dam/ bdud kyi ris kyi lha'am/ gzhan mu stegs can spyod pa can dang ske/ kun tu rgyu dang dmigs pa'i lta ba la mngon par zhen pa dang / pha rol rgol ba med par 'gyur ro/ /sems can de dag thams cad ni zab mo'i spyod yul stong pa nyid kyi phyag rgyas btab par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams de nas ming du btags pa tsam dang / 'du shes tsam ma gtogs par lha dang mi zhes tha dad du bya ba med par 'gyur ro/ /sems can de dag thams cad ni yongs su 58—770

spyodatubasnyematshungs par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das yon tan gyi rgyal por snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yang lha dang / mi rnams kyisaskye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba'i phyir bar gyi bskal pa bcu tham par bzhugs par 'gyur rol/ /bcom ldan 'das yon tan gyi rgyal por snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa de gang gi tshe yongs su mya ngan las 'das par bzhed pa de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus 'bar ba 'di nga'i 'og tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te / bkod pa chen po zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su 'gyur ro zhes byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus 'bar ba zhes bya ba lung bstan nas mya ngan las 'da' bar5ge'agyur ro/ /kun dga' bo bar gyi bskal pa de yang sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang chos dkon mchog dang dge 'dun dkon mchog dang mi 'bralam45bar 'gyur te/ bar gyi bskal pa de ni dkon mchog 'byung ba zhes brjod do/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos bcom ldan 'das las lung bstan pa thos nas dga' zhing mgulaste/ yi〈perangs shing rab tu dga' nas/ dga' ba dang rka/ yid bde ba skyes te/ byang chub sems dpa'i dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba'i shugs kyis sa las steng gi bar snang lasashing ta la bdun tsam du 'phags te/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor dad pa rgya cher〈spel ba dang /58—771

dge ba'i rtsa ba yang 1dag par bskyed pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / rang gi shes rab kyi spobs pas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /chos 'di thams cad rab tu dben pa dang / /dri ma med de nam mkha'i lango bo nyid/ /rgyud kyi dam pa 'di ni rnam shes na/ /de phyir de dag thub sras rathu bor 'gyur/ /rmi lam bzhin du mthong ba cung zad med/ /thams cad med de gzung 4)med gsog dang gsobar/ /chos rnams thams cad rmi lam 'drar shes nas/ /'dus byas dag la (skyo bar 'gyur ba med/ /la las sgyu ma'i rta dang glang chen dang ske/ /shing rta dpung bu chung dang bzhon mthong ba/ /dam pa'i don du snying po med pa ltar/ /phung po 'di dag sgyu 'dra snying po med/ /gzugs kyi rang bzhin dbu ba rdos 7 pa bzhin/ /tshor ba 'di ni chu yi 8chu bur 'dra/ /'du shes dag ni smig rgyu 'dra bar gsungs9/ /'dus byas thams cad chu shing snying po med / /srid gsum 'di ni 1 risems yid rnam par shes/ /rgyal bas de bzhin sgyu 'dra gsog tu gsungs/ /gzugs kyi rang bzhin stong par rig nas ni/ /'dus byas dag la nam yang skyo ba med/ /khams bzhi po ni chos kyi dbyings 'dra dang ske/ /skye mched rnams ni grong stong lta bu dang / /chos 'di gsog dang gsob ltar rnam shes pa/ /de dag rgyal ba'i chos mdzod 'dzin pa yin/ /rab tu dul phyir sbyin dang dul ba dang / /de bzhin tshul khrims rnam dag tshul khrims dang / /rtag tu 'phags pa'i tshul gyis bzod mi zad/ /stong pa nyid phyir brtson 'grus rnam par dag /bsam gtan rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa dang / /de ltar shes rab chags med ma spros par/ /gang gi 'jug pa de 'drar gyur pa de/ /pha rol phyin pa'i pha rol rab tu phyin/ /bdag med kho na nyid phyir byams pa mnyam//58—772

nam mkha' lta bur gong du snying rje dag /zhi phyir dga' dang btang snyoms bcas pa yi/ /lam 'di tshangs pa'i lam ste rtag tu zhi/ /bsdu ba bzhi po khyad par 'phags pa 'di/ /rnam par 'dren pas rjes su gzung phyir gsungs/ /'dzin pa med cing rnam rtog gang med pa/ /de ni bsdu ba'i dngos po'i pha rol phyin/ /sems can 'di dag bdag med sems can med/ /srog dang gso ba gang zag mi rnyed do/ /dbang po drug 'di stong ste rab zhi bar/ /gang shes de ni byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /sems can med cing byang chub sems dpa' med/ /de ni gang du'ang bdag med rlom sems med/ /gnyis dang bral zhing ma chags spros med pa/ /sems can byang chub sems dpa' de dpal ldan/ /chos 'di snying po med de sgyu ma 'dra/ /gang du'ang mi 'ong nam yang 'gror mi 'gyur/ /chos dbyings 'di yi ticiganas pa rig nas ni/ /rgyal bas de bzhin nyid ni mnyam sangs rgyas/ /gang na'ang yod pa'am med pa med mod kyi/ /rgyu la brten nas chos rnams 'byung bas na/ /mkha' la glog mthong 'jig pa lta bur ni / /sems kyi 'khri nashing de ltar shes par bya/ /rlung ni nam mkhar mi chags rgyu ba bzhin/ /gzugs med sems ni 'dus byas dag la rgyu/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rnam dag de shes nas/ /nyon mongs gzugs med sogs ris par mi 'gyur rol/ /lus ni rtsig ripa rtswa ridang lo ma 'dra/ /blun pa rje med rdo shing ngan pa ltar / /de yis snga ma'i rang bzhin 'drar shes nas/ /lus kyis chos la gnas par mi byed do/ /tshig ni rtag tu gzung med rlung dang 'dra/ /ri 7dang phug 8gi brag ca 9 lta bu ste/ /de 'drar sgra ni rab tu dben shes pa/ /sgra rnams kun la 'dod pa'i chags pa med/ /bdag ni nam mkha'i ngos gnas 1 rimi ltung ste/ /58—773

mkha' las ltung ba'i gnas kyang yod ma yin/ /chos 'di nam mkha' 'dra bar bsgoms nas ni/ /de ltar sems can sems can med mtshungs gnas/ /bskal pa brgya phrag mang por bsregs kyang ni/ /ji ltar nam mkha' nam yang sngon ma tshig /chos rnams thams cad nam mkhar 'drar shes pa/ /de sreg bskal tshe zhing rnams brgyar yang 'gro/ /ri dang ri bar 37kho ra khor5 yug ri/ /de bzhin ri dang bcas pa'i sa rnams kun/ /nam mkha'i ngos kyis phye bar rig nas de/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis bye ba'i zhing du 'gro/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dag dang / /khams bzhi 'di dag nam mkha'i ngos mnyam par/ /dpa' bo tshul 'di khong du chud pa dag /mkha' las bye ba mtha' yas zhing du 'gro/ /srid pa gsum na sgra dang skad kyi bag /bzang ngan de bzhin 'bring po ci yod pa// de yi lamatha' ma bskal pa brgyar brjod kyang / /sngon gyi rang bzhin mi snang rgyu ba med/ /rang byung ba ni mtshan mchog ma yin yang / /sems kyi chos kyis gzugs kyis rab tu phye/ /sems dang yid ni mtshungs pa dben par gyur(5)/ /rgyal ba thams cad chos mtshungs dzi nyid phyir mnyam/ /sngon gyi srid par byang chub spyad spyod cing / / dge ba 7brgya stong rab tu bsags nas ni/ /byang chub mnyam zhing mnyam par rab shes pa/ /grags pa chen po rnams ni lung bstan 'gyur / /chos rnams kun ni rang yul yang 3 dag ste/ /mtha' yas phyir ni rgyal ba'i yul 9du mnyam/ /mnyam nyid 'di dag gang gis rab shes pa/ /yon tan ldan pa de dag lung bstan 'gyur/ /bdag ni gzugs min tshor min 'du shes min / /sems pa 1 ma yin rnam par shes med kyang / /byang chub khong du chud pas bdag lung bstan/ /phung po khams kyis bdag ni lung ma bstan/ /bzod 58—774

pa gang zhig gzod7)ma nas zhi yi/ /skad cig pa ni zad dang 'dra min la/ /mtshungs med mi skye ba la bzod pa na/ /mi dbang 'gyur zhes rgyal bas lung bstan to/ /chos rnams kun dang bdag tu rang bzhin mnyam/ /bdag ni bdag med stong pa'i rang bzhin te/ /stong pa nam mkha' 'dra ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /byang chub rtag tu mkha' mnyam rang bzhin no/ /zad par bya phyir zad pa shes mi nusal/ /mi zad pa ni zad pas zad mi 'gyur/ /zad pa'i sgo yis chos rnams kun ma skyes/ /bzod dang ldan la sangs rgyas lung dun/ston to/ /mtshan med gnas 'jug pa yi 5)gnas med de/ /yang dag 'dus ma byas pa dus las grol//ma byas byed du ma bcug byung ba min/ /de bzhin nyid 'drar rgyal bas bdag lung bstan/ /gal te bdag ni lung bstan 'gyur snyam na/ /chos lam tshul la mi mnyam sbyor ba yin/ /sems dang yid kyis sbyor ba sbyor ma yin/ /chos sbyor khyad par 'phags 'di mtshungs shing mnyam/ /khyed cag thams cad sa yisngo steng na 'khod/ /bdag ni nam mkha'i dkyil na rnam par gnas/ /sa dang nam mkha' mnyam par shes nas ni/ /srid pa gsum na chags med ye shes 'jug /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos tshigs su bcad 45)pa 'di dag smras nas steng gi bar snang las babs te thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal 6te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas ni bdag gi ched du byung ngo / /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa don ma mchis par ma bgyis te/ sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyis bdag ma bslus pas bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi bsam pa thams cad yongs su bskang ba'i slad du bla na med pa yang dag par 58—775

rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan to/ /de nas 'khor de'i nang na byang chub sems dpa' kha cig 'di lta bu'i sems 1bskyed de/ mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang las dang po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do tsho snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' /lha'i cod pan gyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sems kyi rnam par rtog pa sems kyis shes nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos de bzhin gshegs pa gang las byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa cade'i mtshan ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa'i yang ches risagrangs med pa/ rgyas pa/ tshad med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur pa de'i tshe de'i dus na rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i bskal pa la 'jig rten gyi khams dge ba zhes bya bar 6de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur 7ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rin chen phung po zhes bya ba na'ajig rten du byung (ngo / /rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen phung po de'i 1 byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun ni bye ba phrag drug cur gyur te/ thams cad kyang brtson 'grus brtsams pa/ bzod pa rab tu thob pa/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las 11phyir mi ldog pa sha stag go/ /58—776

de'i tshe'i tshad ni lo bye ba phrag drug cu thub par gyur to/ /dge ba zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams de yang bai drur+ya nyalas grub pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pal/ rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris lta bur khang khyim dang / longs spyod dang / nye bar spyod pa dang / bza' ba dang /btung ba bsams na pa tsam dgyis 'byor pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na theg pa chen po ma gtogs par theg pa gzhan rnam par gzhagam pa med par gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i dus na gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los sgyur 5)ba'i rgyal po sa 'dzin ces bya ba rin po che sna bdun dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ de'i slas ni stong phrag bzhi bcu yod do/ /de'i bu ni stong tham pa yod de ni/ dpa' ba / rtul 7phod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs can pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms napa sha stag go/ /rigs kyi bu rgyal po sa 'dzin des bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen phung po de dang / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag drug cu la lo bye ba tham par yid du 'ong ba'i chos gos dang / zhal zas dang ske/ mal cha dang / na ba'i gsos sman dang / yo byad rnams dang / bde bar sbyar ba bde ba la reg par gnas par bya ba thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas nas des bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen phung po de (9la mchod pa dpag tu med pa byas te/ dge ba'i rtsa bas nye bar brtan 1 nas bud med bzhi stong po de dag dang / bu stong po de dag dang / srog chags brgyad khri bzhi stong dang lhan cig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /des byang chub tu sems bskyed nas kyang lo bye bar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen phung po de la bsnyen bkur byas so/ /58—777

de dus gzhan zhig na bu thu bo brtul zhugs yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba rgyal por bcug 1tshonas rgyal srid thams cad bor te/ skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos te bcom ldan 'das de'i bstan pa la dad pas khyim du nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po'i bu de dag gis kyang rim gyis bu thu bo re re rgyal por bcug nas pha'i rjes su rab tu byung bar gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar na rnam grangs 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa de'i tshe'idzagatshad ring bar gyur to/ /rgyal po gzhon nu de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa de las rab tu byung nas rgyal bu gzhon nu tha chungs 5snying rje'i blo zhes bya ba gcig pu nyam gtogs te/de ni chos kyis rgyal srid byed pa chad pa med pa dang / mtshon cha med par chos dang 'thunas ripar dbang byed du bcug go/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar rgyal po sa 'dzin de bu dang bcas par bcom ldan 'das de'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas thog ma dang bar ma dang tha mar de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen phung po de'i dam pa'i chos rab tu bzung ngo / /rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i dus na gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los sgyur na ba'i rgyal po sa 'dzin zhesamadu'o/bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du khyod dogs shing the tsom tshaza'am yid gnyis su gyur pa lta na rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar mi blta'o11/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po 'di de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po sa 'dzin zhes 3 bya bar gyur to/ /rgyal po de'i bur gyur pa de dag thams cad ni de 12ltar phyogs bcu na byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod do/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar na mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen phung po de las bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de bla na med pa yang dag par 58—778
