rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu dang po sems bskyed tshun chad/ da'i 1 bar thams cad du sangs rgyas mthong ba dang chos nyan pa dang / dge 'dun la rim gro byed pa dang ma bral bar gyur ri to/ /'dis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis tshogs kyang myur du yang dag par bsgrubs ④pas 'di la ngas 'di ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan gyi rgyal por snang ba 5zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung yang bstan to / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lha'i cod pan gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji tsam du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen pa dang ldan pas 'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par 'dus bgyis pa'i rgyu ba nas yun ring du lags pa yang bcom ldan 'das kyis sgribs pa mi mnga' ba'i ri namakhyen pas gzigs pa ni ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni thogs pa med pa'i ye shes mthong ba dang ldan no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu gang sems can thams cad kyi 'das pa'i sems kyi rgyu zad pa/ 'gags pa / bral ba/ rnam par gyur pa/ rgyu gang dag las sems kyi rgyud de dag byung ba dang / rgyu gang dag med pas zad pa/ dge ba'am/ mi dge ba'am/lung du bstan pa'am/ lung du ma bstan pa de dag thams cad rnam pa dang bcas/ gzhi dang bcas/ gtan tshigs dang bcas par 8de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu shes so/ /da ltar byung ba'i dus kyi sems can thams cad kyi sems 58—779

kyi rgyud byung ba dge ba'am/ mi dge ba'am/ lung du bstan pa'am/ lung du ma bstan pa yang rung ste/ sems rang 1gi 'og tu sems gang byung ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa dang bcas/ gzhi dang bcas/ gtan tshigs rinadang bcas par de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu shes so/ /gang ma 'ongs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyud dang sems las byung ba'i chos dge ba'am/ mi dge ba'am/ lung du bstan pa'am/ lung du ma bstan pa yang rung ste/sems gang gi 'og tu sems gang da'abyung bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa dang bcas/ gzhi dang bcas pa/ gtan tshigs dang bcas par de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu shes so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni thogs pa med pa'i ye shes dang ldan no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mkhyen pa thogs pa mi mnga' ba bstanas pa 'di bshad pa na srog chags sum 'bum gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyi 'khor dang bcas pa la zhag bdun bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas nas yongs su longs spyad 5par bya ba'i phyir rang gi khang khyim dang / 'khor gyi khyams de yang bcom ldan 'das la phul te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du rtag tu 'dir gshegs shing bzhugs par gsol/ des na skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang ske/ 'jig rten la thugs brtse 6ba dang / skye bo'i tshogs phal po che'i don dang ske/ mi 'am ci 7dang / dri za dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams la phan pa dang 58—780

bde bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i bu 1dri ma med pa'i mig ces bya bas bcom ldan 'das la nor bu rin po che'i dra ba phul nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'am ci bdag cag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la yang dag par zhugs su lags kyang bdag cag ni sil snyan dang rol mo'i dbyangs sgra dang / glu dang gar la rab tu chags/ me tog dang spos dang nacibadug pa dadang byug pa dang /phye ma la bag ma mchis par dga' zhing rtse ba lags na ji ltar bdag cag bag camachis par 'gyur zhing / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yang dag par bsgrub 5par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos rin po che'i phyag rgya'i sgo'i gdams ngag bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la stsal bar gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po'i bu dri ma med pa'i mig la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bzhin bzangs dag 6de'i phyir deng phyin cad pasil snyan dang glu dbyangs de dag las byang chub yongs su smin par byed pa'i chos drug cu rtsa bzhi 'byung 8bar khyed la byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi rtag pa'i sgra 'byung ba dang / sdug bsngal gyi sgra dang /bdag med pa'i sgra dang / zhi ba'i sgra dang / mngon par 'du mi byed pa'i sgra dang ske/ dben pa'i sgra dang / mi skye ba'i sgra dang / dngos po med pa'i sgra dang /'byung ba med pa'i sgra dang / gnas med pa'i sgra dang / ji lta ba bzhin gyi sgra dang ske/ yang dag pa'i mtha'i sgra dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi sgra dang / sems can med pa'i sgra dang / srog med pa'i sgra dang / gang zag med pa'i sgra dang /sbyin pa'i sgra dang / tshul khrims kyi sgra dang / bzod pa'i sgra dang / brtson 58—781

'grus kyi sgra dang / bsam gtan gyi sgra dang / shes rab kyi sgra dang / byams pa'i sgra dang / snying rje'i sgra dang / dga' ba'i sgra dang / btang snyoms kyi sgra dang ske/ 'ong ba med pa'i sgra dang / 'gro ba med pa'i sgra dang / rgyu ba med pa'i sgra dang / gnas med pa'i sgra dang / brtan pa med pa'i sgra dang / stong pa nyid kyi sgra dang / mtshan ma med pa'i sgra dang / smon pa med pa'i sgra dang /'dod chags dang bral ba'i sgra dang / 'byung ba med pa'i sgra dang / rten pa'i sgra dang / rten pa med pa'i sgra dang / sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang / chos kyi sgra dang ske/ dge 'dun gyi sgra dang / byang chub tshad med pa'i sgra dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag 17pa'i sgra dang / yang dag par spong ba'i sgra dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i sgra dang / dbang po'i sgra dang / stobs kyi sgra dang / byang chub kyi yan lag gi sgra dang / lam gyi sgra dang / zhi gnas kyi sgra dang / lhag mthong gi sgra dang / thabs kyi sgra dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po'i sgra dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i sgra dang / bdud tshar gcad 95)pa'i sgra dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba'i sgra dang / chos thams cad sgyu ma dang / rmi lam dang ske/ gzugs brnyan dang / chu'i zla ba dang / brag cam lta bu'i sgra dang /chos kyi dbyings 'dres pa med pa'i sgra dang / 'khor bas yongs su mi skyo ba'i sgra dang ske/ 'byung ba'i sgra dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs thams cad kyi sgra dang /dbu 4ba dang / chu'i chu bur dang / smig rgyu dang / chu shing gi phung po dngalo3)/sgyu ma dang / snying po med pa'i sgra dang / ji skad smras pa de bzhin du bya zhing chos bsgrub 6pa'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhin bzangs pedag de ltar na sangs rgyas kyi mthus sil snyan dang glu dbyangs de dag las gang gi she)khyed bag 58—782

yod par byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams bsgrub 1)par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i sgra 'di dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro// //bam po lnga pa ste tha ma/ de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de ngo mtshar du gyur nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshalam te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji tsam du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang dbyang chub 'di byin gyi rlabs 4)kyis shin tu byin gyis rabarlabs pa dang / chos bstan pa dang ske/ ji 6)tsam du de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams shin tu yongs su bzung ba ni ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/grogs po dag ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams shin tu yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' yongs su bzung bas sems can thams cad yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /grogs po dag de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub sems dpa' yongs su bzung ba gang yin pa de sems can thams cad kyi don nyid do/ /de ltar na sems can thams cad 75kyi ched du de dag go cha gang gis sems can tshad med grangs med pa 'khor ba las mya ngan las 'da' ba'i 8lam du gzud par 49 'gyur ba'i go cha chen po gyon no/ /grogs po dag rnam grangs 'dis 'di lta rang da ltar bzhugs kyang rung yongs su mya ngan las 'das 1 kyang rung ste/byang chub sems dpa' rnams yongs su bzung ba mdzad pa gang yin pa des sems can thams cad yongs su bzung ba yin par rig par bya'o/ /grogs po dag byang chub sems dpa' la chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal cha dang ske/ na ba'i gsos 11sman dang / yo byad rnams kyis rim gror byas pa ni 58—783

sems can thams cad la rim gro byas par 'gyur ro/ /grogs po dag byang chub sems dpa' la bde bar sbyar ba nye bar bsgrubs pa ni sems can thams cad la bde bar sbyar ba nye bar bsgrubs par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ grogs po dag tha na byang chub sems dpa'i dbugs 'byung ba dang / rngub pa gang yin pa de thams cad kyang sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po rab tu 'thob tsho1pa dang ldan pa dang / sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir yongs su 'dzin to/ /de nas 'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa dang ske/ gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu de dag dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa la rjes su yi rangs nanas/ lha'i me tog rnam pa mang po kha dog sna tshogs pas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor to / /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos 'di snyam du bsams te / bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis sam/gzhan byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis bdag gi gnas nas/ bya rgod kyis5)phung po'i ri la gshegs pa ni bdag gi cha ma yin gyis tsibadag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir shing rta gang la bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas par bzhugs pa de lta bu'i shing rta bkod pa bsgrubs te/ shing rta de yang bdag 'khor dang bcas pas drangs nas ri/ de ltar na bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa byas par 'gyur snyam mo/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos yid las byung ba lha'i rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta 'phang du dpag tshad lnga nakhyon 58—784

du dpag tshad lnga pa/ kha khyer rin po che sna tshogs kyis bskor ba shing ljon pa 1sna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan pa steng du rin po che'i dra ba bres pa/ rin po che'i skud pa mig mangs nasaris su bres pa mngon par sprul nas shing rta de la bcom ldan 'das sne)kyi gdan seng ge'i khri bkra ba blta na sdug pa/ 'phang du mi bdun yod pa / ras bcos ma zung brgya stong mang po bkram pa mngon par sprul/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun thams cad kyi stan yang so sor mngon par sprul/ gang dag bcom ldan 'das la chos nyan zhing zhabs ca'abring du 'brang ba brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang /'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu de dag gi stan yang shing rta de'i steng du ci rigs par sbrusprul to/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos de lta bu'i shing rta bkod pa de sprul nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ne nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du shing rta 'di la ji ltar gdan bshams 7pa rnams la 'khor thams cad dang thabs cig 8tu bzhugs su gsol/de nas seng ge'i khri de la bcom ldan 'das kyang bzhugs9/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun dang 'khor thams cad kyang ci rigs par 'khod do/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis shing rta de lag pa g.yas pas blangs te/ shing ta 1 ril bdun srid kyi steng 1 gi bar snang la 'phags 12nas/ de nas mi 'am ci mo brgyad khri bzhi stong de dag thams cad dang bu brgyad stong po de dag dang gzhan yang mi 'am ci dang dri za dang lto 'phye chen po brgya stong phrag du ma dang mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po nyid kyang rin po 1 58—785

che'i thag pa thogs nas shing rta la btags te nam mkha' las drangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das steng gi bar snang gi shing rta la bzhugs shing / nam mkha'i dkyil nas gshegs pa la mi 'am ci mo brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag gis sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs blangs nas mchod pa byed de mdun du dong zhing bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /mi 'am ci mo brgyad khri bzhi stong po/ /gzugs kyi dam pa dang ni ldan pa dag /sil snyan rnams ni 41rab tu dkrol ribagyid cing / /yang dag bsngags pas 'dren la bstod pa bgyid/ /mtshan mchog bsod nams kyis ni gzi brjid gyur//gzugs mchog mthong na dga' bar bgyid pa'i gzugs/ /bden pa'i yon tan la ni rtag gnas pa/ /yon tan mtsho 3)chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams dang khyod mi 'dra/ /g.yas g.yon na yang rnam par mthong ma myong ske/ /ji ltar ri rab cachibartan zhing mi g.yo ba/ /de ltar khyed kyi sku ni dpal gyis mdzes/ /'dren pa khyod kyis pa rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /chags pa ma mchis par yang mkha' las mchi/ /nam mkha' lta bur dag cing dri mi mnga'/ /bcom ldan nyon mongs bsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dbang lha min dbang dang srin po dang / /brgya byin tshangs pa dang ni dag pa'i lha/ /nyi ma zla ba skar mar bcas pa'i 'od/ /khyed 6kyi mdzod spus 'od ni ma mchis gyur/ /shes rab 'byung gnas 7shes rab rgya mtsho ldan/ /sems can kun gyi sems lde kyi spyod la mkhas / /'jig rten gsum na 'jig rten gsumam9 gyis mchod/ /'jig rten grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud bzhi po yi71 skyon rnams bsal ba po11ske/ /bden pa bzhi la bsgom 32zhing dpyod mdzad pa/ /rdzu 'phrul bzhi yi 1nye58—786

stobs kyis bsnyengs mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas gshegs pas gshegs te gshegs pa mdzes/ /bskal pa brgyar yang skyo ba mi mnga' zhing / /rtag tu dul la thugs ni mnyam par bzhaganyu) /legs par gsungs pas 'gro ba tshim nasgomadzad kyang / /khyod ni tshig dang skad la gnas ma lags/ /khyod kyi gsung ni yid 'ong rab tu snyanas / /zhing brgya dgasatu thogs pa med par mchi/ /sgra ni sems can gang gis thos gyur pa/ /de dag thams cad bde bas tshim par 'gyur/ /sems can kha lo sgyur seb spu gcig tu/ /stong gsum rgya mtsho'i chab rnams zhugs gyur kyang ske/ /sems can ragasam6)pa rnams la'ang mi gnod la/ /rdzu 'phrul 3)la yang skyon ni yongasho mi gda'/ /stong gsum gyi ni ri bo ri59rirab dag /phyag 3 rigacig gi ni mthil du bzhag71)nas su/ /zhing mang bye ba dag tu gshegs mdzad kyang / /khyod kyi sku yi 3nyestobs ni zhum ma mchis/ /khyod ni bskal pa brgya phrag bsam yas nas / /brtul zhugs dka' thub tshul khrims yon tan dang / /sbyin dang dul dang sdom 32dang bzod pa dang / /brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab shin tu bslabs / /sangs rgyas bye ba mang la bsnyen bkur mdzad/ /de dag rnams kyis bshad pa'i chos kyang bzung / /thugs rje ldan zhing 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir/ /khyod la yongs su skyo ba'i thugs mi mnga'/ /rim gror ma bgyis zhum par mi 'gyur zhing / /rim gro bgyis pas mtho bar 'gyur ma lags/ /dog sa lta bur snyoms shing mi g.yo ste/ /'jig rten chos gnas mi gos pad ma bzhin/ /chos rnams stong pa mtshan ma ma mchis dang / /chu zla 'dra zhing sgyu ma lta bu dang / / dbu ba rdos bo'adra rmi lam glog 'dra dang / /smig rgyu'i mtshan nyid lta bur rab tu mkhyen/ /ngo bo nyid kyis gang zag bdag ma mchis/ /gdod nas stong zhing 58—787

mi g.yo rjes 1ma mchis/ /nam mkha' lta bur dag cing dri ma mchis/ /dngos po bas par dngos po ma mchis 'dra/ /las dang bya ba rgyu dang rkyen rnams las/ /byung ba lags kyi rjes ni ma mchis par/ /tshul 'di rnam par sbyang ba mdzad pas na / /de phyir khyod ni rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes 2bgyi/ /gang dag 'dren pa mthong zhing thos gyur pa/ /de dag la ni ngan song 'jigs ma/ mchis/ /de dag bde 'gro dag tu mchog gzhol te/ /srog chags de rnams kyi ni rnyed pa lags/ /bdag cag rnams kyis gang zag dam pa khyod/ /kun tu mchod pas mchod pa bgyis nas su/ /byang chub tu ni sems kyang bskyed bgyis te/ /gang zag mchog 'drar thams cad 'gyur bar shog /nam mkha' la ni dpag tu nus kyang gda' ske/ /rgya mtsho'i chab ni bas bgyir nus kyang gda'/ /nyi zla mkha' las sar ni ltung gda' 5yi/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bas par 'gyur mi gda' no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shing rta la bzhugs te nam mkha'i dkyil gyi lam nas gshegs pas gshegs shing / gser gyi kha dog lta bur sku las 'od gang 7gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 8khyab par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i 'od phyung ba dang / 'od des rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po dang / bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri yang rab tu khyab par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shing rta des rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer dang bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri ga la ba der gshegs so / /de nas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer gyi rgyal po ma skyes dgra 9blon po dang /rgyal bu dang / tshong dpon dang / grong rdal pa dang / khyim bdag tu bcas pa dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams 'od des bskul nas phyi dro'i dus kyi tshe me tog dang / bdug pa 58—788

dang ske/ spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang ba dan thogs te/ bcom ldan 'das bsu ba'i phyir rings pa rings par rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po nas byung ste/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ngo / /sdong po'i slas rnams shing rta 'dren bzhin du sil snyan brgyad khri bzhi stong byed do/ /mi 'am ci mo'i rol mo sil snyan gyi sgra des bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri thams cad du grag par gyur to/ /de ltar mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po dpung dang bcas/ 'khor dang bcas pas rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i dkyil nas khyer te 1bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la bzhag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shing rta de las babs nas rang gi gnas su gdan bshams pa la bzhugs naso/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang nyan thos chen po de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor rnams rikyang shing rta de las babs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal la te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas bcom ldan 'das la kun nas bskor te rang rang gi 5stan la 6'khod do/ /'dod pa na spyod pa dang /gzugs na spyod pa dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i 7bu de dag kyang shing rta de las babs te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nanas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra blon po dang / rgyal bu dang ske/ tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag dang / grong rdal pa dang bcas pa dang ske/ dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams kyis me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan 58—789

dang ske/ ba dan ji ltar thogs pa de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 6)te/ bcom ldan 'das la sku ma mnyel natam/ bde ba la reg (par gnas sam zhes gsol nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod 3)do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po g.yog 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das〈ge'akhor dang bcas te/ shing rta la bzhugs pa nam mkha'i dkyil nas drangs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i 6ci'akhor dang bcas pas ci zhig 'thob rdzi par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba des mi 'am ci'i nargyal po sdong po slas dang bcas/ bu dang bcas/ g.yog dang bcas pas 'dir byang chub tu sems bskyed nas de dag thams cad nam byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi bar du mngon par shes pa las mi nyams pa rab tu thob par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du phan tshun 'gro bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / chos nyan pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ tshe rabs thams cad du skye ba dran par 'gyur/ lung bstan pa thob par 'gyur/ dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba 9la brtson par 'gyur/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba la spro bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras mi 'am ci'i bdag po sdong po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod kyi yon tan yongs su brjod pa mdzad pas khyod kyis rnyed pa legs par rnyed kyisamasakhyod kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba de las shas 11shig kho bos kyang thob par 'dod do/ /mi 58—790

'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos smras pa/ rgyal po chen po dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di thams cad bdag gis khyod dang sems can thams cad la dbul lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / rgyal po chen po byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ni gang sems can thams cad dang thun mong ma yin pa de gang yang med do/ /rgyal po chen po byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ni ser sna can ma yin te/ de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la ser sna mi bskyed do1)/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad la gtong yang yid mi bde bar mi bgyidadun/ 'gyod lde par mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang thams cad mkhyen par yongs su bsngos pa de yang sems can thams cad kyi 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po chen po byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub ni sems can thams cad kyi gnas byed pa dang / sems can la sbyor ba dang / sems can gyi phyir 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis gang gi phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcom ldan 'das dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa rnyed de/ de gnyis las khyod kyis dam pa'i chos thos nas des mi shes pa'i mun pa dang / gti mug gi ling tog cichen pos mtshams 5 med pa'i 'gyod pa byangadza tsho/ba'i sems bsal nas khyod kyis chos la chos kyi snang ba chen po thob ste/ chos kyi snang ba des khyod da ltar sgrib pa med pa thob cing gnas pas khyod kyis kyang rnyed pa legs par rnyed do/ /rgyal po chen po de lta bas na byang chub semasam7)dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gus par byas te/ ji nanas kyang chos kyi57)tshig dang / yi ge 'bru gcig thos pa'ang 1 ribarjed par mi 'gyur ba dang ske/ chud za bar mi 'gyur ba dang / kun tu bzung 31ba dang / yongs su 58—791

bsrung ba'i phyir bdag chos kyi snod du 'gyur bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi snod du 'gyur ba lags / de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 11byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nachos sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan na chos kyi snod du 'gyur ro/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i snod sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs cadang / lhag pa'i bsam pa'i snod bsam pa dang / byang chub kyi lam nye bar ston pa'i snod 5)sbyor ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba khyad par du 'gro ba'i snod lhag pa'i bsam pa dang /mang du thos pa'i snod dran 6pa dang / lam la 'jug pa'i snod blo gros dang /don rtogs pa rjes su rtogs pa'i snod rtogs pa dang / longs spyod chen po'i snod sbyin pa dang / bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i snod tshul khrims dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis 'thob 7pa'i snod bzod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad 8'grub pa'i snod brtson 'grus dang / sems las su rung ba'i snod bsam gtan dang / dogs pa thams cad las rab tu 'das pa'i snod shes rab dang / sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pa'i snod byams pa dang / dbul zhing nyam thag pa thams cad bskyabs 9pa'i snod snying rje dang / chos la dga' ba'i snod dga' ba dang / rjes su chags pa dang /khong khro ba spang ba'i snod btang snyoms dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'dzin du 'jug pa'i snod dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 58—792

pa'i snod thos pa tshol bas 11ngoms mi myong ba dang / mi ltos napa'i snod rab tu 'byung ba dang / don nyung zhing bya ba nyung ba'i snod dgon pa la gnas pa dang /bsam gtan dang shesamangon par shes pa'i snod dben pa la dga' ba dang /sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i snod bsdu ba'i dngos po dang / chos snang ba'i snod dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa dang / thos pa thams cad 'dzin pa'i snod gzungs dang / sems can thams cad kyi the tsom gcad 4pa'i snod spobs 5)pa dang / sangs rgyas mthong ba'i snod sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tsisnod chos rjes su dran pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsrung ba'i snod zhe sdang med pa'i sems dang / lta bar gyur pa thams cad spong 7)ba'i snod stong pa nyid la mos pa dang / mthar 'dzin pa thams cad yongs su spong 8)ba'i snod rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / mi 'khrugs 9shing phyad 1 ripar lung ston pa'i snod mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa 11dang /stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 12kyi snod phyir mi ldog pa'i sa stelhan/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag dang ldan na chos kyi snod du rig par bya'o/ /bstan pa 'di bshad pa na srog chags khris bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ tshig 'di skad ces bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad kyang 'di 'dra ba'i chos kyi snod du gyur cig /bdag cag kyang bcom ldan 1 'das kyis ji skad du bstan pa'i chos de lta bu'i snod du gyur cig ces smras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 15mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po khyod kyis 58—793

'khor 'di skyo bar 'gyur du 'ong gis ༅khyod rang gi gnas su song shig(ge /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang yongs su skyo ba de byang chub sems dpa' zhes mi bgyi ste/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas 0ni skyo ba bzod par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltarams)byang chub sems dpa' yongs su skyo ba lags/ ji ltar na yongs su mi skyo ba lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na yongs su skyo bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ sems can gyi khams tshad med pa thos na skrag pa dang / 'khor ba tshad med pa thos na skrag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes tshad med par57thos na skrag pa dang / bsod nams tshad med pas mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po 'grub pa thos na skrag pa ste/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na yongs su (3skyo bar rig par bya'o/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na yongs su mi skyo bar rig par bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ sems can gyi khams tshad med pas de yang bdag gis yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar59/bya'o zhes thos na mi skrag pa dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrub pa'i phyir 'khor ba tshad med pa yongs su gzung bar bya'o zhes thos na mi skrag pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshad med pa de bdag gi nyi )yongs su rdzogs par bya'o zhes thos na mi skrag pa dang / bsod nams tshad med pa bsags pas mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po 'grub ste/bdag gis kyang bsgrub par bya'o zhes thos na mi skrag pa ste/ mi 'am ci'i (1bdag po byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na yongs su mi skyo 58—794

bar rig par bya'o/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na yongs su skyo bar rig par bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ skabs skabs su nyan thos kyi theg pa la re ba dang / skabs skabs su rang sangs rgyas7 theg rin pa la re ba dang / dam pa'i chos rnam par 'jig pa nams yal bar 'dor zhing yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / gzhan yang yang cadag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par 'dzin tu mi 'jug pa ste/ mi 'am 5ci'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na yongs su skyo bar rig par bya'o/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na yongs su mi skyo bar rig par bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ rab tu nyen kyang byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ba dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la mi dbang 6ba dang / lus dang srog 7'dor zhing dam pa'i chos bsrung ( ba dang / dpag tshad stong du 'gro zhing gzhan dag byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa ste/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po 'di dag dang (9ldan na yongs su mi skyo bar rig par bya'ol/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na yongs su 3 siskyo bar rig par bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ slong ba nyu1rimathong na yongs su skyo 12ba dang / bsod snyoms 1 byed par sbyor ba la brtson par 1riganas pa dang / mang du thos pa tshol ba la mi brtson pa dang / ji ltar thos pa'i chos rnams gzhan la mi ston pa ste/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na yongs su 12skyo bar rig par bya'o//mi 'am ci'i bdag po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na 58—795

yongs su mi skyo bar rig par bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ slong ba la71 bshes gnyen du 'du shes skyedamatsho cing zhe sdang ba'i sems med la bzhin 'dzum zhing khro gnyer med de tshur shog legs par 'ongs sam zhes bya ba'i tshig smra ba dang /bdag bde sa ba la mi chags shing sems can thams cad la bde ba rab tu sbyin pa dang ske/ mang du thos pa tshol bas mi ngoms shing / ji ltar thos pa'i chos rnams kyang gzhan dag la rgya cher rab tu ston cing zang zing med pa'i sems kyi la chos de gzhan la rab tu ston pa ste/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na yongs su mi skyo bar rig par bya'o/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na yongs su pa skyo bar rig par bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam yongs su mi tshol ba dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po la mi sbyor ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par byed par brtson 'grus mi rtsom pa dang / yon tan chung ngu tsam gyis chog par 'dzin cing gong du mi tshol ba ste/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na yongs su skyo bar rig par bya'o/ /mi 'am ci'i bdag po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na yongs su mi skyo bar rig par bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/snyemago'i thod la me 'bar ba bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam yongs su tshol ba dang ske/ bsdu ba'i dngos po la rtag tu brtson pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par byed par brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / dge ba 6thams cad yongs su bkang 7ba'i phyir de la mi chags pa yin te/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na yongs su mi skyo bar rig par 58—796

bya'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bzhi bsgrub pa 'di 1mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po la lan btab nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su skyo ba dang / yongs su mi skyo ba bzhi bsgrub 2pa la 'jug pa 'di thos sam/ rgyal pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das thos lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po de lta bas na khyod byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la yongs su mi skyo bar spyad par bya'o/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgras gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa gang lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 4pa yongs su bskang ba'i phyir mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po la bka' stsal pa/ mi 'am ci'i bdag po ji ltar sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i rang gi thabs mkhas pa'i khyad par rgyal po ma skyes dgra 'di'i 5byang chub sems dpa'i 6spyod pa yongs su bskang ba'i phyir khyod kyis ston cig /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos rang gi pi bang 8)de bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar blangs so/ /pi bang 9de blangs ma thag tu de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i gzi brjid kyis pi bang 1 gi sgra de las seng ge bsgyings pa ltar shing sā 11la du ma g.yo ba'i sgrar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag byung ngo / /phan pa spyod pa dag dang don spyod dang / /chos thos nan tan byed pa spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag yongs su skyo 12ba med par spyod/ /bde ba spyod dang skyid pa spyod 1 pa dang ske/ /sems can kun la sems 1 snyoms spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi 58—797

spyod pa gang spyod panyan/ /de dag rgya chen ma yin spyod pa med/ /brtan⑧pa spyod dang bden pa spyod pa dang / /bsam pa yongs su dag pa spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag gang du'ang sgyu med spyod pa yinatshi/ /dul ba spyod dang sbyin pa spyod pa dang / /dngos po thams cad yongs su gtong spyod dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag ser sna med par spyod pa yin/ /tshul khrims spyod pa ma nyams spyod pa dang / /lus dang ngag ni yongs dag spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag ngan pa'i ngang tshul spyod pa med/ /brtul zhugs spyod dang bzod pa spyod pa dang ske/ /khro skyon yongs〈gesu gcod rin)pa'i spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag gnod sems med par spyod pa yin/ /brtson 'grus spyod dang mthu rnams spyod pa dang / /'khor bar yongs su mi skyo spyod pa dang ske/ /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag le lo med par spyod pa yin/ /bsam56 gtan spyod dang ting 'dzin spyod pa dang / /lus dang sems ni rab tu dben spyod dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa〈gegang spyod pa/ /de dag g.yeng ba med par spyod pa yin/ /shes rab spyod dang blo mchog spyod pa dang ske/ /chos rnams thams cad ji bzhin spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag shes rab 'chal pa'i spyod pa med/ /byams pa spyod dang phan 'dod spyod pa dang / /sems can kun la snying rje spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag khro ba'i tha ba 3tsho/med par spyod/ /stong pa spyod dang rab tu dben spyod dang / /mtshan ma med pa yongs su dag spyod dang ske/ /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag smonamadzo9)pa med par 58—798

spyod pa yin/ /yang dag spyod dang de bzhin nyid spyod dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa yongs su dag spyod dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag gang du'ang chags pa med par spyod/ /dad pa spyod dang dang ba 1spyod pa dang ske/ /dran dang g.yeng ba medamu par spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag yongs su gcod pa med par spyod/ /bsam gtan spyod dang rnam thar chosaspyod pa dang / /mngon shes lnga rnams yongs dag spyod pa dang ske/ /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag chags pa med par spyod pa yin/ /sangs rgyas spyod dang dam chos spyod pa dang / /dge 'dun dkon mchog nye bar brtan spyod dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa//de dag dkon mchog mchog gi spyod pa yin/ /chos spyod pa dang shin tu rigs spyod dang / /sems can thams cad yongs su smin spyod dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag rgyun mi 'chad par spyod pa yin/ /bya ba spyod dang chos rnams spyod pa dang / /mtha' kun yongs su gcod (5pa'i spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag gang du'ang lta bar spyod pa med/ /dag par 6)spyod dang rnam par dag spyod dang / /nyon mongs thams cad yongs su gcod 57)spyod dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag yongs su gdung bar spyod pa med/ /bde ba spyod dang shin tu rnam thar spyod/ /sems can kun la 'jigs med mchog spyod dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag smon lams spyod pa med pa yin / /nyi ma spyod dang zla ba spyod pa dang / /pad ma lta bur gos pa med spyod dang ske/ /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag lhar bcas 'jig 58—799

rten phyag bya ba/ /brgya byin spyod dang tshangs pa'i spyod pa dang / /dkar po'i chos rnams yongs su rdzogs spyod dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa//de dag bdud 91)rnams sder bcas skrag par byed/ /mchog spyod pa dang khyad par 'phags spyod dang / /'dod chags nyes pa tha ba gcod tsho spyod dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag gang du'ang gti mug spyod pa med/ /lam spyod pa dang mu stegs ri spyod pa dang / /shes rab mig ni yongs su dag spyod dang ske/ /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag yongs su rtog par spyod pa med/ /dul ba spyod dang rab tu zhi spyod dang / /ming dang gzugs la mi chags spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag lha dang mi ni mang 4pos bstod/ /'phags pa'i spyod dang shin tu mnyam spyod dang / /g.yon phyogs lam ni yongs su gcod spyod sridang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod56)pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag rtag tu don la 'bab pa yin/ /dpa' bo spyod dang shin tu brtan spyod pa/ /bdud kyi sde rnams 'jigs medapar byed spyod dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag byang chub snying por gzhol ba yin/ /gzung ba spyod dang don yod spyod pa dang / /gzungs la g.yeng bsngon/med par spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag gang du'ang ma rig spyod pa med/ /dgon pa spyod dang rab tu dben spyod pa/ /rtag tu rab tu 'byung bar spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag nan tan byed par spyod pa yin/ /gtso bo'i spyod dang khyad par 'phags spyod dang / /'jig rten thams cad zil gnon spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag chung ngu la ni spyod pa med/ /rigs pa 58wa 800

spyod dang thabs la spyod pa dang / /bsam gtan bde las ldog par (1)spyod pa dang ske/ /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag mi ldenoshes spyod pa med pa yin/ /lta ba spyod dang rnam par lta spyod dang / /ming dang gzugs la mi chags spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag 'jigs pa med par spyod pa yin/ /thams cad spyod dang kun tu spyod pa dang / /dbang po yongs su smin par spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa gang spyod pal/ /de dag ye shes nam mkha'i mtha' dang 'dra/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mngon par bsgrub dpa 'di pi bang cagi sgra de las byung ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' lnga stong mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob par gyur gto/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i 'khor dang / rgyal po'i khab kyi bram ze dang / khyim bdag dang / mi 'am ci dang / dri za dang / lto 'phye chen po de dag gi 'khor gyi srog chags brgyad stong bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas tshig 'di skad ces 6bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'di la bslab 7par bgyi'o//nan tan gyis bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /sems can tshad ma mchis pa dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'di nyid yang dag par 'dzin du stsal bar bgyi'o zhes smras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po 'gror gnang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang bas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po bu dang bcas/ dpung dang bcas/ slas dang bcas/ rang gi skye 2bo dang bcas 'khor dang bcas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 9)nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba 1 cibyas te/ bzod pa 58—801

gsol nas sil snyan dkrol/ me tog gi char phab/ 'od zer gyi dra ba phyungatuste/sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos par byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad nas song ste/ de skad cig thang cigasngon/yud tsam de nyid la ri'i rgyal po spos kyi5kyengad ldang sku du rang gi khyim du phyin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang chos la mchod pas bdag zil gyis non to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bsna/'a stsal pa/ kau shi ka mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos khyod tshoga'aba' zhig 61zil gyis mnan pa ma yin gyisasti/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa thob pa ma gtogs par gang dag stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas de dag thams cad mi 'am ci'i rgyal po na sdong pos zil gyis non to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed ma thagashoshe)pas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /'jig rten skyong ba thams 1 cad zil gyis non to/ /kau shi ka de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' ni lhar bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis zil gyis mi non to/ /gang byang chub sems dpa' la zil gyis gnon par sems pa 31de ni de bzhin gshegs pa la zil gyis gnon par 'dod pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' las ni de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ngo / //rnyede bzhin gshegs pa las ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas 'byung ngo / /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bstan pa 'di thos nas thal mo sbyar te mchi ma blags nyarte58—802

nas 'di skad ces kye ma'o/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa chags pa mi mnga' zhing sgrib pa mi mnga' ba 'di lta bu las nyams so zhes smras so/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi bu lha'i bu 'od zer srung nyu)zhes bya ba 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa des lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yang mi'adi ltar gang rab tu dben pa rnam par bsgruba'i par nye bar gnas pa'i mtshan nyid ma lags pa'i chos rnams la/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems mi bskyed pa de ni sems can thams cad la snying rje rnyed pa ma lags/ rgya chen po la mos pa'i dge ba'i bshes54)gnyen la sten55)pa ma lags te/ phyis 'gyod par 'gyur ba'o/ /yab skyon med pa la zhugs te rgyud tshig cing sa bon tshig ste/ theg pa chen po'i snod du ma gyur pa la da bgyir ci mchis/ bstan pa 'di bshad pa na sum cu rtsa gsum ris kyi lha'i bu las lha'i bu stong tham pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i bu 'od zer srunga'adzigis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das kyis47byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa (8)dka' ba spyad (9)pa brgya stong phrag ji snyed pa bcom ldan 'das sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na bstar ba 9/ )ni bdag la mngon sum du gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das sngon byang chub sems dpar gyur pa 37na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad las mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob pa'i bzod pa thob pa de la 'jug pa'i rnam par dbye ba bstan pa cung 32zad cig bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub 58—803

sems dpa' mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob pa gang bdag 0)gis thos nas de bzhin nyid du bsgrubs pas chos de 'thob par 'gyur/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu 'od zer srung khul 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'od zer srung chos byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskrun pa rnams kyis /mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par mi 'gyur gyis45)/byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba brtan ne pa rnams kyis mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa 7)thob par 'gyur ro/ /'od zer srungs byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob 95par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas mnyam pa nyid dang / chos mnyam pa nyid dang ske/ dge 'dun mnyam pa nyid dang / zhing mnyam pa nyid de7 )lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ bsam gtan bzhis stong pa nyid la rnam par rtse ba dang /pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis thabs mkhas pa la rnam par rtse ba dang / mngon par shes pa lngas ye shes la rnam par rtse ba dang / thogs pa med pa'i ye shes kyis rdzu 'phrul la rnam par rtse ba ste/ 'od zer srung 11byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /'od zer srung 12gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/phung po rnams la byang chub tshol yang phung po rnams la byang chub kyi rang bzhin du 58wa 804

mos pa ma yin pa dang / khams rnams la byang chub tshol yang khams rnams la byang chub kyi rang bzhin du mos pa ma yin pa dang skye mched rnams la byang chub tshol yang / skye mched rnams la byang chub kyi rang bzhin du mi rtog pa dang /chos thams cad la byang chub tshol yang chos thams cad la byang chub kyi rang bzhin du mos pa ma yin pa ste/ 'od zer srung7)byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob napar 'gyur ro/ /'od zer srung lke ri/gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/mi g.yo ba'i tshul gyis chos thams cad yang dag pa'i mtha' la gnas par shes pa dang ske/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid pas chos thams cad de bzhin nyid la gnas par 'jug pa dang / chos thams cad mtshan nyid 'dres pa med pas chos kyi dbyings su 'du bar shes pa dang 54)/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song bas nam mkha'i rang bzhin du so sor rtog pa ste/ 'od zer srung45byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob pa bstan pa 'di bshad pa na byang chub sems dpa' lnga stong mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob par gyur 46to/ /lha'i bu 'od zer srung 7)ni rjes su 'thun par 8chos la bzod pa rab tu thob 9par gyur to/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i tha mar bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos zhus pa pha rol tu phyin pas 'dul ba bstan pa'i sgo'i le'u'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bzung ngam/ kun 58—805

dga' bos 1tshogasol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu nyid kyis bdag gis nachos kyi rnam grangs 'di bzung lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kye ma'o ji tsam du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di du nozab mo rnam par nges pa dang don bzang po dang tshig 'bru bzang pos brgyan pa ni mdzes te ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi sgo ma bsdus pa de gang yang ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das sngon bdag la chos snang bar gyur pa gang lags pa de yang nga 3)chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la brten nas 'bum 'gyur du du skyes so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni 'di snyam du bdag lta bu nyi tshe ba'i 'chal snyob dang ldan pa blo chung ngu nyan thos kyi theg pa'i skyon ma mchis pa/ tha chad la zhugs par gnas pas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas kyang 'di lta bu'i chos kyi snang ba 'di skyes par gyur na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes tshad ma mchis pa'i snod du gyur pa/ blo rgya che zhing rgyashematsho lta bu dang ldan pa/ chos rin po che thams cad yongs su 'dzin pa/gsol ba ma btab par sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bgyi bshosagang lags 9 pa de dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos na chos kyi snang ba ji snyed cig thob par 'gyur ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal snyam bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nyi ma dang zla ba'i snang ba ji snyed pa de dag 7thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i spu gcig gi 'od kyis nyu1mog mog por 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa'i spu'i khung bu thams cad nas 'od ji snyed byung ba de dag ni shes rab kyi 'od kyis72brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro ste/ stong gi cha 58wa 806

dang ske/ stong phrag brgya'i cha dang / bye ba'i cha dang / bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gi cha dang / grangs dang / cha dang / bgrang ba dang / dpes3)dang /rgyur yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ snang ba thams cad ni shes rab kyi snang ba las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa'i shes rab kyi snang ba gang yin pa shes rab kyi snang ba de dang ldan na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis (mi'adas pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa dang / g.yo ba rnams mkhyen pa'i shes rab kyi snang ba de sta bu dang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo dag ldan paras 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bolo4)gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan pa dang / thos nas kyang mos pa dang / mos nas kyang 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du so sor rtogs55)pa dang / de bzhinapo)du bsgrub〈bepa de dag ni byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa dang sems can yongs su smin par bya ba don du gnyer ba dang snying rje chen po'i go cha bgos pa dang / byams pa chen po'i go cha bgos pa dang / bdud dang phyir rgol ba bcom pa dang / byang chub kyi snying por gzhol ba'i skyes bu dam par rig par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas mos pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / gzhan dag la ri yang rgya cher rab tu ston pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de bsod nams ji snyed cig skyed par 'gyur1)/ bcom 58—807

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis snga dro'i dus kyi tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna bdun gyis rab tu bkang ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig7phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la sbyin pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du nyi ma'i gung dang / phye ma red kyi dus dang / srod dang / nam gyi gung thun dang / tho rasaman/stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rin po che sna bdun gyis yongs su bkang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bar la sbyin pa byin pa dang / rnam grangs 'di lta bus lo gcigam gam / lo brgya'am / lo stong ngam/ lo brgya phrag stong du sbyin pa byin na kun dga' bo de la ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de gzhi de las bsod nams mang du skyed skudam/ kun dga' bos 46gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ste tshad ma mchis so/ /bde bar gshegs pa dpag tu mas ramachis so/ /bcom ldan 'das gdugs gcig bsags pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po de yang tshad ma mchis na/ dgung 8lo brgya phrag stong du bsags pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod mos par bya'o / /khyod kyis khong du chud par bya'o/ /byang chub don du gnyer ba dang /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba don du gnyer ba dang / sems can rab tu thar par bya ba don du gnyer ba gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas mos sam 'dzin tam / 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed na rigs kyi bu'am 58wa 808

rigs kyi bu mo byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa de de las bsod nams kyi phung po mang du skyed na gang de bzhin nyid 1)du bsgrubs pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las tha na tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa tsam 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed dam/ gzhan dag la yang ston na de ni sbyin pa zhes bya ste/ de ni sbyin pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ chos kyi sbyin pa 'di ni sbyin pa rnams kyi mchog go/ /'di lta ste/ chos kyi rjes su 'dzin pa de ni rjes su bzung ba rnams kyi mchog go/ /'di lta ste/ chos kyi gding ba de ni sading ba rnams kyi mchog go/ /'di lta ste chos yongs su 'dzin pa de ni yongs su 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog go/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo chos kyi sbyin pa byin pas ni nyon mongs pa 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /zang zing gi sbyin pa byin pas ni lus brtan55pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa 'bri bar byed 'dod pas sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba chos kyi sbyin pa de sbyin par bya ste/ chos kyi sbyin pa des ni yon tan gyi khyad par thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi 4sbyin pa sbyin pa ni yon tan gyi phan yon yang dag phul sum cu rtsa gnyis rab tu 'dzin par 'gyur ro / /sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang ske/ blo gros dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / rtog 5pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / 'dod chags chung bar 'gyur ba dang / zhe sdang chung bar 'gyur ba dang ske/ gti mug chung bar 'gyur ba dang / bdag dang gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa tshar gcod par 'gyur ba dang / skye bo mang po nedaga' bar 'gyur ba dang /58—809

de'i bsngagasam51)pa lha rnams kyisamachosabarjod par 'gyur ba dang / lha dang / klu dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / dri za rnams kyis bsrung bar 'gyur ba dang / las byas nas bsod snyoms zas bar 'gyur ba dang / chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal cha dang / na ba'i gsosam44)sman dang / yo byad rnyed par 'gyur ba dang / grags pa dang / sgra dang / tshigs su bcad pa phyogs bcur grags par 'gyur ba dang / mi ma yin pa rnams kyis glags 6)rnyed par mi 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bsngags par 'gyur ba dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su bsrung 6ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis 7)dam pa'i chos 'dzin par (9'gyur ba dang / ngan song thams cad kyis 'jigs par mi 'gyur zhing / de la lha dang mir skye ba dka'aspo bar mi 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ba dang ske/ 1 dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang bral51bar mi 'gyur ba dang /skye ba dran par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par skye bar 'gyur ba dang / nam du yang dbang po mitsha/getshang bar mi 'gyur ba dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis thob par 'gyur ba dang / gzi brjid can gyi 1lhagazungs kyi sa bon bsgrub par 'gyur ba dang / spobs pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rgyu rab tu 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / skye bo mkhas pas g.yog byas par 'gyur ba dang / shes rab chen po'i rgyu rab tu 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang /myur du chos kyi snang ba rab tu thob par 'gyur ba dang / de'i sems la tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid la byed pa kun tu mi 'byung beb dang / 'jig rten gyisazang zing gi 17sbyin pa thams cad zil gyis mnanam/rtenas de chos kyi gter zad mi 58—810

shes pa yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ba ste/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi sbyin pa sbyin na yon tan gyi khyad par yang dag phul sum cu rtsa gnyis po kyi'adi dag thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang chos kyi rnam7grangs 'di bzung lags te/ bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i slad na sems can snod du gyur pa de dag gi rna lam du bsgrag par bgyi/ kun bsrung bar bgyi/ mos par bgyi/5) de ci'i slad du zhe na/bcom ldan 'das bdag ni yon tan phun sum tshogs pa 'di dang bsod nams yongs su 'dzin pa don du gnyer ba'i slad du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin la legs so/ /zhes bya ba gnang ste/ kau shi ka khyod dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba'i phyir nga'i gemadun du seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa legs so legs so/ /skam45)shi ka dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di nga'i neridam pa 'i chos yun ji srid du gnas pa de srid du lha dang lha ma yin g.yul 'gyed pa na lha ma yin rnamasam7ni pham par 'gyur lha rnams ni rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni yang dag phul yin te/ kau shi ka 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad mi dmigs pa de ni 'jigs pa med pa'i sbyin pa'o//kau shi ka gang cung zad 'jigs pa skye ba de dag thams nericad ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba la dmigs shing rab tu gnas pa las byung ngo / /kau shi ka gang mi dmigs pa de dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la mi mjed 9kyi bdag po tshangs pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag bsam gtan gyi bde ba la gnas pa tshad ma mchis pa btang 1 ciste/ grong dang /58—811

grong khyer dang / grong rdal7)dang / ljongs dang / yul 'khor dngas mi/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor gang dang gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rab tu spyod pa de dang de dag tu bdag chos nyan 47pa'i slad du nye bar mchi bar ri4)bgyi'o/ /mchis nas kyang chos smra ba de dag chos dang ldan pas bsrung ba dang / sba ba dang bskyab par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang ske/ 'khor los sgyur 5kyiba'i rgyal po rnams 6)ni 'di las byung ba'i slad du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po chen po bzhi po bdag cag dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos chen po de dag dang bdag cag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du bsrung ba dang sba ba dang bskyab 7pa la brtson par bgyi'o / /bdag cag gi 'khor gang dag sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi bstanaman pa la ma dad pa de dag kyang jimatshorinas de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i slad du brtson 7par 'gyur bar dad par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong dang ske/ dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen 11dang / dge bsnyen 32ma gang 1lhadag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la brtson r+shapa dang / gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan 15pa la mngon par dad pa srung ba khomachis pa de dag srung 1 tshoba'i ched du gsang sngags 18kyi tshig 'di dag la 39kha ton du bgyi'o/ /gsang sngags rikyi tshig de 21dag gis gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / mi 'am ci dang /lto 'phye 22chen po dang / grul /bum la sogs pa dang / mi dang 25mi ma lags 37pa dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhe snang bar bgyid pa 58wa 812
